title: Senior Territory Account Executive (Kansas City)
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2>Available Locations</h2> <ul> <li>Kansas City, MO</li> </ul> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>We are seeking a highly accomplished and strategic Account Executive to join our Territory/Field Sales team. In this advanced role, you will be pivotal in driving significant growth by leading comprehensive sales cycles within a portfolio of assigned enterprise-level clients, and strategically acquiring new logos. The ideal candidate possesses a deep blend of advanced sales acumen and sophisticated technical understanding, enabling them to lead engagements at all levels, from the C-suite to technical leaders (e.g., Head of/VP of Networking or Security).</p> <p>As an Account Executive, you will consistently demonstrate advanced proficiency in all sales activities, ensuring highly accurate forecasting, proactive and strategic pipeline management, and consistently exceeding attainment targets. You will be a subject matter expert, speaking fluently about Cloudflare's products, features, benefits, and use cases across diverse customer segments. This role demands the ability to deeply understand complex customer IT Architectures, match them with relevant Cloudflare Reference Architectures, and orchestrate successful, large-scale platform sales. You will be a key driver of digital transformation for our customers, understanding their broader market trends and how Cloudflare uniquely enables their strategic initiatives.</p> <h2>Responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Strategic Revenue Generation:</strong> Architect and execute advanced territory and account plans to consistently exceed multi-million dollar sales targets and annual quotas, with a strong focus on new business acquisition and expansion within complex enterprise environments.</li> <li><strong>Expert Pipeline & Forecasting:</strong> Lead proactive and strategic pipeline management efforts, demonstrating a sophisticated understanding of sales cycles and customer buying processes. Deliver highly accurate forecasts, providing clear insights and strategic guidance to sales leadership.</li> <li><strong>Deep Customer & IT Architecture Understanding:</strong> Develop a profound understanding of customers' IT architectures, including applications and third-party technologies. Architect and align Cloudflare Reference Architectures to customer environments, driving comprehensive platform solutions.</li> <li><strong>Multi-Engagement Leadership:</strong> Orchestrate and manage multiple complex customer engagements simultaneously across various business units within an organization. Strategically connect disparate needs to strengthen Cloudflare's platform sale, actively involving and influencing technical C-level minus one executives.</li> <li><strong>Virtual Team Leadership:</strong> Set clear direction and lead a virtual team of in-GEO specialists, Product Managers, Deal Desk, and Legal to collaboratively manage and close complex customer opportunities. Proactively identify and navigate through situations to address colleague and customer needs, escalating as appropriate to drive urgency and efficient delivery.</li> <li><strong>Digital Transformation Authority:</strong> Act as an authority on digital transformation, understanding key drivers (e.g., new offering development, enhanced customer capabilities) and the broader market trends influencing these decisions. Position Cloudflare as a critical enabler of these transformations.</li> <li><strong>Compelling Value Creation:</strong> Articulate highly compelling, strategic value propositions for Cloudflare's services, directly linking them to customer business outcomes and strategic objectives. Lead with a strong focus on the "why," communicating the whole picture to both internal and external stakeholders.</li> <li><strong>Advanced Negotiation & Closure:</strong> Expertly lead and navigate complex contract negotiations, driving win-win scenarios for all parties. Demonstrate advanced closing skills across new business and expansion opportunities.</li> <li><strong>Trusted Advisor & Coach:</strong> Build long-term, executive-level strategic relationships, ensuring deep customer adoption, retention, and expansion. Consistently provide clear, direct, and constructive feedback to team members, coaching them to improve communication, learn from mistakes, and enhance the quality of work. Share learnings proactively to build trust across the organization.</li> <li><strong>Organizational Impact & Leadership:</strong> Consistently focus on the long-term needs of the team and the business, understanding how decisions impact other teams and openly sharing these insights. Leverage company-wide learnings to improve department and team execution. Serve as a leader within Cloudflare, making significant contributions while elevating the work of others by bringing diverse perspectives and strategic long-term thinking.</li> </ul> <h2>Desirable title: Head of Finance (all genders)
description: Support us in designing the insurance experience of the future. As Head of Finance (all genders), you will lead and further professionalise our global Finance function, ensuring the company has the financial transparency, processes, and steering mechanisms required to scale successfully. This role combines strategic financial leadership with hands-on ownership of all core finance activities, including financial planning, controlling, accounting, treasury, payroll, tax, reporting, and finance operations. You will lead a growing team and continue the transformation of Finance from a scale-up function into a mature, globally operating business partner. Beyond running the existing function, you will proactively identify future challenges and opportunities, helping leadership make well-informed decisions through robust planning, forecasting, business insights, and financial modeling. You will act as a trusted partner to the C-Level and leadership, and our corporate shareholder, ensuring Finance is not only a reporting function but a strategic driver of long-term success. Foster a high-performance culture focused on ownership, accuracy, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Ensure appropriate resource planning and team development. Financial Planning, Budgeting & Forecasting Own the annual budgeting, forecasting, and long-range planning processes from a financial perspective. Develop scalable planning structures and financial governance frameworks across all departments. Ensure financial targets are translated into operational plans and measurable outcomes. Continuously improve forecast quality and business visibility. Support leadership with scenario planning and strategic decision-making. Controlling & Business Partnering Further develop financial controlling processes and management reporting. Partner with department leaders to improve financial planning, cost transparency, and performance management. Challenge assumptions, identify risks early, and provide actionable recommendations. Establish a culture of financial accountability throughout the organisation. Drive improvements in cost tracking, resource planning, and investment prioritisation. Ensure compliance with statutory, tax, and internal reporting requirements. Manage month-end, quarter-end, and year-end closing processes. Coordinate external audits and relevant financial reviews. Corporate & Shareholder Finance Serve as the primary financial interface to our corporate shareholder and relevant stakeholders. Prepare board and shareholder reporting materials. Support capital planning and long-term financial strategy. Ensure transparency and professionalism in all financial communications. Global Finance Operations Own Finance processes across all markets. Ensure consistency of financial standards and reporting across countries. Support international expansion through scalable financial structures and processes. Promote best-practice sharing and operational alignment across markets. Finance Systems, Data & Automation Drive the professionalisation and automation of Finance processes. Improve the quality, availability, and utilisation of financial data. Define requirements for Finance tooling, reporting, and workflow improvements. Collaborate with Strategic Operations, Data, Product, and Engineering teams on automation initiatives. Leverage technology and AI-enabled solutions to increase efficiency and decision quality. Process Excellence & Continuous Improvement Continuously evaluate and improve Finance processes, controls, and governance structures with a strong focus on simplicity and ease of use. Reduce manual effort through standardisation and automation. Implement scalable operating models that support company growth. Ensure Finance remains fit for purpose as organisational complexity increases. Experience: 8+ years of experience in Finance, Controlling, FP&A, Accounting, or related fields. Proven leadership experience in a scale-up, high-growth, or international environment. Strong background in financial planning, forecasting, and business partnering. Experience building and professionalising Finance functions and processes. Exposure to corporate structures and shareholder reporting environments. Experience in insurance, financial services, technology, or other regulated industries is beneficial. Skills: Strong analytical and strategic thinking capabilities. Outstanding financial planning and modelling skills. Strong stakeholder management and communication abilities. Proven ability to influence decision-making at leadership level. High degree of ownership and proactiveness. Excellent organisational and prioritisation skills. Strong understanding of finance systems, reporting structures, and process design. Interest in automation, AI, and technology-enabled finance processes. Languages: Full professional fluency (written and spoken) in English and German Benefits Why getolo? 🌴 Salary & Vacation Attractive fixed salary Start with 28 vacation days, with an increase every two years (capped at 30 days). title: Senior Fullstack-Entwickler (m/w/d) – Hybrid PHP/Symfony & React
description: Der Plan steht, jetzt fehlst du: Bring unsere Software von Legacy-PHP auf Symfony und React. Auf einen Blick Stack: PHP 8.1 (Legacy) → Symfony · jQuery/Vanilla-JS → React · MySQL/MariaDB, SingleStore · Git, CI/CD Gehalt: 52.000–62.000 € brutto/Jahr, für außergewöhnliche Profile auch mehr · unbefristet, Vollzeit Arbeitsmodell: hybrid, 3 Tage Büro / 2 Tage remote Standort: Berlin-Zehlendorf, direkt am S-Bahnhof Zehlendorf (S1) Produkt: Konsentas, ein Termin- und Vorgangsmanagement für Behörden Start: so bald wie möglich oder nach Vereinbarung Die Rolle Unser Kernprodukt Konsentas ist über viele Jahre gewachsen, und das sieht man dem Code an. Das Backend läuft auf PHP 8.1 ohne Framework. Im Frontend stehen jQuery und Vanilla-JS neben React, und automatisierte Tests gibt es bisher wenige. Wohin es gehen soll, ist klar: Das Backend wird schrittweise auf Symfony umgestellt, das Frontend auf React vereinheitlicht. Bis Ende 2027 soll die Migration abgeschlossen sein. Was dafür fehlt, ist kein Plan, sondern Kapazität. Du triffst eigenständig technische Entscheidungen, bringst dich in Architektur- und Modernisierungsfragen ein und sorgst dafür, dass die Codequalität mit jedem Release besser wird. Dabei bleibt das Produkt im Einsatz: Wartung, Support und neue Features laufen parallel zur Modernisierung. Deine Aufgaben Legacy-Module bei laufendem Betrieb schrittweise durch Symfony-Services und React-Oberflächen ersetzen Fullstack-Features von der Datenbank bis zum Frontend entwickeln, teils auch als kundenspezifische Erweiterungen Bestehenden Legacy-Code pflegen, debuggen und weiterentwickeln Code-Reviews durchführen und die Testabdeckung ausbauen Mit Entwicklungsleitung und Geschäftsführung abstimmen, welche Bereiche als Nächstes modernisiert werden Unsere zwei Auszubildenden im letzten Ausbildungsabschnitt fachlich begleiten (ohne disziplinarische Führung) Gelegentlich an Kundenterminen teilnehmen, etwa alle 3–4 Wochen Nach 6 Monaten … … setzt du Features eigenständig um, hast spürbar zur Modernisierung beigetragen, die Codequalität verbessert und bist für unsere Azubis eine feste Ansprechperson. Dein Profil Erfahrung: etwa 4–5 Jahre in der professionellen Softwareentwicklung (ein Richtwert, keine harte Grenze) PHP: fundierte Kenntnisse in modernem PHP 8.x mit objektorientierter Architektur, etwa Dependency Injection, Interfaces und SOLID Symfony: nachweisbare Praxiserfahrung mit dem Framework Legacy-Code: Du gehst sicher mit gewachsenen Codebasen um. Du refaktorierst, debuggst und entwickelst weiter, ohne alles neu zu schreiben. JavaScript/React: solide Erfahrung im Frontend, jQuery schreckt dich nicht ab Datenbanken: relationale Datenbanken wie MySQL/MariaDB oder SingleStore und sicherer Umgang mit SQL Tooling: Git und Arbeit mit CI/CD Sprache: Deutsch auf C1-Niveau, Englisch mindestens B1 Arbeitsweise: eigenständig, strukturiert, proaktiv und mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch Persönlich: Du kommunizierst verlässlich, arbeitest gern im Team, übernimmst Verantwortung, hast keine Angst vor schwierigen Codestellen und gibst dein Wissen gern weiter. Abschluss: Ausbildung oder FH-Abschluss zählen bei uns genauso viel wie ein Uni-Studium. Entscheidend ist deine Praxiserfahrung. Pluspunkte: REST/API-Design und Schnittstellenentwicklung, automatisiertes Testing (PHPUnit, Jest), Docker, Deployment-Pipelines und Cloud, Software-Architektur und Design Patterns, produktiver Einsatz von KI-Tools wie Claude Code oder Codex. Erfahrung mit Software für den öffentlichen Sektor ist nicht nötig. title: Lead UAS Systems & Edge AI Architect
description: About Promethion Industries Promethion Industries is a European defence technology company building autonomous supremacy systems for aerial and multi-domain operations. Our mission is to enable decisive autonomy for NATO-aligned forces - through tightly integrated autonomy stacks designed and built in Europe. Our focus is defensive and counter-system capabilities, including anti-UAS and resilient autonomy under contested conditions. We are looking for a Lead UAS Systems & Edge AI Architect. Your mission with us Own the end-to-end technical architecture of our autonomous aerial systems. Define how flight control, edge compute, sensors, perception, state estimation, autonomy, RF/C2 and payload systems work together as one aircraft. Define and maintain clear subsystem interfaces, timing budgets, compute budgets and integration. Turn research prototypes into deployable airborne systems with clear interfaces, timing requirements and compute allocation. Architect the onboard compute stack across flight controllers, embedded Linux systems, GPUs and dedicated accelerators. Make pragmatic decisions between ROS2, existing middleware and custom high-performance runtime components. Lead rapid integration of new cameras, sensing modalities, AI models and autonomy algorithms onto flying platforms. Work directly with the aircraft, flight-test team and engineering leads to identify system bottlenecks and resolve them quickly. Drive the system from laboratory prototypes toward robust, repeatable field operation. Maintain a strong understanding of weight, power, thermal, latency, bandwidth and reliability constraints. Own technical quality across subsystem boundaries and prevent local engineering decisions from compromising overall system performance. Your contribution to the team (required) Significant hands-on experience architecting and deploying complex robotic or autonomous systems. Strong experience with real hardware — not simulation-only development. Experience deploying perception, autonomy or AI workloads onto embedded / edge compute. title: Communications Officer
company: Botnar Institute of Immune Engineering - BIIE
description: About the BIIE The Botnar Institute of Immune Engineering (BIIE) is an independent Swiss research institute advancing immune engineering to improve the health of children and adolescents, especially in low- and middle-income countries. The Institute brings together expertise across immunology, bioengineering, computational biology and artificial intelligence, combining fundamental research with a focus on translating scientific discoveries into practical and accessible health solutions. Established through the initiative of Fondation Botnar, the BIIE is a young and growing international research institute based in the Basel region. Position Overview We are seeking a creative, proactive and versatile Communications Officer to help bring the research, people and mission of the BIIE to a wide range of audiences. Reporting to the Head of Communications & Institute Relations, and working closely with scientific and administrative colleagues across the institute, you will help translate complex scientific topics and lead the planning and execution of a broad range of communications activities. This is a hands-on role, covering digital communications, content creation, internal communications, events and the production of institutional materials. You will take responsibility for content management on the BIIE's website and the Institute’s LinkedIn channel, and the organisation of internal and external events. Key Responsibilities Content Creation Develop, write, edit and design engaging content for different audiences and channels, including news articles, press releases, newsletters, presentations, flyers and institutional materials. Work with scientists and colleagues across the Institute as well as partner organisations to identify compelling stories and translate complex scientific topics into clear, accessible content. Coordinate the production of visual and multimedia content, including photography, video and graphics. Website & Social Media Further develop and manage the day-to-day content of the BIIE website, ensuring it remains accurate, engaging and up to date. Plan and coordinate digital content through an editorial calendar, proactively identifying opportunities for storytelling. Monitor digital performance and identify opportunities for improvement. Internal Communications Develop and maintain effective internal communications channels to keep employees informed, connected and engaged. Create and coordinate internal news, announcements and other communications materials. Support all-staff meetings and other internal activities that strengthen the BIIE community and foster a shared institutional identity. Stakeholder Engagement & Events Support media relations activities, including media enquiries, press materials, media lists and monitoring. Support stakeholder engagement activities, coordinating visits and meetings, and maintaining institutional contacts in a dedicated CRM. Plan and coordinate internal and external BIIE events, including scientific events, stakeholder events, visits and institutional activities. Manage event logistics and communications, including invitations, programmes, briefings, promotional materials and follow-up activities. Communications Strategy & General Support Support the Head of Communications & Institute Relations in establishing and implementing the BIIE's Communications and Institute relation Strategy and related priorities. Ensure consistent application of the BIIE's key messages, tone of voice and visual identity across communications activities and materials. Support the planning, coordination and implementation of communications projects and campaigns across the Institute. Required Qualifications Essential University degree in communications, journalism, or a related field. At least 3–5 years of relevant professional experience in communications, science communication, journalism or a related role. Excellent writing and editing skills in English and German. Experience creating and managing content in particular for digital channels. Ability to understand complex scientific topics and translate them into accurate, accessible and engaging content for wider audiences. Strong organisational and project management skills. Ability and confidence to work directly with leading scientists and subject-matter experts. A proactive, collaborative and hands-on working style, with strong attention to detail. Ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic and growing organisation. Preferred Background or professional experience in academia, life sciences, pharma, biotechnology, global health or another field relevant to the BIIE. Experience with website content management systems and digital analytics. Experience with visual communications and design tools such as Adobe Creative Cloud or Canva. Experience producing or commissioning photography, video or other multimedia content. Additional languages apart from English and German. Experience working in an international and multicultural environment. Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Territory Account Executive
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2><span style="color: rgb(230, 126, 35);">Available Locations</span></h2> <p>Spain</p> <h2><span style="color: rgb(230, 126, 35);">About the Role</span></h2> <p>We are seeking a highly accomplished and strategic <strong>Territory Account Executive</strong> to join our <strong>Iberia Sales Team</strong>. You will be a subject matter expert, speaking fluently about Cloudflare’s products, features, benefits, and use cases across diverse customer segments.</p> <p>This role demands the ability to understand complex customer IT architectures, match them with relevant Cloudflare Reference Architectures, and orchestrate successful platform sales. Strategically connect disparate needs to strengthen Cloudflare’s platform sale, actively involving and influencing senior technical executives.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Virtual Team Leadership:</strong> Set clear direction and lead a virtual team of regional specialists, Solution Engineers, Product Managers, Deal Desk, and Legal to collaboratively manage and close complex customer opportunities. Proactively identify and navigate situations to address colleague and customer needs, escalating as appropriate to drive urgency and efficient delivery.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Digital Transformation Authority:</strong> Act as a trusted authority on digital transformation, understanding key drivers—such as new offering development and enhanced customer capabilities—and the broader market trends influencing these decisions. Position Cloudflare as a critical enabler of these transformations.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Compelling Value Creation:</strong> Articulate compelling, strategic value propositions for Cloudflare’s services, directly linking them to customer business outcomes and strategic objectives. Lead with a strong focus on the “why,” communicating the whole picture to both internal and external stakeholders.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Advanced Negotiation and Closure:</strong> Lead and navigate complex contract negotiations, driving win-win scenarios for all parties. Demonstrate strong closing skills across new business and expansion opportunities.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Trusted Advisor and Coach:</strong> Build long-term, executive-level strategic relationships, supporting deep customer adoption, retention, and expansion. Provide clear, direct, and constructive feedback to team members, coaching them to improve communication, learn from mistakes, and enhance the quality of their work. Share learnings proactively to build trust across the organisation.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Organisational Impact and Leadership:</strong> Focus on the long-term needs of the team and the business, understanding how decisions impact other teams and openly sharing these insights. Leverage company-wide learnings to improve department and team execution. Contribute to Cloudflare’s broader sales organisation while elevating the work of others through diverse perspectives and strategic thinking.</p> </li> </ul> <h2><span style="color: rgb(230, 126, 35);">Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</span></h2> <ul> <li> <p>5+ years of experience selling complex technology solutions in a B2B sales model, with a significant track record of consistently meeting or exceeding sales quotas.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience managing a defined territory or portfolio of accounts, balancing new-logo acquisition with retention and expansion of existing customers.</p> </li> <li> <p>Knowledge of, or experience selling into, the Spanish market, with an understanding of its business and technology landscape.</p> </li> <li> <p>Deep expertise and fluency in cloud networking, security, and edge computing technologies, with an exceptional ability to articulate features, benefits, and use cases across diverse customer segments.</p> </li> <li> <p>Proven ability to understand complex customer IT architectures and effectively map them to Cloudflare Reference Architectures for successful platform sales.</p> </li> <li> <p>Demonstrated success leading and influencing virtual cross-functional teams—including Solution Engineers, Product Managers, Deal Desk, and Legal—to drive complex deals to closure.</p> </li> <li> <p>Exceptional strategic communication and presentation skills, with a focus on articulating the “why” and conveying the whole picture to executive leadership and technical decision-makers.</p> </li> <li> <p>Demonstrated use of AI tools in a sales context, such as account intelligence, outreach personalisation, pipeline management, or meeting preparation. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><p><strong>An overview of this role</strong><br>Analytics Instrumentation is part of the Data Engineering and Monetization (DE&M) group, focused on the collection of Product Usage and Billing event data within GitLab. kits with a single, unified solution that teams can rely on.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll do<br></strong></p> <ul> <li>Guide the design, implementation, and evolution of a unified data collection code reviews, design discussions, and clear technical documentation, with success measured by stronger code quality, faster technical alignment, and more maintainable systems.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></p> <ul> <li>Significant experience working with platform or infrastructure systems in production environments.</li> <li>Strong proficiency in the Go programming working across team boundaries with product teams, data consumers, and other internal stakeholders.</li> <li>Familiarity with cloud native technologies and open source development practices.</li> <li>A track record of mentoring other engineers and helping teams make clear, well-documented technical choices.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About the team</strong><br>The Analytics Instrumentation team operates at the intersection of Product, Analytics, and customer-facing teams, providing data collection infrastructure that serves engineering teams across GitLab. We’re a distributed team of generalist engineers who tackle complex problems spanning the GitLab codebase, JavaScript, Go, and Python satellite services, data pipelines, and AI tool integration. We collaborate transparently across teams, deliver measurable results through efficient iteration, and build inclusive solutions that respect user privacy. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. title: Senior Solution Architect - PKI (m/w/x)
description: Digitale Identitäten, sichere Kommunikation und der Schutz sensibler Daten sind zentrale Voraussetzungen einer modernen digitalen Gesellschaft. In dieser Position übernimmst Du eine zentrale Schnittstellenfunktion zwischen Architektur, Entwicklung, PKI-Betrieb und weiteren Fachbereichen. Du verbindest strategisches Denken mit fundierter technischer Expertise und schaffen die Voraussetzungen für leistungsfähige, sichere und zukunftsfähige Systemarchitekturen. Aufgaben Technologie- und Applikationsstrategie: Du koordinierst bereichsübergreifend die Weiterentwicklung einer ganzheitlichen Applikations- und Technologiestrategie für die Systemlandschaft sowie die Komponenten, Produkte und Lösungen unseres Mandanten. Systemarchitektur: Du konzipierst und gestaltest zukunftsfähige Systemarchitekturen und stellst sicher, dass technische, funktionale und regulatorische Anforderungen berücksichtigt werden. Anforderungsmanagement: Du verantwortest die Aufnahme, Analyse und Abstimmung von Anforderungen für die Entwicklung und Weiterentwicklung von Komponenten, Produkten und Lösungen. PKI-Architektur & CA Lifecycle Management: Du steuerst und überwachst den Lebenszyklus der Certificate Authorities (CA) und bildest eine wichtige Schnittstelle zum spezialisierten PKI-Team. Public-Trust-PKI: Du konzipierst und entwickelst CA-Hierarchien, Zertifikatsprofile und kryptographische Verfahren gemäß relevanter Standards und regulatorischer Anforderungen weiter. Governance & Compliance: Du erstellst und pflegst Certificate Policies (CP), Certification Practice Statements (CPS) sowie weitere sicherheits- und compliance-relevante Dokumentationen. Automatisierung & Tooling: Du evaluierst, entwickelst Prototypen und führst geeignete Tools zur Verwaltung und Automatisierung von Systemen ein. Audits & internationale Anforderungen: Du begleitest externe Audits, unterstützt die Pflege relevanter CCADB-Einträge und koordinierst Anforderungen internationaler Root-Programme. Stakeholder-Management: Du koordinierst interne und externe Beteiligte, steuerst fachlich PKI-Spezialist und externe Dienstleister und sorgst für eine zielgerichtete Zusammenarbeit. Qualität & Weiterentwicklung: Du unterstützt das CA-Incident-Management, führst Root-Cause-Analysen durch und wirkst an der Weiterentwicklung von KPIs und SLA-Reports mit. Qualifikationen Du verfügst über ein abgeschlossenes technisches Hochschulstudium oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit entsprechender Berufserfahrung. Du bringst mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im PKI-Umfeld mit, idealerweise im Bereich öffentlich vertrauenswürdiger Certificate Authorities (Public Trust PKI). Du besitzt fundierte Kenntnisse in der Konzeption und im Betrieb komplexer CA-Hierarchien sowie in der Gestaltung von System- und Zertifikatsarchitekturen. Du bist mit kryptographischen Verfahren, Zertifikatsprofilen und dem Certificate Lifecycle Management bestens vertraut. Du kennst relevante Standards und regulatorische Anforderungen wie RFC 5280, CA/Browser Forum Requirements, ETSI, eIDAS sowie die Anforderungen internationaler Root-Programme. Du verfügst über Erfahrung in der Erstellung und Pflege von CP/CPS-Dokumentationen und kennst die Anforderungen an eine auditkonforme PKI-Organisation. Du hast idealerweise Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Applikations- und Technologiestrategien sowie im bereichsübergreifenden Anforderungsmanagement. Kenntnisse im Prototyping und in der Einführung von Automatisierungs- und Verwaltungstools sind von Vorteil. Du kommunizierst souverän mit technischen Expert, Auditor, Kunden und weiteren Stakeholdern. Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (mindestens B2-Niveau) setzen wir voraus. Eine analytische, strukturierte und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise sowie ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für komplexe technische Zusammenhänge zeichnen Dich aus. Benefits Attraktive Vergütung: Ein Jahresgehalt zwischen 80.000 € und 98.000 €, abhängig von Qualifikation und Erfahrung. Tarifgebundene Rahmenbedingungen: Du profitierst von einer tariflichen Vergütungsstruktur. Flexibles Arbeiten: Mobiles Arbeiten ermöglicht Dir eine flexible Gestaltung Ihres Arbeitsalltags. Planbare Arbeitszeit: Eine 40-Stunden-Woche bietet einen klar definierten zeitlichen Rahmen. Gestaltungsspielraum: Du übernimmst eine zentrale Rolle bei der technologischen und strategischen Weiterentwicklung einer anspruchsvollen IT-Systemlandschaft. title: Manager Business Development & Market Analysis (m/w/d) | Befristet auf 4 Jahre
description: Wollen Sie Ihre berufliche Zukunft in einem wegweisenden Projekt gestalten? Bei der Deutschen Energy Terminal GmbH (DET) in Düsseldorf erwartet Sie eine spannende Herausforderung. Im Auftrag des Bundesministeriums für Wirtschaft und Energie entwickelt und betreibt die Deutsche Energy Terminal GmbH (DET) die vier schwimmenden LNG-Terminals an der deutschen Nordseeküste, über die LNG vom Schiff in das Gasnetz eingespeist wird. Die sogenannten Floating Storage and Regasification Units (FSRU) sind von entscheidender Bedeutung für die Versorgungssicherheit Deutschlands und damit kritische Infrastruktur mit hohem Risikopotenzial. Wir suchen motivierte Talente, die aktiv an der Gestaltung unseres Verantwortungsbereichs teilhaben möchten. Bewerben Sie sich noch heute und gestalten Sie die Zukunft mit uns! Aufgaben Ihre Aufgabe: Den Markt verstehen, weiterdenken und in Projekte übersetzen Genau hier kommen Sie ins Spiel: Als Manager Business Development & Market Analysis (m/w/d) beobachten und analysieren Sie fortlaufend die Entwicklungen in den internationalen Energiemärkten – von LNG über Gas bis hin zu grünen Alternativen. Sie leiten daraus Empfehlungen für die Ausgestaltung unserer Marktangebote ab und entwickeln Tools zur systematischen Bewertung der Versorgungssicherheit in Deutschland. Sie entwickeln und leiten strategische Projekte zur Nutzung unsere Terminalstandorte. Aktuell begleiten sie beispielsweise eine europaweit ausgeschriebene Konzeptstudie, aus der konkrete Projekte hervorgehen sollen. Diese können thematisch von der synergetischen Nutzung mit Nachbarstandorten über die Umwandlung zu Grün-Terminals bis hin zum Aufbau von CO2-Terminals Umschlagsplätzen an unseren Terminals reichen. Unser Gesellschafter ist das Bundesministerium für Wirtschaft und Klimaschutz (BMWK) und ihre Arbeit ist von besonderem öffentlichem Interesse. Ihre Aufgaben bei uns Analyse von Markttrends rund um LNG, Erdgas und grüne Energieträger – sowohl auf nationaler als auch internationaler Ebene Entwicklung fundierter Marktanalysen und Marktberichte zur Bewertung unserer Marktangebote (z. B. Nachfrageeinschätzung, Preisbildung, Angebotsstrukturen) Entwicklung von Tools zur Bewertung der Versorgungssicherheit, der Diversifizierung der Gasversorgung, von Marktpotenzialen und geopolitischen Einflussfaktoren Unterstützung von Vermarktungsaktionen, insbesondere bei der organisatorischen Vorbereitung und Analyse der Ergebnisse Entwicklung und Leitung strategischer Projekte zur z. B. Terminaltransformation, Entwicklung von strategischen Partnerschaften Koordination von Studien und Ausschreibungen (z. B. title: Senior Account Associate - Medical
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.</p> <p>Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.</p> <p>Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.</p></div><p><strong>Job Summary:</strong></p> <div> <p>Real Chemistry is looking for a Senior Account Associate to join our growing team!</p> <p>As a Senior Account Associate, you will have a strong focus on day-to-day project management and learning how to manage client relationships. You are already able to manage small and medium sized projects from start to finish and will be gaining experience of managing others and delegating. Both clients and your colleagues know they can rely on you to make sensible decisions, and to be efficient and reliable.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>What you’ll do:</strong></p> <p><strong>Client delivery</strong></p> <ul> <li>Take full responsibility for planning ahead and managing your time, priorities and deliverables across your accounts, proactively seeking guidance from your account leads and line manager, if required; highlight risks to project delivery, as necessary</li> <li>Confidently manage administrative accounts tasks (managing internal & external meeting invites; updating status reports; developing agendas, call notes and timelines, etc.) with minimal senior input</li> <li>Maintain an awareness of projects across your accounts, flagging key updates to your teams in a timely manner along with suggested next steps/solutions</li> <li>Manage small to medium-sized projects from start to end, ensuring that they are delivered to cost and deadline, including managing internal and external resource where required</li> <li>Identify opportunities to delegate effectively (both up and down), matching suitable assignments with more junior team members for their professional development and effective delivery (where applicable)</li> <li>Demonstrate an understanding of your clients’ needs (building an awareness of their strategy and brand) and preferences in your interactions and the delivery of work</li> <li>Lead sections of client calls and face-to-face meetings, providing recommendations and counsel to clients, where appropriate</li> <li>Develop writing skills further; conducting research, drafting the complete first draft, and ensuring content is accurate</li> <li>Demonstrated proficiency on VVPM, capable of uploading, tagging and managing assets through approval</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Team management</strong></p> <ul> <li>Understand the reasons behind why we are doing the programme and project objectives, and be able to effectively communicate these internally and externally</li> <li>Start to develop your coaching, delegation and briefing (both internally and externally with suppliers) skills, and lead by example; use these approaches to upskill, develop and inspire more junior team members</li> <li>Buddy new AA/SAA starters</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Financial management </strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop a clear understanding of the relevant RC financial processes (e.g. raising job codes, purchase orders, managing Salesforce opportunities, requesting time moves, etc.) and support your account teams as required</li> <li>Begin to draft budgets, talking your account lead through your rationale</li> <li>Complete your timesheets and expense claims accurately and on time and take an active role in reviewing timesheets across some of your projects</li> </ul> <p><strong>Agency environment</strong></p> <ul> <li>Immerse yourself in the medical communications and pharma industries, and your client companies and therapy areas: engage with every opportunity to establish an awareness of developments, innovations and trends. Look for opportunities to reflect these in your work and flag your ideas to your teams and wider team to raise your internal profile</li> </ul> <p><strong>This position is a perfect fit for you if:</strong></p> <ul> <li>​Our Company values – <em>Best Together, Impact-Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always</em> and <em>Accountability with an “I”</em> – really speak to you.</li> <li>You are adaptable, resilient, and OK with adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and focus as we grow. When things change, so do we. We’re always evolving.</li> <li>You are proactive, driven, and resourceful with strong prioritization skills and a desire to dive into the data.</li> <li>You are highly organized self-starter, able to work independently and under tight deadlines.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>What you should have: </strong></p> <ul> <li><u>Relevant degree in a scientific subject</u></li> <li>Previous industry experience</li> <li>Must have at least one year of experience in a professional environment</li> <li>Highly organised with a mindfulness of deadlines, the ability to manage multiple tasks based on priorities and a strong attention to detail</li> <li>Independent thinker confident in taking ownership of assets and material development, but a team player who enjoys collaboration</li> <li>Performs tasks with a sense of urgency and has the confidence to communicate with managers when deadlines will not be met or when issues are foreseeable</li> <li>Strong written and oral communication and presentations skills</li> <li>Open minded and eager to learn – the more you put in, the more you get out!</li> <li>High energy, able to effectively operate in fast-paced, growing and evolving environment</li> </ul> </div> <p> </p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Real Chemistry is proud to be Great Place to Work® certified; title: Director, Maternal & Reproductive Health

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span class="TextRun SCXW142035299 BCX0" lang="EN-US" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW142035299 BCX0">Resolve to Save Lives (RTSL)</span></span><span data-contrast="none"> is a global health organization that partners locally and globally to create and scale solutions to the world’s deadliest </span><span data-contrast="none">health threats. </span><span data-contrast="none">Millions of people die from preventable health threats. We collaborate to close the gap between proven, life-saving solutions and the people who need them. </span><span data-contrast="none">Since 2017, </span><span data-contrast="none">we’ve</span><span data-contrast="none"> worked with governments and other partners in more than 60 countries to save millions of lives. We work toward a future where people live</span> <span data-contrast="none">longer, healthier lives, communities flourish, and economies thrive. This is an ambitious vision, and it inspires us and our partners to make progress every day.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p></div><p><span class="EOP SCXW70040856 BCX0" data-ccp-props="{}">Resolve to Save Lives (RTSL) works with governments and partners to strengthen and transform primary health care (PHC) to improve health and save lives. Our approach focuses on making PHC more prioritized, proactive and accountable for outcomes, and strengthening how care is organized, delivered, financed and measured. Drawing on expertise across RTSL's portfolio, we bring together solutions in health system resilience and epidemic readiness, digital health and data-driven decision-making, performance measurement and improvement, and sustainable health financing. We apply these capabilities to address priority health challenges, including cardiovascular health, maternal survival and sexual and reproductive health, while strengthening health systems to deliver more equitable, effective and resilient care.  </span></p> <h3><strong><span class="EOP SCXW70040856 BCX0" data-ccp-props="{}">Position Purpose</span></strong></h3> <p>The Director, Maternal & Reproductive Health will provide strategic and technical leadership for RTSL's portfolio to reduce preventable maternal deaths and improve sexual and reproductive health outcomes. The role will lead the development and implementation of a multi-country program that strengthens government capabilities to identify and address barriers to quality care, translate data into action, and deliver measurable improvements in health outcomes.</p> <p>The Director will have overall accountability for the strategy, resources, quality, performance, and results of the maternal survival and reproductive health portfolio, leading a multidisciplinary team and working closely with governments, technical partners, and colleagues across RTSL to design, implement and scale evidence-informed approaches. The role requires deep expertise in sexual, reproductive and maternal health, strong program leadership, and the ability to translate technical evidence into practical, sustainable health system improvements.</p> <p><span data-contrast="auto"><strong>Work Location: </strong>100% Remote with travel as stated. </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto"><strong>Duration:</strong> Full-time employment for a fixed term of 24 months.</span></p> <h3><strong><span class="EOP SCXW70040856 BCX0" data-ccp-props="{}">Core Duties and Responsibilities</span></strong></h3> <h4><strong>Strategic</strong> <strong>Leadership</strong> <strong>and Portfolio Management</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Set the strategic direction, priorities and implementation approach for RTSL's maternal survival and reproductive health portfolio, exercising delegated authority to make program investment, resource allocation, and partnership decisions within approved organizational parameters and in alignment with country priorities.</li> <li>Oversee a multi-country portfolio, with accountability for program planning, budget development and management, resource allocation, performance and delivery against strategic objectives.</li> <li>Lead and manage a multidisciplinary team, establishing clear responsibilities and performance expectations, overseeing staffing and talent development, addressing performance and capacity gaps, and building the capabilities needed for sustained program delivery.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Technical Leadership and Program Development</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Provide expert technical leadership across maternal survival and sexual and reproductive health, including maternal death surveillance and response, quality maternal care, family planning, and adolescent pregnancy prevention.</li> <li>Lead the development and adaptation of evidence-informed approaches that connect data-driven learning with targeted improvements in clinical care, service delivery and wider health system capabilities.</li> <li>Guide the design and implementation of country programs, identifying opportunities to strengthen government leadership, institutional capabilities and sustainable approaches to improving health outcomes.</li> <li>Drive innovation and collaboration across RTSL's technical teams, drawing on expertise in PHC delivery, digital health, measurement and financing to address priority health system bottlenecks.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Country Engagement and Strategic Partnerships</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Lead senior-level engagement with Ministries of Health and national partners to identify priorities, shape country strategies and secure government ownership of programs and results.</li> <li>Develop and manage strategic partnerships with donors, multilateral agencies, technical institutions and implementing partners, identifying opportunities for collaboration, investment and program expansion, and representing RTSL in high-level technical and policy discussions.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Performance, Learning and Accountability</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Maintain overall accountability for portfolio performance and results, establishing clear performance expectations and monitoring mechanisms, and using evidence and implementation learning to inform strategic decisions, address delivery challenges, and adapt approaches.</li> <li>Oversee the generation, synthesis and dissemination of evidence and practical learning to inform policy, program improvement and scale-up across countries.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Qualifications</strong></h3> <h4><strong>Education</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Advanced degree in medicine, public health, sexual and reproductive health, obstetrics and gynecology, or a related field.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Experience</strong></h4> <ul> <li>At least 15 years of relevant global health experience, including substantial technical and leadership experience in sexual, reproductive and maternal health in low- and middle-income countries.</li> <li>Demonstrated experience developing and leading complex, multi-country programs, including strategic planning, budget oversight and accountability for results.</li> <li>Extensive experience engaging senior government officials, donors and international partners, with the ability to build relationships and influence strategic decisions.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Skills & Abilities</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Recognized technical expertise in maternal survival and reproductive health, with a strong understanding of evidence-based interventions, health service delivery and health system strengthening.</li> <li>Proven ability to lead and develop multidisciplinary teams and manage programs across different countries and organizational functions.</li> <li>Strong understanding of data-driven program improvement, implementation challenges and approaches to translating evidence into sustainable results.</li> <li>Excellent strategic thinking, judgement, communication and leadership skills, with the ability to navigate complex political and operational environments.</li> <li>Fluency in English required; proficiency in French desirable.</li> <li>Willingness to travel internationally, approximately 30% during program start-up and up to 25% thereafter.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Compensation and Benefits</strong></h3> <p><span data-contrast="none">Resolve to Save Lives prides itself on cultivating a supportive, connected remote team doing work that matters. We do everything possible to ensure our employees are connected and set up for success.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"335557856":16777215,"335559738":0,"335559739":0}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">The salary range </span><strong><span data-contrast="none">for applicants based in the US</span></strong><span data-contrast="none"> is $150,000 to $170,000 annually. The exact offer will be determined by various factors, such as the candidate's skills and experience relative to the requirements of the role. </span><strong><span data-contrast="none">For applicants based outside the US</span></strong><span data-contrast="none">, salaries are set according to national labor rates for the international NGO sector. </span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"335557856":16777215,"335559738":0,"335559739":0}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">In addition to a competitive salary, Resolve to Save Lives provides a generous package of benefits, including:</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"335557856":16777215,"335559738":0,"335559739":0}"> </span></p> <ul> <li><span data-contrast="none">Health insurance for you and your dependents</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"335557856":16777215,"335559685":450,"335559737":0,"335559738":0,"335559739":75}"> </span></li> <li><span data-contrast="none">Contributions toward retirement </span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"335557856":16777215,"335559685":450,"335559737":0,"335559738":0,"335559739":75}"> </span></li> <li><span data-contrast="none">Paid annual leave and sick leave, in addition to public holidays</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"335557856":16777215,"335559685":450,"335559737":0,"335559738":0,"335559739":75}"> </span></li> <li><span data-contrast="none">Two paid, week-long organization-wide breaks at mid-year and end-of-year </span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"335557856":16777215,"335559685":450,"335559737":0,"335559738":0,"335559739":75}"> </span></li> <li><span data-contrast="none">Professional development and home office setup benefits</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"335557856":1677721

title: Senior Quality Assurance Officer
description: About Vitestro Founded in 2017 in Utrecht, Vitestro is pioneering the future of blood collection with the Aletta® Autonomous Robotic Phlebotomy Device™ (ARPD™) . This groundbreaking medical device combines advanced multi-modal imaging (near-infrared, ultrasound, and Doppler ultrasound) with robotics and AI to perform the entire diagnostic blood draw procedure autonomously. By addressing critical healthcare staffing shortages and improving patient experience, Vitestro is transforming one of the most common and essential medical procedures. With more than 130 team members and growing rapidly, we are scaling our impact. As we placed our first devices with customers, we are now expanding our team to ensure successful implementation and long-term reliability. At Vitestro, we are committed to continuous innovation and improvement. As our Senior QS officer, you focus on the continuous improvement of our quality systems and support the company through the change control process. You review existing quality processes, identify where they can be improved or made more compliant, and help develop practical solutions to make those improvements happen. You also guide colleagues through change control. Rather than executing every change yourself, you ensure people understand and follow the process, ask the right questions, consider the relevant implications, obtain the necessary approvals, and ensure that changes are completed Correctly and on time. This role requires a strong analytical and systematic mindset combined with a pragmatic approach to quality. You should be comfortable identifying problems, but more importantly, finding workable solutions and alternatives. You understand the requirements of working in a regulated environment without approaching quality as simply enforcing rules. You are able to adapt, think creatively and help the organisation find compliant ways forward. First months at Vitestro In your first months, you get to know Vitestro’s quality systems, processes, and the teams working with them. You build a thorough understanding of our Change Control process and start supporting colleagues through changes, helping them consider the right questions and ensuring changes are complete, appropriately approved, and progressing on time. As you become familiar with how we work, you identify opportunities to improve the compliance and efficiency of the Change Control process and develop a clear plan for implementing those improvements. This is what success looks like: After 12 months, you are a trusted partner for colleagues working with our quality systems and Change Control process. You confidently support the organization in executing changes, ensuring they are well considered, appropriately approved, and completed on time. You have improved the Change Control process to strengthen both compliance and efficiency, and have identified and implemented improvements across other areas of the QMS. You combine strong analytical thinking with a pragmatic and creative approach. You don’t just identify where something could be improved; you translate those insights into practical solutions and, when one approach doesn’t work, find alternative ways forward. What You’ll Bring: Strong analytical thinking and the ability to assess existing processes, identify where issues occur and determine how they can be improved. Experience working in a regulated environment. Relevant professional experience that provides an understanding of how quality systems and processes work. A systematic, process-oriented way of working. The ability to identify and develop solutions to quality and process problems. A pragmatic and adaptable mindset, with the ability to think beyond rigid or established approaches while respecting regulatory requirements. The ability to guide colleagues through processes by asking questions, highlighting considerations and ensuring required steps are completed. Bachelor’s degree or higher in engineering, applied sciences, biomedical engineering, or similar technical field Minimum 3 to 5 years experience in Quality Assurance / Quality Systems for medical devices. Nice to have: Experience across multiple organisations or environments, providing exposure to different ways of working. Medical-device experience can be relevant but is not required. Experience with MDSAP How We Work At Vitestro, ownership is not a slogan - it is an expectation. We trust people to take responsibility, make decisions, and drive work forward. We believe breakthroughs happen when talented people combine dedication, accountability, and teamwork. That means: We take initiative rather than wait for direction. title: Talent Acquisition Intern
description: Our Team We believe travel can create citizens of the world. We spark moments of connection and transformation, giving people the freedom to explore openly and shape their own story. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a warm and clear writing style, as you’ll often be a candidate’s first point of contact. Curiosity about AI and digital tools, and a willingness to experiment. Ability to work well in a dynamic environment. Strong attention to detail and accuracy. Fluent in English. description: Hoe vertaal je marktontwikkelingen en klantbehoeften naar sterke proposities die zichtbaar zijn en commerciële kansen creëren? Tijdens deze hbo- of wo-afstudeerstage bij Risk Solutions, onderdeel van Centric, ga je aan de slag met een uitdagend vraagstuk waarin marketing, propositieontwikkeling, business development en procesoptimalisatie samenkomen. Risk Solutions ondersteunt organisaties bij het beheersen van financiële, operationele en compliance-risico’s. Denk aan oplossingen en dienstverlening rondom kredietacceptatie, risicobeoordeling, Wwft, AML, KYC en fraudebeheersing. Er is veel kennis aanwezig over de markt, klanten, risico’s en wetgeving. De uitdaging is om deze kennis te vertalen naar duidelijke proposities en gerichte commerciële en marketingactiviteiten. Jouw afstudeeropdracht Tijdens je afstudeerstage onderzoek je hoe het huidige marketing- en propositieproces verloopt: van een eerste idee tot content, campagne, lead en commerciële opvolging. Je kijkt waar het proces beter of efficiënter kan en werkt daarbij samen met collega’s uit onder andere Marketing, Sales, Business Consultancy, Compliance en Risk Management. De centrale vraag tijdens jouw afstudeerstage is: Hoe kan Risk Solutions het marketing- en propositieproces zo inrichten dat nieuwe proposities met beperkte capaciteit sneller en consistenter in de markt worden gezet en de zichtbaarheid, vindbaarheid en commerciële opvolging worden verbeterd? Je onderzoekt ook wat er in de markt speelt en hoe andere aanbieders hun oplossingen presenteren. title: Head of Legal @ AI Chip DeepTech Venture, Dresden / Berlin
description: This is an Atlantic portfolio venture. About the Venture We build brain-inspired computing hardware designed to tackle problems that conventional computing handles badly or not at all. Our technology has its roots in leading European research and is now a commercial system, being deployed by research institutions, supercomputing centres and companies internationally. We are a deep-tech company moving from research-led development into a much larger commercial operation. We are scaling our hardware deployments, expanding our international customer base and building the organisation and infrastructure to support the next phase of growth. We recently closed fresh funding, are around 70 employees in size and based out of our Dresden HQ. About the Role This is our first legal hire. Legal currently sits largely with the managing directors. Your mandate is to build the legal function, establish clear decision rights and create the infrastructure that allows the company to scale without unnecessary friction. You will own legal end to end, from corporate and commercial through to export control, IP and product regulation. The remit is broad because we sell sophisticated, regulated hardware internationally and are moving faster than our processes have historically allowed. This is a role for someone who enjoys both the legal and operational sides of the job: not simply answering questions, but building the frameworks, processes and decision-making structures that prevent the same questions from coming up repeatedly. What you'll do Own corporate governance across our German GmbH and US entity: shareholder and board matters, financing rounds, related-party and conflict-of-interest questions. Lead commercial contracting across hardware sales, licensing, research collaborations, cloud and service agreements, and NDAs. Build the templates and playbook so that standard cases can be handled efficiently. Take ownership of export control and dual-use matters, including EU Dual-Use Regulation, German licensing requirements, US export-control exposure, sanctions and restricted-party screening. Lead our cybersecurity and product compliance agenda, including NIS2, the Cyber Resilience Act and related incident-reporting and conformity requirements. Cover product safety and market access for the hardware itself, including CE marking, EMC, RoHS, REACH and product liability. Manage our IP portfolio: patents, freedom to operate, trade secrets, licensing, technology rights and trademarks. Manage compliance obligations connected to public funding, including grant conditions, record keeping and audit readiness. Work with People & Culture on employment matters, including contracts, terminations, employee participation structures, immigration. Data protection and GDPR sit here too. Oversee open-source licence compliance and software supply-chain obligations together with engineering. Build the delegation layer: signing authority, approval thresholds, decision rights and clear ownership, so that routine hiring, procurement and commercial decisions do not automatically converge on the managing directors. Decide what we keep in house and what goes to external counsel, then manage those firms and the associated budget. About You You are comfortable being the only lawyer in the building, and you see that as an opportunity rather than a risk. You enjoy the operational side of legal work as much as the technical side. You are direct, commercially minded and comfortable making judgement calls. You know where your own limits are and are happy to bring in specialists when the question warrants it. Qualified German lawyer (Volljurist), with fluency in EU regulation. In-house experience at a semiconductor, hardware or deep-tech company, ideally in a start-up or scale-up environment rather than exclusively in a large corporate legal department is strongly preferred. Experience with export control and dual-use questions in a business that actually ships internationally, including an understanding of the difference between licensing and per-transaction screening. Comfortable across a wide surface: corporate, commercial, IP, employment and regulatory. You do not need to be the deepest expert in each area, but you need to know what good looks like and when to escalate. You have built structure inside a company before: templates, approval frameworks, signing authority or something equivalent that outlived your involvement. Familiarity with hardware product regulation, CE marking, RoHS and REACH, or with the evolving EU cybersecurity regime is a strong plus. German and English at working fluency, both written and spoken. Based in or willing to relocate to the company's location in either Dresden or Berlin. Why Join You would be shaping the legal function of a company with direct access to the managing directors. The subject matter is unusually interesting: brain-inspired computing, advanced hardware, international technology sales, export-controlled technology, research partnerships and a regulatory environment that is evolving in real time. The work environment is flexible and inclusive, and we offer a competitive salary with relocation support for the right person. If you want to build something meaningful rather than maintain something that already exists, this is that kind of role. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Responsable d'agence F/H

Leadership naturel, sens du collectif et qualités humaines affirmées. Goût prononcé pour le développement, la création et l’entrepreneuriat. title: Chef de produit digital F/H
description: LIANAKA est une filiale du Groupe Fondasol, spécialiste de l’ingénierie conseil de la construction. Allier le meilleur des données de sols, de l’IA et de l’analyse humaine dans une plateforme technologiquement avancée, pour permettre aux porteurs de projets de construction d’anticiper les risques et de saisir les opportunités liées à l'environnement des sites de leurs projets : tel est l’engagement de LIANAKA. Dès la recherche foncière , notre plateforme délivre aux acteurs de la construction un accès direct à une information globale, qualifiée et synthétique des risques et opportunités du sous-sol. Chaque phase du projet est également l’opportunité d’optimiser les hypothèses techniques et les solutions de travaux. Les bénéfices directs pour nos clients? Une fiabilité des données du sous-sol optimisée, sur les critères eau, pollution des sols, géotechnique et géothermie. Une meilleure anticipation et maitrise de leurs projets. Des décisions prises plus rapidement. Une identification immédiate des gains financiers. Une contribution à l’empreinte environnementale des projets. title: Operative Leitung mit Schwerpunkt Finanzen 80 - 100 %

title: Beijing Office Administrator
description: <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few roles based in offices. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are hiring <strong>Beijing Office Administrators with excellent English</strong> to help take responsibility for the success of our Beijing office and hardware certification lab. </p> <p>Our office administrators are part of our global business services team which covers business services, travel and logistics, events, expense management and administration. We look for positive team players who are self-driven and results oriented, with excellent attention to detail. The best candidates show that they are forward planners, reliable and determined, and keen to assume responsibility for projects, processes and policy. We are a unique global business, so we are not looking for candidates with extensive experience so much as excellent organisers and communicators who are keen to develop skills and strive for continuous improvement.</p> <p><strong>Location:</strong> This is an office-based role based in Beijing.</p> <h3>What your day will look like</h3> <ul> <li>Create a professional, positive and welcoming environment for colleagues and guests</li> <li>Proactive management of front-of-house, meeting rooms and desk space</li> <li>Clerical, administrative and logistical tasks such as ordering supplies, office equipment, and processing invoices</li> <li>Creating and maintaining relationships with internal and external stakeholders</li> <li>Cross team collaboration across the company</li> </ul> <h3>What we are looking for</h3> <ul> <li>Excellent academics</li> <li>Excellent spoken and written English skills</li> <li>Responsible and accountable</li> <li>Self-awareness and thoughtfulness</li> <li>Ability to travel up to twice a year for company events of up to two weeks duration</li> <li>Ability to grasp our existing technical systems and suggest improvements</li> <li>Strong problem-solving skills with attention to detail</li> <li>Excellent communication and interpersonal skills</li> <li>Adaptability in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment</li> </ul> <h3>What we offer you</h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Pension and medical insurance</li> <li>Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues</li> <li>Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events</li> </ul> <h3>About Canonical</h3> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <h3>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</h3> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. <a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity">Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p>

title: Vulnerability Management Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Available Locations: </span></strong><span style="font-size: 12pt;">London (UK)</span></p> <h2><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>About the Role</strong></span></h2> <p>Reporting to the Vulnerability Manager, the VM  Engineer will be responsible for identifying, analysing, and supporting the remediation of vulnerabilities across Cloudflare's Infrastructure and cloud environments.You will work closely with Engineering, Infrastructure, cloud and compliance teams to identify, triage, and drive timely and effective remediation of security vulnerabilities in line with defined SLAs. A key focus of the role will be supporting DOD IL4 and Fedramp preparation, ensuring vulnerability processes, evidence, and tooling align with regulatory and assurance requirements. You will also apply AI-driven tools and methodologies to enhance scanning efficiency, triage accuracy, and automated remediation pathways. We are looking for a proactive, detail oriented individual with the ability to manage multiple remediation activities in parallel.</p> <h2><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Responsibilities</strong></span></h2> <ul> <li>Conduct vulnerability scanning, and perform in-depth analysis of  findings from scanning tools (e.g., Qualys, Nessus, Rapid7), to verify title: Junior Marketing and Communication Manager - IT (f/m/d*)
description: Chi siamo Nailscamp è un'azienda e-commerce innovativa specializzata nella cosmesi professionale per unghie. Ongle24 si è affermata come leader indiscusso del mercato in Francia e Belgio, e stiamo ora espandendo attivamente la nostra presenza in Italia. La nostra missione è semplice: offrire ai clienti cosmetici per unghie di livello professionale a prezzi accessibili. La bellezza di lusso non deve essere costosa! Per guidare la nostra rapida espansione nel mercato italiano, cerchiamo una persona motivata, creativa e propositiva da inserire nel team nel ruolo di Junior Marketing & Communication Manager for the Italian Market (f/m/d/) *. Le tue responsabilità Relazioni con gli Influencer (Italia): Ricerca, negoziazione e gestione delle partnership con beauty influencer e content creator italiani, dal briefing iniziale al completamento della campagna e al monitoraggio delle prestazioni. Pianificazione e creazione di contenuti: Ideazione e creazione a 360° — pianificazione, ripresa e montaggio di contenuti video e fotografici originali e coinvoggenti, pensati specificamente per la community italiana. Servizio clienti & Community Management: Gestione delle richieste dei clienti italiani tramite e-mail, ticket e social media con empatia, precisione e un approccio orientato alla risoluzione dei problemi, per garantire un'eccellente soddisfazione del cliente. Localizzazione del mercato & E-Commerce: Supporto alla traduzione, localizzazione e ottimizzazione continua del nostro shop online italiano, garantendo testi e presentazioni di prodotto culturalmente in linea con il pubblico locale. Supporto alle campagne & Presenza davanti alla telecamera: Assistenza durante i servizi fotografici/video di marketing e il lancio delle campagne, con la disponibilità e l'entusiasmo di metterti in gioco davanti alla telecamera per creare tutorial e reel autentici. Requisiti richiesti Ottima conoscenza della lingua italiana (obbligatorio): Eccellenti competenze di comunicazione scritta e verbale in italiano, con una naturale familiarità con il linguaggio del settore beauty e il tono di voce dei clienti. Comunicazione inglese: Inglese fluido (lingua di lavoro aziendale); la conoscenza del tedesco o del francese costituisce un plus. Orientamento al cliente e alla community: Passione per l'interazione con le persone, attitudine all'aiuto e pazienza nel gestire le richieste dei clienti. Gusto creativo ed estetico: Forte senso per l'armonia visiva, l'estetica moderna del settore beauty, i trend attuali e la tipografia. Disponibilità e impegno: Capacità di integrare agevolmente nella propria routine un orario di lavoro di 40 ore settimanali, nella sede di Berlino. Affinità con il mondo dei cosmetici: Un'esperienza pratica o un forte interesse per le unghie in gel, lo smalto o la nail art rappresentano un grande vantaggio (saremo felici di insegnarti tutte le nozioni tecniche sul prodotto).
