Rapido percorso di apprendimento: Un ambiente dinamico e agile in cui potrai prendere l'iniziativa, testare le tue idee ed ampliare rapidamente le tue competenze. Ambiente collaborativo: Un team affiatato e disponibile che ti supporterà durante l'onboarding e in ogni fase della tua crescita professionale. Base solida da cui partire: Accesso all'esperienza e agli asset di account aziendali già avviati, con un seguito combinato di oltre 160.000 follower su Instagram e TikTok. Ambiente di lavoro moderno: Stipendio competitivo, orari di lavoro flessibili, sconti per i dipendenti e attrezzatura di lavoro moderna. Prospettive a lungo termine: Chiare opportunità di avanzamento di carriera e di inserimento a tempo indeterminato. Come candidarsi Ti sembra il ruolo giusto per te? title: Ausbildungsplatz zum Fachinformatiker – Systemintegration (m/w/d)
description: Stellenbeschreibung Internet? Kann ich. Zukunft? Kann ich. Ausbildung? Kann ich. Wir sind ropa – ein Internet Service Provider (ISP) aus Schwäbisch Gmünd. Seit über 25 Jahren beschäftigen wir uns mit Telekommunikation, leistungsfähigen Netzwerken und digitaler Infrastruktur. Du nutzt täglich das Internet – aber weißt Du auch, was dahintersteckt? Bei uns lernst Du die Technik kennen, die hinter einer zuverlässigen Internetverbindung steckt. Als ISP sorgen wir dafür, dass Menschen und Unternehmen zuverlässig online sind und Du kannst ein Teil davon werden. Und das Beste: Du bist von Anfang an mittendrin! Von der Netzwerkinfrastruktur und -technik über die Administration von IT-Systemen bis hin zur Analyse komplexer technischer Störungen. Learning by Doing – so funktioniert Ausbildung bei ropa. Statt nur zuzuschauen, arbeitest Du an echten Aufgaben mit, bringst Deine Ideen ein und übernimmst Schritt für Schritt mehr Verantwortung. Netzwerktechnik: Routing und Switching? Verstehe, wie Netzwerke funktionieren und Daten ihr Ziel erreichen. ISP-Infrastruktur: Lerne den Aufbau der technischen Infrastruktur kennen und welche Komponenten für einen zuverlässigen Netzbetrieb notwendig sind. Netzwerkbetrieb und Monitoring: Du lernst, wie Netzwerke überwacht, technische Auffälligkeiten erkannt und Störungen analysiert werden. Systemadministration: Du beschäftigst Dich mit der Einrichtung, Konfiguration und Betreuung von Servern, Betriebssystemen und IT-Diensten. Troubleshooting: Du analysierst technische Probleme, bearbeitest Tickets und arbeitest gemeinsam mit Deinem Team an passenden Lösungen. Kundenanbindungen: Du bekommst Einblicke in die technischen Abläufe – von der Planung bis zur Bereitstellung unserer Dienste. IT-Sicherheit: Du lernst, worauf es beim sicheren und zuverlässigen Betrieb von Netzwerken und IT-Systemen ankommt. Ausbildungsbeginn: 1. September 2027 Ausbildungsort: Schwäbisch Gmünd Berufsschule: Aalen Arbeitszeit: 40 Stunden pro Woche außerhalb der Schulzeiten Qualifikation Das bringst Du mit Mittlere Reife oder (Fach-)Abitur Begeisterung für IT, Netzwerke und Technik Spaß daran, technische Zusammenhänge zu verstehen und Probleme zu lösen Teamgeist, Neugier und Eigeninitiative Ein Führerschein der Klasse B ist von Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung. Profil Noch kein IT-Profi? Kein Problem! Ob Du bereits erste Erfahrungen mit Netzwerken oder Linux gesammelt hast oder einfach neugierig auf die Technik hinter dem Internet bist: Entscheidend sind Dein Interesse, Deine Motivation und Deine Bereitschaft, Neues zu lernen. Last but not least - was wir zu bieten haben Unsere Mitarbeiter sollen jeden Tag gerne zur Arbeit kommen und sich innerhalb des Teams und des Unternehmens gut aufgehoben fühlen. Diesen Anspruch stellen wir an uns selbst als Arbeitgeber. Bei uns bist Du nicht einfach nur Azubi, sondern Teil des Teams. spannende Aufgaben: bei uns wird es nicht langweilig - Praxis statt grauer Theorie Persönliche Betreuung: Unterstützung auf Augenhöhe durch Ausbilder und erfahrene Azubis Individuelle Förderung: Entdecke Deine Stärken und entwickle Dich weiter Prüfungsvorbereitung: Lernzeit im Betrieb und Unterstützung mit Übungsmaterialien Corporate Benefits: Attraktive Mitarbeiterrabatte Candy Bar & kostenlose Getränke: Für Deine Pausen zwischendurch Teamevents: Gemeinsame Veranstaltungen und jährlicher Azubi-Tag Echte Praxiserfahrung: Spannende Projekte und Verantwortung von Anfang an Einstiegschancen : B ei guten Leistungen winkt in der Regel eine Möglichkeit zur Übernahme nach der Ausbildung Ansprechpartner & Kontaktmöglichkeiten Von Azubi zu Azubi Wie ist die Ausbildung bei ropa wirklich? Unser Fachinformatiker-Azubi Finn beschreibt seine Erfahrungen so: „Die ropa ermöglicht es mir, an spannenden Projekten mitzuarbeiten, durch die ich mein Wissen erweitern kann.“ Bei ropa bekommst du die Möglichkeit, Fragen zu stellen, Neues auszuprobieren und an deinen Aufgaben zu wachsen. Denn wir sind überzeugt: Am meisten lernt man, wenn man selbst mitmacht. Wir machen Internet. Bald auch mit dir? title: Staff Software Engineer, Security Foundations
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h1><strong style="font-size: 14px;">An overview of this role</strong></h1> <p>As a Staff Software Engineer, you'll help lead two important areas for GitLab Security: the data layer behind our vulnerability and dependency management capabilities, and our move toward services outside the GitLab monolith. You'll design and develop systems that ingest, store, index, and query security report data, including integrations with key third-party systems. With a strong focus on PostgreSQL and scalable backend design, your work will support security features delivered by teams across GitLab.</p> <p>You'll take ownership of large deliverables from early ideas through implementation, working directly with product, design, frontend, and engineering partners to shape the technical and product roadmap. You'll stay hands-on across GitLab's Ruby on Rails application and newer services, including greenfield projects, while helping the team build its expertise in modular service design.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead large technical deliverables from initial problem definition through delivery, often across multiple months or quarters.</li> <li>Design and develop backend systems for vulnerability and dependency management, including security report ingestion, storage, indexing, querying, and integrations with key third-party systems.</li> <li>Build and improve systems using Ruby on Rails and PostgreSQL, and contribute to newer services using technologies such as Go or Rust where appropriate.</li> <li>Shape technical plans, break down complex work, and help other engineers deliver effectively.</li> <li>Work directly with product, design, frontend, and engineering partners to make clear decisions, resolve constraints, and deliver measurable progress.</li> <li>Influence the team's product and technical roadmap through hands-on investigation, clear proposals, and iterative delivery that demonstrates progress in each monthly release cycle.</li> <li>Apply a security mindset when designing systems, including considering how GitLab identifies and handles malicious or vulnerable software packages.</li> <li>Define patterns for modular services, provide technical leadership when vulnerability management work spans multiple GitLab areas, and share that expertise across GitLab Security.</li> <li><span data-sheets-root="1">Take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it.</span></li> </ul> <p><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience leading complex backend projects from idea through delivery while remaining hands-on with design and development.</li> <li>Strong PostgreSQL experience, including evidence of query optimization, table optimization, and write-ahead log management in data-intensive systems.</li> <li>Strong professional experience with Ruby on Rails or  Go and comfort working in Ruby on Rails day to day. Experience with large monoliths is helpful, along with an interest in working across languages and services.</li> <li>Experience shaping delivery plans, guiding technical decisions, and supporting the work of other engineers.</li> <li>The ability to collaborate with a range of partners and explain technical trade-offs clearly.</li> <li>Experience communicating with leaders, leading peers through complex delivery, identifying constraints, and moving work forward.</li> <li>Experience using security tooling for activities such as vulnerability triage and remediation, or professional experience building vulnerability management, dependency management, or related security products.</li> <li>Experience with large-scale data systems or established software products. We welcome transferable experience from outside the security domain.</li> <li>Fluency in using artificial intelligence tools to improve delivery while applying sound engineering judgment.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>About the team</strong></p> <p>The Vulnerability Management team contributes to GitLab's move toward modular services and will help other Security teams adopt these patterns over time. Today, we include two Staff Software Engineers, two Senior Software Engineers, and one Intermediate Software Engineer across the United Kingdom, Poland, the Netherlands, and India. You'll work closely with us, product partners, and engineering leaders across GitLab.</p> <p>We work with clear goals and shared priorities. You'll receive clear context and outcomes, then have the space to own delivery, communicate decisions and progress, ask for help early, and work directly with the partners needed to get the job done.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. title: Vice President Finance (all genders)
description: Support us in designing the insurance experience of the future. As Vice President Finance (all genders), you will lead and further professionalise our global Finance function, ensuring the company has the financial transparency, processes, and steering mechanisms required to scale successfully. This role combines strategic financial leadership with hands-on ownership of all core finance activities, including financial planning, controlling, accounting, treasury, payroll, tax, reporting, and finance operations. You will lead a growing team and continue the transformation of Finance from a scale-up function into a mature, globally operating business partner. Beyond running the existing function, you will proactively identify future challenges and opportunities, helping leadership make well-informed decisions through robust planning, forecasting, business insights, and financial modeling. You will act as a trusted partner to the C-Level and leadership, and our corporate shareholder, ensuring Finance is not only a reporting function but a strategic driver of long-term success. This is a full-time hybrid role, with 1-2 days per week working from our Berlin office. Your Mission Financial Leadership & Team Management Lead, develop, and inspire the Finance team across all functional areas. Manage and support direct reports, including Accounting, Controlling, and Finance Operations. Build organisational capabilities, processes, and structures required for the next stage of growth. Foster a high-performance culture focused on ownership, accuracy, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Ensure appropriate resource planning and team development. Financial Planning, Budgeting & Forecasting Own the annual budgeting, forecasting, and long-range planning processes from a financial perspective. Develop scalable planning structures and financial governance frameworks across all departments. Ensure financial targets are translated into operational plans and measurable outcomes. Continuously improve forecast quality and business visibility. Support leadership with scenario planning and strategic decision-making. Controlling & Business Partnering Further develop financial controlling processes and management reporting. Partner with department leaders to improve financial planning, cost transparency, and performance management. Challenge assumptions, identify risks early, and provide actionable recommendations. Establish a culture of financial accountability throughout the organisation. Drive improvements in cost tracking, resource planning, and investment prioritisation. Financial Reporting & Accounting Ensure accurate and timely financial reporting across all entities and markets. Oversee accounting, payroll, tax, treasury, and financial operations. Ensure compliance with statutory, tax, and internal reporting requirements. Manage month-end, quarter-end, and year-end closing processes. Coordinate external audits and relevant financial reviews. Corporate & Shareholder Finance Serve as the primary financial interface to our corporate shareholder and relevant stakeholders. Prepare board and shareholder reporting materials. Support capital planning and long-term financial strategy. Ensure transparency and professionalism in all financial communications. Global Finance Operations Own Finance processes across all markets. Ensure consistency of financial standards and reporting across countries. Support international expansion through scalable financial structures and processes. Promote best-practice sharing and operational alignment across markets. Finance Systems, Data & Automation Drive the professionalisation and automation of Finance processes. Improve the quality, availability, and utilisation of financial data. Define requirements for Finance tooling, reporting, and workflow improvements. Collaborate with Strategic Operations, Data, Product, and Engineering teams on automation initiatives. Leverage technology and AI-enabled solutions to increase efficiency and decision quality. Process Excellence & Continuous Improvement Continuously evaluate and improve Finance processes, controls, and governance structures with a strong focus on simplicity and ease of use. Reduce manual effort through standardisation and automation. Implement scalable operating models that support company growth. Ensure Finance remains fit for purpose as organisational complexity increases. Requirements What You Need to Succeed Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field. Experience: 8+ years of experience in Finance, Controlling, FP&A, Accounting, or related fields. Proven leadership experience in a scale-up, high-growth, or international environment. Strong background in financial planning, forecasting, and business partnering. Experience building and professionalising Finance functions and processes. Exposure to corporate structures and shareholder reporting environments. Experience in insurance, financial services, technology, or other regulated industries is beneficial. Skills: Strong analytical and strategic thinking capabilities. Outstanding financial planning and modelling skills. Strong stakeholder management and communication abilities. Proven ability to influence decision-making at leadership level. High degree of ownership and proactiveness. Excellent organisational and prioritisation skills. Strong understanding of finance systems, reporting structures, and process design. Interest in automation, AI, and technology-enabled finance processes. Languages: Full professional fluency (written and spoken) in English and German Benefits Why getolo? 🌴 Salary & Vacation Attractive fixed salary Start with 28 vacation days, with an increase every two years (capped at 30 days). Holidays on December 24th and 31st. 🧑‍💻 Mobility & Flexibility Choose between a free Swapfiets bike, or a Berlin/Brandenburg ticket (“VBB - Jobticket”) or BVG “Deutschlandticket” subsidized by us Work hybrid - from your home office or in our office in Berlin-Mitte Work abroad in the EU for up to 60 days 🧘 Health Benefit from free coaching sessions with nilo.health, our mental health tool Test our products yourself! Choose between dentolo, petolo or vitolo 📚 Development Learning Budget starting from 750 € per year Regular (360 degree) feedback 🌍 Berlin Based, International Mindset We communicate, collaborate, and celebrate in English to ensure everyone is included Our diverse team spans from 33 different countries 🧬 Values Our values are not buzzwords, but actions that are a part of our individual and collective DNA: #fast: We simplify, move with urgency, and focus on outcomes #brave: We take bold decisions, challenge the status quo, and act with conviction #accountable: We deliver end-to-end, reduce dependencies, and own our decisions #caring: We treat each other with respect, build trust, and create an environment where everyone can thrive 🙌 And much more… Legendary summer and winter parties Regular team events Many discounts on the corporate Benefits Platform Two Community Days per calendar year Pet friendly office Sounds like the perfect job for you? We look forward to receiving your application and getting to know you! About getolo Founded in 2015, getolo GmbH is an innovative and award-winning InsurTech company that offers comprehensive supplementary insurance plans in the areas of dental, pet health and liability, as well as health add-on coverage. Under the brands dentolo, petolo, patolo and vitolo, we serve over 265,000 customers across Germany, France and Spain, providing digital and hassle-free protection that seamlessly integrates into their daily lives. We believe that prevention is always better than cure—which is why we focus on preventive care, customer-centric service, and financial security to protect our customers and their loved ones from unexpected costs. Thanks to the close collaboration of our team of market specialists and insurance experts, we continuously monitor industry developments to offer practical solutions for current challenges. getolo's company culture is built on collaboration, innovation, and agility—always with a strong focus on the needs of our customers. With a team of around 300 employees, getolo is led by Daniel Gadea (CEO) and Laura Wulff (CGO). getolo is a partner of DA Direkt and part of the Zurich Group Germany. getolo is an equal opportunity and diversity employer. title: Working Student Marketing & Content (m/w/d)
description: Unsere Mission Neue Kunden zu gewinnen ist für viele kleine und mittelständische Unternehmen zeitaufwendig und teuer. selqo wurde gegründet, um genau diesen Unternehmen die Möglichkeit zu geben, planbar und kosteneffizient zu wachsen. Dafür entwickeln wir eine KI-basierte Plattform, mit der kleine und mittelständische Unternehmen automatisiert passende Zielkunden finden, sie persönlich ansprechen und nachfassen können, bis aus Kontakten neue Kunden werden. Deine Aufgabe Wie selqo im Markt wahrgenommen wird, entscheidet sich jetzt. Dafür suchen wir eine Werkstudentin oder einen Werkstudenten, die oder der Seite an Seite mit unserem Gründerteam die Marke selqo von Grund auf mitgestaltet: unsere Geschichte erzählt, Kundenerfolge sichtbar macht und unseren Auftritt auf LinkedIn und in Kampagnen prägt. Du planst und schreibst LinkedIn-Beiträge für die Profile unserer Gründer und für die selqo-Unternehmensseite. Du führst Interviews mit unseren Kunden und machst daraus überzeugende Case Studies. Du gestaltest Grafiken, Karussells und kurze Videos für LinkedIn und unsere Werbekampagnen. Du bereitest unsere Inhalte für Blog und Newsletter auf und baust beides Schritt für Schritt aus. Du wertest aus, welche Inhalte funktionieren, und hilfst so, unsere Kommunikation weiterzuentwickeln. Was diese Stelle besonders macht Etwas Neues mitprägen: Mit selqo geben wir jedem KMU die Möglichkeit planbar und effizient zu wachsen. Du definierst wie wir darüber sprechen, und prägst damit nicht nur unsere Marke, sondern einen ganzen Markt. Direkt mit dem Gründerteam: Du arbeitest täglich mit uns drei Gründern zusammen, ohne Hierarchie dazwischen. Du sitzt mit am Tisch, wenn wir über Positionierung, Zielgruppen und Kampagnen entscheiden. Maßgeblicher Einfluss von Tag eins: Du bist die erste Person im Marketing. Was du aufbaust, wird zum Fundament, auf dem unser künftiges Marketingteam aufsetzt. Spannende Geschichten: Du sprichst mit Unternehmern aus ganz unterschiedlichen Branchen und erzählst, wie sie mit selqo neue Kunden gewinnen. Dein Profil Erfahrung Du bist an einer Hochschule eingeschrieben, idealerweise in Marketing, Kommunikation, Wirtschaft oder Medien. Du sprichst und schreibst Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau: klar, verständlich und ohne Floskeln. Du hast schon eigene Projekte umgesetzt, zum Beispiel einen Social-Media-Kanal, einen Blog oder ein kleines Business. Mindset Du packst Dinge an, ohne auf Anweisungen zu warten. title: Technical Support Engineer, Zero Trust
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: </strong>Lisbon</p> <h4><strong>About the Department</strong></h4> <p>The Cloudflare Customer Support Team solves complicated problems and answers technical questions via phone, email, chat and social media. Whether it is a Wordpress blogger using our services for free or a global Enterprise business with petabytes of web traffic, we are always eager to assist. We are the eyes and ears of Cloudflare, acting as the real-time voice of the customer to help communicate their needs and real-world use cases back to the rest of the company - for better service and future product development.</p> <h4><strong>About the role</strong></h4> <p>Do you love solving complex technical issues and interacting with people? Are you passionate about providing premium-level support to customers and are a standout colleague? Cloudflare is seeking an experienced <strong>Technical Support Engineer for Zero Trust </strong>to join our team. You will work with our largest and most technically sophisticated customers on a variety of technical support issues to ensure they can deploy and operate Cloudflare's Zero Trust solutions with confidence.</p> <h4><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Serve as a trusted technical advisor, providing advanced support for enterprise customers using Cloudflare’s Zero Trust platform, including products like Access, Gateway, Cloudflare Tunnels, Cloudflare WAN and the Cloudflare One client (formerly known as Cloudflare WARP client).</li> <li>Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues related to identity, device security, and secure application access.</li> <li>Communicating and working directly with the customers via phone, video conference (ie Zoom, Google Meet), chat and tickets in Salesforce</li> <li>Work directly with customers to diagnose and remediate configuration and integration challenges with authentication protocols (e.g., SSO, SAML, OIDC) and network security settings.</li> <li>Create and maintain knowledge base articles, technical guides, and troubleshooting documentation for internal and customer use.</li> <li>Partner with Cloudflare’s Product, Engineering, and Security teams to escalate and resolve advanced customer issues.</li> <li>Provide feedback based on customer interactions to drive product improvements and ensure alignment with user needs.</li> <li>Assist customers in identifying and responding to security incidents, leveraging Cloudflare’s threat intelligence and security tools.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Availability to work the weekend shift (Saturday & Sunday)</li> <li>You have a minimum of 3 years experience working as a Support Engineer / Sr. Support Engineer supporting networking or web security products.</li> <li>Exceptional troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with the ability to simplify complex concepts for customers.</li> <li>Strong customer service orientation and communication skills, both written and verbal.</li> <li>Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.</li> <li>You have experience supporting and troubleshooting multi-factor mechanisms (TOTP, SMS, FIDO, U2F, WebAuth, EMAIL, Push MFA, etc).</li> <li>Hands-on experience with identity and access management (IdP, IAM, SCIM) systems, such as Okta, Microsoft Entra, Ping, etc. Strong knowledge of authentication protocols (SAML, OIDC)</li> <li>Proficiency in networking fundamentals, including DNS, VPNs, firewalls, and traffic routing.</li> <li>Experience supporting cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and SaaS application integrations.</li> <li>You have worked with PostgreSQL, MySQL, MS SQL or other database servers.</li> <li>Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, or a related field (or equivalent experience). This may also include specialized bootcamps. </li> <li>Relevant certifications such as Cloudflare Certified Zero Trust Specialist, CISSP, or CCSP.</li> <li>Experience with building projects on Cloudflare or using Cloudflare Products.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation</strong><br>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <p><strong>Equity</strong><br>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Consultant SAP S/4HANA Transformation
description: Für viele Unternehmen ist S/4HANA ein Pflicht-Upgrade. Bei UNITY ist es deine Mission, daraus eine echte unternehmerische Entscheidung für unsere Kunden zu machen: Wohin soll sich die Prozess- und Systemlandschaft bewegen? Was kostet welcher Weg und wer setzt ihn um? Und wie bleibt das Programm steuerbar? Du sitzt auf der Seite des Kunden. Du gestaltest End-to-End-Prozesse, Zielarchitektur und Programmsteuerung. Die technische Implementierung übernimmt unser Partnernetzwerk. Unser Anspruch als Business Integrator: Wir schützen das, was unsere Kunden vom Wettbewerb unterscheidet (wir nennen das „Prozess-DNA“) und helfen ihnen zu verstehen, was sich nicht unterscheiden sollte. Das erwartet dich Transformationspfad entwickeln: Du arbeitest gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden und Team an Vorprojekten zur Auswahl von ERP-Systemen samt Definition von Zielbild, Leitplanken, Zielarchitektur, Deploymentvariante (RISE vs. GROW, Cloud vs. On-Premise) und Transformationspfad (Greenfield, Brownfield, Lift-&-Shift) inklusive Business Case. Zielarchitektur mitgestalten: Du arbeitest an Clean-Core-Konzepten, an SAP Business AI Platform (BAIP) – auf Basis von SAP BTP als Entkopplungsplattform und an Datenstrategien, etwa für Datasphere oder SAP Analytics Cloud. Programme transparent begleiten: Du unterstützt bei der Erstellung einer tragfähigen Roadmap und sorgst im PMO mit Tools wie SAP Signavio, LeanIX und SAP Cloud ALM für Klarheit über Fortschritt, Risiken und Abhängigkeiten. Den richtigen Partner an Bord holen: Du gestaltest Transformationsausschreibungen – im Mittelstand und Konzern ebenso wie vergaberechtskonform bei öffentlichen Auftraggebern und Kliniken. KI dort einsetzen, wo sie wirkt: Du identifizierst Use Cases for SAP Business AI und Joule, etwa in der Custom-Code-Analyse, bei der Datenqualität oder mit unseren KI-Agents in Einkauf, Supply Chain und Order-to-Cash. Branchenwissen aufbauen: Du arbeitest in Industrie und Handel, im Krankenhaus (IS-H-Ablösung, KIS-Szenarien) oder in der Energiewirtschaft (IS-U). Künstliche Intelligenz @UNITY Bei UNITY arbeitest du mit KI, die du selbst mitgestalten kannst: die eigenentwickelte UNITY X-Plattform gibt dir Zugriff auf verschiedene Claude-, ChatGPT & Gemini Modelle. Copilot und Claude-Modelle sind direkt in Teams und den Microsoft-Anwendungen verfügbar. In Copilot Studio kannst du außerdem eigene Agenten bauen, wenn du willst. UNITY Coding Communities, Hackathons, AI Labs und das AI Trainings Camp geben dir Raum, eigene Lösungen für intern und für Kunden zu bauen. Das bringst du mit Must-haves Junior Erste Praxiserfahrung entweder in einer Management- oder IT-Beratung oder auf Kundenseite in der Industrie Verständnis für Geschäftsprozesse in mindestens einem Bereich, zum Beispiel Finance, Logistik, Einkauf, Produktion oder Vertrieb, und Freude daran, diese zu analysieren und zu optimieren Grundkenntnisse der SAP-Vorgehensmodelle, etwa SAP Activate, und der Migrationsszenarien Die Fähigkeit, KI wirksam und sicher anzuwenden. Prägnante Kommunikation und Präsentation auf Deutsch (C1) und Englisch (mindestens B2) Ein abgeschlossenes Studium der (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, des Wirtschaftsingenieurwesens, der Produktionstechnik oder ein vergleichbarer Abschluss mit technischem oder betriebswirtschaftlichem Schwerpunkt Idealerweise Erste Erfahrungen aus SAP-S/4HANA-Projekten Erste Berührungspunkte mit SAP BTP, Signavio oder LeanIX Branchenerfahrung in Industrie, Healthcare oder Energie (Senior Level): Entwicklung Architektur-Roadmaps rund um Clean Core und BTP. (Senior Level): Übernahme von Teilprojektleitungen oder Streamleadfunktion. Senior Level: Das bringst du zusätzlich mit Du hast bereits mindestens eine S/4HANA-Transformation über mehrere Phasen begleitet. Du bist an der Steuerung von Implementierungspartnern beteiligt gewesen und hast Scope-Entscheidungen mit dem Management deiner Kunden mitgetroffen. Du hast Erfahrung in der Sammlung und Darstellung von Use Cases und/oder Change-Requests im Kontext von SAP S/4HANA Transformations-Programmen. Juniors coachst du im Projekt, und du bringst eigene Ideen in unser SAP-Leistungsangebot ein. Ehrlich gesagt: Diese Rolle ist nichts für dich, wenn du vor allem selbst customizen oder in ABAP entwickeln willst. Die Implementierung liegt bei unseren Partnern, deine Stärke liegt im Steuern, Gestalten und Entscheiden. Sie passt auch nicht, wenn du lieber ein Modul tief betreust, als den Blick über Prozesse, Daten und Organisation hinweg zu weiten. Wenn dich dagegen die Frage reizt, wie aus einem ERP-Projekt messbarer Business-Nutzen wird, dann bist du bei uns richtig. Deine Chancen und Möglichkeiten Projekte mit Substanz: Du begleitest Transformationsprogramme von der Strategie bis zum Go-Live, in Industrie, Healthcare und Energie, und siehst, wie aus einem ERP-Projekt Business-Nutzen wird. Fachlicher Austausch auf Augenhöhe: Du arbeitest mit den Köpfen hinter unserem SAP-Angebot, darunter unsere Heads of SAP Architecture & Innovation und SAP Transformation Excellence. Partnernetzwerk statt Einzelkämpfertum: Du steuerst gemeinsam mit Implementierungspartnern, statt alles selbst zu bauen, und lernst dabei die gesamte Wertschöpfungskette einer Transformation kennen. SAP-Innovation aus erster Hand: Mit unserem zentralen KI-Team, AI Labs und Hackathons entwickelst du Business-AI-Use-Cases für den SAP-Kontext mit. Entwicklung vom Junior zum Senior: Deine SAP-Laufbahn ist bei uns kein Zufall, sondern ein Pfad bis zur Projektleitung und Architekturverantwortung. UNITY unterstützt diese Entwicklung mit konkreten Zertifizierungen, die zu deinem Entwicklungsziel passen, sowie einem breiten Portfolio an Fach- und Persönlichkeitsentwicklungsschulungen. KI, die wir selbst bauen: Zentrales KI-Team, AI Labs, Hackathons und unsere eigene UNITY X-Plattform – du entwickelst Business-AI-Use-Cases mit, statt sie nur zu präsentieren. Wohnort-Freiheit: Du arbeitest an dem deutschen UNITY-Standort, der zu dir passt, zur Auswahl stehen neun. Verwirkliche mit uns deine Big Five for Life in einer Kultur, die von Vertrauen, Authentizität und Zusammenhalt geprägt ist. Und obendrauf : Unternehmerischer Freiraum für eigene Ideen, flexible Arbeitsmodelle (u. a. Homeoffice), Sabbaticals, persönliches Coaching, Mentoring und UNITYacademy, ein individuelles Mobilitätskonzept, JobRad, Urban Sports Club und mehr. *UNITY lebt Vielfalt und Chancengleichheit. Bei uns ist jeder unabhängig von Herkunft, Geschlecht, sexueller Orientierung, Handicap, Religion und Alter willkommen. description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>Our Purpose<strong><br></strong></h3> <p>At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.</p> <h3>About Us<strong><br></strong></h3> <p>SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.</p> <p>Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.</p> <h3><strong>What Are We Looking For?</strong></h3> <p>We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.</p></div><p>As a Sr. Channel Account Executive, you will be tasked with managing an assigned group of focus partners in the French region where we are rapidly growing our presence and revenues. This role will report into the Senior Director, Channels SEUR. You will manage existing and grow new national focus partners that will allow better market and vertical sales and support coverage</p> <h3>What will you do?</h3> <p>Primary responsibilities include<strong>: </strong></p> <ul> <li>Implement and manage an effective channel strategy</li> <li>Increase Partner Generated revenues and Partner Initiated Deals</li> <li>Manage existing and grow new national focus partners that will allow better market and vertical sales and support coverage</li> <li>Execute account mapping, meetings and demand generation activities with other SentinelOne staff and partners to qualify target accounts and opportunities that will lead to Partner Initiated Deals and POCs</li> <li>Generate monthly, quarterly and yearly planning of sales activities </li> <li>Lead Enablement sessions to train our focus partners to ensure we have self-sufficient partners</li> <li>Build up strong relationships with relevant decision makers and key persons within partners</li> <li>Support marketing plans and coordination of marketing activities</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?</strong><strong><br></strong></h3> <p>Ideal candidates will have:</p> <ul> <li>5+ years of high-tech channel sales experience in an enterprise sales environment, with experience of both resell and MSSP sales motion</li> <li>Proven track-record of driving continued partner growth and revenue</li> <li>Knowledge of and network within leading French VAR partners </li> <li>Understands business models of channel partners and knows how to build in our solutions and offerings into Partner offerings</li> <li>Strong working knowledge of the cyber security or similar space</li> <li>Metrics driven and accountable - takes ownership and responsibility</li> <li>Can work in a fast paced, start-up environment</li> <li>Great relation and reputation with key partners in assigned region</li> <li>Able to present in front of a bigger audience and to host events with and for partners and end-customers</li> <li>Able to identify and initiate deals with partners</li> <li>Able to work on deals and close them with a partner in close sync with SentinelOne Account Teams</li> <li>Fluent French and English</li> <li>Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience</li> </ul> <h3 class="p2"><strong>Why us?</strong></h3> <p>AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.</p> <p>We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family:</p> <p><strong>Equity & Rewards</strong></p> <ul> <li>Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)</li> <li>Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)</li> </ul> <p><strong>Time Off & Wellbeing</strong></p> <ul> <li>Competitive leave benefits</li> <li>Gender-neutral parental leave</li> </ul> <p><strong>Insurance & Financial Security</strong></p> <ul> <li>Medical and insurance benefits</li> <li>Disability insurance</li> <li>Employee Assistance Program (EAP)</li> </ul> <p><strong>Work Perks & Flexibility</strong></p> <ul> <li>Global home office allowance</li> <li>Mobile phone reimbursement</li> <li>Work-from-home allowance</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span style="font-weight: 400;">SentinelOne is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">SentinelOne participates in the E-Verify Program for all U.S. based roles. </span></p> <p data-pm-slice="1 1 []">To learn more about how we use AI in our hiring process, please review our <a href="https://assets.contentstack.io/v3/assets/blt53c99b43892c2378/bltca86b3b84e902400/AI-in-Hiring-SentinelOne.pdf">AI in Hiring Candidate Disclosure</a>.</p></div> Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Product Designer, Security
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>Brief info about Vinted </strong></h2> <p data-renderer-start-pos="1"><span data-sheets-root="1">Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third. <br>The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:<br><br><strong><a href="https://careers.vinted.com/marketplace" target="_blank">Vinted Marketplace</a></strong> is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.<br><br><a href="https://careers.vinted.com/vintedgo" target="_blank"><strong>Vinted Go</strong></a> enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.<br><br><a href="https://careers.vinted.com/vintedpay" target="_blank"><strong>Vinted Pay</strong></a> is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.<br><br>Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. </span></p></div><h2><strong>Information about the position </strong></h2> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;">IMPORTANT - this role is initially offered as a 24-month fixed-term contract, with the possibility of an extension depending on business needs.</span><br><br>We see design as a crucial element of achieving our mission, so designers are represented at all levels, including senior leadership. As our new Senior Product Designer, you will be empowered to concentrate on design solutions for people’s needs. The design organisation is well established and our impact is highly valued. That means you will be able to fully focus on your contribution to our success. </p> <p>We’re looking for an experienced Senior Product Designer to join our Security domain. The team works to keep Vinted safe and trusted without compromising the member experience. This work goes beyond preventing fraud and abuse: you’ll also shape a new, high-impact member-facing experience that broadens how people can safely access and use Vinted.</p> <p>As a Senior Product Designer in Security, you’ll own complex, ambiguous product problems from discovery through delivery, turning questions around trust, access, and protection into intuitive, accessible, and easy-to-use solutions. You’ll collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, researchers, data analysts, content designers, and other designers, balancing strong safeguards with clarity and ease for millions of members.</p> <h2><strong>In this position, you’ll </strong></h2> <ul> <li>Work with cross-functional partners to be the voice of our members, define problems and goals, map flows, prototype interactions, and support the development process.</li> <li>Own complex product work end to end, from framing the right problem and defining the experience architecture through prototyping, implementation, launch, and iteration.</li> <li>Use AI-assisted building tools to turn ideas into working experiences, test assumptions early, and accelerate delivery, while critically assessing their output and knowing when human judgement is essential.</li> <li>Partner up with other domain designers to work on initiatives that keep raising design quality and user-centeredness maturity. </li> <li>Conduct usability tests to assess and validate design ideas and collaborate with User Researchers on discovery and generative studies.</li> <li>Give and solicit feedback from designers and cross-functional partners.</li> <li>Be part of our Security domain and report to the Product Design Director.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About you </strong></h2> <ul> <li>Strong proven experience (typically 5+ years) designing complex web or native mobile products and taking them from ambiguous problem spaces through implementation, launch, and measurable outcomes.</li> <li>Interaction design, visual design and evaluative user research skills. </li> <li>Good at working with complex systems</li> <li>Excellent communication skills, including excellent written and spoken English.</li> <li>Good understanding of the design process, designing with qualitative and quantitative insights.</li> <li>A strong collaborator with cross-functional peers.</li> <li>Hands-on experience using AI-assisted prototyping or building tools to create, test, and ship working product experiences.</li> <li>A portfolio demonstrating strategic impact, complex problem-solving, and proof of shipping, including your personal contribution, delivery trade-offs, collaboration through implementation, and what changed after launch.</li> <li>Experience contributing code-based prototypes or pull requests within an engineering workflow is a plus.</li> </ul> <p>Only applications that include a portfolio will be considered.</p> <h2><strong>Work perks  </strong></h2> <ul> <li>The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme</li> <li>30 days of paid annual leave</li> <li>Newest MacBook models</li> <li>Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family</li> <li>Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture</li> <li>Lunch benefit per your workday</li> <li>Frequent team-building events</li> <li>A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted</li> <li>Access to a discounted gym membership plan</li> <li>Pension Plan with Vinted matching 150% of your chosen contribution</li> <li>Supplemental Private Health Insurance</li> <li>Life and Disability insurance</li> <li>A subsidised Deutschlandticket for your commute to the office by public transport</li> <li>A dog-friendly office</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Working at Vinted </strong></h2> <p><strong>Workation policy</strong></p> <p>Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.</p> <p><strong>Individual learning budget</strong></p> <p>Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.</p> <p><strong>Hybrid work</strong></p> <p>Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.</p> <p><strong>Equal opportunity</strong></p> <p>We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway – you might still be the perfect match!</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">The annual gross salary range for this position is:</div><div class="pay-range"><span>€86.300</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>€116.700 EUR</span></div></div></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Software Engineer, Agentic AI
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif; color: #662d91;">Teamwork makes the stream work.</h2> <p> </p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>Roku is changing how the world watches TV</strong></h3> <p>Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.</p> <p>From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.</p> <p> </p></div><h3> </h3> <h3><strong>What does the team work on?</strong></h3> <p>Roku TV is where embedded systems, media experiences, and intelligent software come together at massive scale. The Roku TV organization builds technology used on millions of TVs globally, and the team is already applying AI to demanding TV problems in resource-constrained environments where quality, performance, and reliability matter.<br>As part of this team, you will help define how agentic AI systems are designed, built, and operated for Roku TV use cases. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who treats AI agent design as an engineering discipline: architecting durable systems, grounding them in the right context, integrating them with tools and services, and making them reliable in production.</p> <p> </p> <h3><strong>What is the role?</strong></h3> <p>We are looking for a hands-on, systems-oriented Agentic AI Engineer of roughly 2-5 years experience to design, build, and maintain intelligent agents and copilots that drive automation, accelerate workflows, and unlock new product and platform capabilities for Roku TV. You will own the full lifecycle of agent development—from prototyping and architecture through orchestration, evaluation, deployment, observability, and continuous improvement.<br>You will contribute directly to Roku’s AI strategy by engineering reusable components, optimizing agent workflows, and ensuring strong real-world performance in production environments.<br><br></p> <p> </p> <h3><strong><span data-contrast="none">How will I use AI at Roku?</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></h3> <p><span data-contrast="none">At Roku, we don’t just use AI, we work with it. AI agents and smart tools help power drafts, analysis, and repetitive workflows, while our people bring direction, judgment, and accountability. We’re looking for curious, adaptable builders who can show how they’ve used AI or automation to move faster, raise the bar, and scale their impact.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p> <p> <br><strong><span data-contrast="none">We value </span></strong><span data-contrast="none">your AI skills if have built fluency across the agentic engineering toolchain — coding harnesses like Claude Code or Cursor, MCP servers, custom skills, or agent frameworks. And you can describe projects where you shipped real work with these tools. You know how to drive an agent, verify its output, and ramp on an unfamiliar codebase with an agent helping you.</span><strong><span data-contrast="none"> </span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p> <h3><strong> </strong></h3> <h3><strong>What are the responsibilities of the role?</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Architect, develop, and deploy AI agents and copilots for Roku TV use cases, integrating them with internal systems, tools, and services.</li> <li>Own end-to-end agentic systems from concept to production, including model selection, prompt and context design, retrieval strategies, backend services, and conversational interfaces.</li> <li>Design and implement single-agent and multi-agent orchestration patterns, including handoffs, delegation, and cooperative task execution.</li> <li>Build scalable RAG and context pipelines that provide high-quality grounding for AI systems and keep them aligned with evolving data sources and business logic.</li> <li>Implement tool-calling, function-calling, and MCP-style integrations so agents can safely take actions and interact with the systems around them.</li> <li>Create reusable agent templates, modular components, and paved-path patterns that accelerate adoption across teams and use cases.</li> <li>Establish strong evaluation, observability, and monitoring for conversation quality, task success rate, latency, cost, and overall system performance.</li> <li>Build safeguards that improve production readiness and reliability, including testing pipelines, controlled rollouts, drift detection, and mechanisms that prevent error amplification in multi-step workflows.</li> <li>Prototype quickly, run experiments, and translate successful ideas into durable, scalable software solutions.</li> <li>Partner closely with engineering, product, QA, infrastructure, and cross-functional teams to deliver meaningful business and customer outcomes.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h3> </h3> <h3><strong>What experience would help someone be successful in the role at Roku?</strong> </h3> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field.</li> <li>2-5 years of experience in software engineering, AI/ML engineering, backend development, or adjacent domains, with strong software engineering fundamentals and the ability to build production-grade systems.</li> <li>Strong proficiency in Python, plus experience with C/C++ or another systems language.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with LLM-based systems, including prompt design, retrieval, tool use, memory handling, and agent orchestration patterns.</li> <li>Experience building and maintaining RAG pipelines, agent frameworks, MCP servers or equivalent function-calling architectures, and conversational interfaces.</li> <li>Familiarity with cloud platforms, REST APIs, containerization, and modern deployment environments.</li> <li>Experience with observability, evaluation, experimentation, and feedback loops for AI systems in production.</li> <li>Ability to work independently, manage ambiguity, move quickly, and deliver incrementally in a fast-paced environment.</li> <li>Excellent communication skills, sound engineering judgment, and a collaborative working style.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h3>Nice to have</h3> <ul> <li>Experience with multi-agent frameworks or orchestration systems such as LangChain, AutoGen, or Semantic Kernel.</li> <li>Experience with video, audio, TV, or edge-device environments, especially where latency, cost, and hardware constraints matter.</li> <li>Familiarity with ML/DL frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.</li> <li>Research experience, paper implementation experience, or a habit of applying emerging GenAI techniques pragmatically to real problems.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h6>#LI-NM1</h6> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3><strong><span style="font-family: GothamBold, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;">What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?</span></strong></h3> <p>Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance.</p> <p> </p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>What are some of the benefits?</strong></h3> <p>Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter.</p> <p> </p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>Accommodations</strong></h3> <p>Roku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to <a ---------- <p> </p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>What should I know about Roku's culture?</strong></h3> <p>Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV. </p> <p>We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem-solvers, which itself is a two-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002. </p> <p>To learn more about Roku, our global footprint, and how we've grown, visit <a href="https://www.weareroku.com/factsheet">https://www.weareroku.com/factsheet</a>.</p> <p>By providing your information, you acknowledge that you want Roku to contact you about job roles, that you have read Roku's <a href="https://www.weareroku.com/roku-job-applicant-privacy-notice-for-job-applicants">Applicant Privacy Notice</a>, and understand that Roku will use your information as described in that notice. If you do not wish to receive any communications from Roku regarding this role or similar roles in the future, you may unsubscrib

title: Senior Software Engineer, Infrastructure / Efficiency / Productivity
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif; color: #662d91;">Teamwork makes the stream work.</h2> <p> </p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>Roku is changing how the world watches TV</strong></h3> <p>Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.</p> <p>From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.</p> <p> </p></div><h3><strong>About the Role</strong></h3> <p>You will be a SME and technical leader in engineering Infrastructure, productivity and enterprise tooling, partnering with globally distributed Engineering, Product and Security teams and systems.</p> <p> </p> <h3><strong>What You’ll Be Doing</strong></h3> <p>Roku is seeking a world class engineer to be a true force multiplier by owning the strategy, architecture, and long-term execution of engineering infrastructure, enterprise tooling, and AI-assisted workflow automation. This architect/strategist role drives org-wide improvements in engineering productivity, delivery throughput, quality, security posture, and cost efficiency by building platforms, working practices and automation (including AI/LLM-enabled capabilities) that scale across geographies and time zones.</p> <p> </p> <p></p> <h3>How will I use AI at Roku?</h3> <p>At Roku, we don’t just use AI, we work with it. AI agents and smart tools help power drafts, analysis, and repetitive workflows, while our people bring direction, judgment, and accountability. We’re looking for curious, adaptable builders who can show how they’ve used AI or automation to move faster, raise the bar, and scale their impact. <br>We value your AI skills if have built fluency across the agentic engineering toolchain — coding harnesses like Claude Code or Cursor, MCP servers, custom skills, or agent frameworks. And you can describe projects where you shipped real work with these tools. You know how to drive an agent, verify its output, and ramp on an unfamiliar codebase with an agent helping you.</p> <p></p> <p> </p> <h3><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></h3> <p><strong>AI-First Automation & Intelligent Tooling </strong></p> <ul> <li>Define and lead an <strong>AI-first automation roadmap</strong> for Engineering Infrastructure and Enterprise Tooling (e.g., reducing waste, accelerating reviews, improving incident response, increasing release confidence).</li> <li>Architect and ship <strong>AI/LLM-enabled workflow automation</strong> across the SDLC (e.g. risk assessment, automated build, test and deployment, intelligent test selection, change-impact analysis, auto-triage of build/test failures).</li> <li>Establish policies and guardrails for AI usage in internal tools: <strong>data handling, prompt/response logging, model/provider selection, evaluation, fallback behaviors, and abuse prevention</strong>.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Dev Productivity & Enterprise Tooling (Global Scale)</strong></p> <ul> <li>Set technical direction and standards for the globally used developer tools, including build systems. Source code management, branching/release strategy, and self-service support tools.</li> <li>Architect and evolve, CI/CD and build/test pipelines using <strong>Jenkins</strong>, <strong>Docker</strong>, and build systems (<strong>Bazel /BitBake/Yocto </strong> <strong>preferred</strong>) to support multi-site engineering environments.</li> <li>Own and scale test and quality workflows leveraging <strong>test management systems</strong> (e.g., <strong>TestRail</strong> or equivalent), enabling consistent traceability, reporting, and release sign-off across distributed teams.</li> <li>Drive <strong>Jira</strong> workflow design and automation (templates, guardrails, integrations) to provide consistent cross-org visibility and execution.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Workflow Automation (Cross-Functional, Cross-Geo)</strong></p> <ul> <li>Design and implement automation spanning <strong>Engineering, Product, Marketing, and Partners</strong> (e.g., launch readiness, certification/release checklists, partner onboarding, incident/change workflows).</li> <li>Replace manual coordination with durable automation and integrations that work reliably across regions/time zones.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Security, Cost, Performance, and Reliability (Distributed Systems)</strong></p> <ul> <li>Embed <strong>secure-by-default</strong> controls into pipelines and tooling (access control, secrets handling, audit trails, policy enforcement), including for AI-enabled systems.</li> <li>Improve build/test performance and reliability (build times, test duration, flake reduction, pipeline stability) using measurable KPIs and operational rigor.</li> <li>Drive cost efficiencies across tooling/infrastructure (compute utilization, caching strategies, license rationalization including AI/runtime costs and ROI tracking.</li> <li>This is a highly visible role and you will report directly to a Vice President of Engineering. This requires a very strong technical leader with experience in the development of consumer electronics devices. The right person for this role will have ability to collaborate well with engineering and partner teams.</li> <li>Own cross-team architectures and standards; drive adoption through influence, clear technical judgment, and sustained multi-quarter execution.</li> <li>Lead design reviews, mentor senior engineers, and unblock the hardest technical problems across distributed teams and systems.</li> <li>Provide long-term stewardship via roadmaps, operational maturity (runbooks/SLOs), and incident/postmortem practices suitable for 24/7 global operations.</li> <li>Establish yourself as the person others bring their hardest problems to</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h3><strong>We’re Excited If You Have</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s in Computer Science or Computer Engineering, or equivalent experience</li> <li>Prior experience at Staff, Principal, or Architect level</li> <li>Ownership in platform/infrastructure, developer productivity, CI/CD, build systems, or workflow automation, including work spanning globally distributed teams and systems.</li> <li>Strong, hands-on knowledge of:</li> </ul> <ul> <li> <ul> <li>Git (workflows, branching strategies, release management)</li> <li>Jenkins (CI/CD pipeline design, scaling, reliability)</li> <li>Docker containers (reproducible build/test execution)</li> </ul> </li> </ul> <p>Build systems ( itBake/Yocto preferred)</p> <ul> <ul> <li>Jira (workflow design/automation, cross-team visibility)</li> <li>Test management systems (e.g., TestRail or equivalent)</li> </ul> <li>Demonstrated experience delivering automation at scale, including building platforms/components used by multiple teams.</li> <li>Strong systems thinking across security, reliability, performance, and cost tradeoffs.</li> <li>Excellent written communication (architecture docs, decision records, operating procedures).</li> <li>Experience building AI-assisted developer tooling (e.g., CI insights, test intelligence, code review automation, release risk Our squads belong to our wider collectives (a word we use to describe self-governing business units of ~100 people). title: Développeur Python IA
description: Développeur Python IA (H/F) Paris/Lille | Secteur Assurance Pourquoi cette opportunité ? Vous rejoindrez une équipe motivée et talentueuse, dont la mission est d’intégrer l’IA au cœur de nos processus métier. L’objectif est de répondre aux besoins de nos équipes comme à ceux de nos clients, et d’automatiser certaines tâches à faible valeur ajoutée. Éléments clés Concevoir des solutions RAG et agentiques appliquées à des cas d’usage métier concrets. Développer et orchestrer des agents tout en assurant la traçabilité des sources et la maîtrise des hallucinations. Contribuer directement au workflow de paramétrage produit KELIA, avec une validation humaine intégrée aux étapes clés. Participer à la mise en production des assistants, de leur API jusqu’à leur intégration dans l’interface web interne. Ce qu’il faut savoir : Nous recherchons un(e) Développeur Python IA pour rejoindre notre équipe R&D à Paris ou Lille Vous interviendrez sur l’ensemble du cycle de vie des solutions, de la conception jusqu’à la mise en production, en mobilisant différentes approches : modèles de langage (LLM), apprentissage supervisé, clustering et autres techniques de machine Learning. Un volet important de la mission concerne également le paramétrage produit : l’objectif est d’extraire les informations pertinentes des conditions générales, de proposer un paramétrage, de prévoir une validation par un expert à chaque étape et de produire un fichier directement importable dans KELIA. Missions principales : Vous développez en Python des fonctionnalités IA. Ingestion documentaire : extraire le texte et les tableaux des PDF, des pages Confluence, des documents SharePoint et des dépôts GitLab, puis découper, indexer et mettre à jour ces contenus avec des jobs asynchrones. Recherche : recherche hybride (sémantique et mots-clés), filtres par collection et par chemin, reranking, et recherche visuelle sur les pages de documents. Agents et LLM : développer des agents avec LangGraph (routage, recherche, filtrage, réflexion, réponse), écrire et versionner les prompts, citer les sources, et répondre « je ne trouve pas » quand l'information manque. Workflow de paramétrage produit : contribuer à l'agent qui extrait les informations des conditions générales, propose le paramétrage, fait valider chaque étape par un expert et produit un fichier importable dans KELIA. Qualité : maintenir des jeux de tests, mesurer le taux de bonnes réponses, suivre les réponses inventées et vérifier que les résultats sont stables d'un run à l'autre. Coût et latence : suivre la consommation de tokens, le temps de première réponse et le cache, et choisir le bon modèle pour chaque tâche. API : exposer les assistants en API, avec des réponses en streaming, et les intégrer à l'interface web interne. Documenter votre code, écrire des tests et participer aux revues de code. Ce poste est fait pour vous si: Vous êtes diplômé(e) d’un Bac+5 en informatique ou assurance Vous maîtrisez Python 3.11+ et êtes à l’aise avec le développement d’API via FastAPI , Pydantic et le streaming SSE . Vous avez une expérience ou un réel intérêt pour les solutions d’ IA générative , les LLM et les architectures agentiques avec LangChain , LangGraph et LiteLLM . Vous connaissez les principes de RAG , de recherche hybride, d’embeddings et de reranking, idéalement avec Qdrant . Vous savez travailler avec des sources documentaires variées et leur ingestion, notamment des PDF , Confluence , SharePoint ou GitLab , avec des outils tels que Docling . Vous êtes à l’aise avec les environnements de stockage et de persistance reposant sur PostgreSQL et le stockage objet S3 . Vous accordez de l’importance à l’observabilité et à la qualité des solutions IA, notamment au suivi des prompts, des traces, des logs, des coûts et des performances, avec des outils comme MLflow . Vous êtes sensibilisé aux enjeux de sécurité, d’authentification et de gestion des rôles, notamment avec Keycloak . Vous évoluez avec aisance dans un environnement d’industrialisation moderne utilisant Git , GitLab CI , Docker , Kubernetes , Helm et pytest , ainsi que des outils collaboratifs comme Jira et Confluence . Ce que vous apportez Une bonne maîtrise de Python et de ses bonnes pratiques : tests (pytest), typage, gestion des dépendances. Votre expérience dans l’utilisation des API de LLM et bases du prompt engineering, y compris les sorties structurées. Votre compréhension du fonctionnement d'un RAG : embeddings, découpage, recherche, génération. Une bonne maîtrise du SQL et notions de bases de données. Git et travail en équipe. Pourquoi nous joindre: Pour contribuer à une stratégie où l’intelligence artificielle est un levier clé de la feuille de route technologique, avec des solutions intégrées au cœur des outils métiers. Pour travailler sur des cas d’usage concrets d’IA générative, de RAG et d’agents LLM, de l’expérimentation jusqu’à l’industrialisation. Pour associer des technologies IA de pointe à une expertise métier forte dans le secteur de l’assurance et créer des solutions à impact réel. Prêt(e) à démarrer une nouvelle expérience ?
