title: Marketing Specialist
description: At Goodweek, we help businesses make the most of AI. Our platform brings leading AI models, such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Mistral, together in one place, allowing employees to use the right AI tools for their tasks while keeping everything secure, controlled, and connected to the software they already use. By helping businesses manage AI more effectively, we enable them to save time, reduce costs, and improve productivity. We work through our partners, including Distributors and Managed Service Providers (MSPs), who bring Goodweek’s platform to their own customers. Our international team is based across France, Spain, and the United States, and our vision is backed by six international investment funds. The role As a Marketing Specialist, you will take ownership of our field marketing activities (trade shows and international events), paid acquisition campaigns (LinkedIn Ads and budget management), visual design and branding, and content localization across our target markets. You will be part of a growing team where you’ll have the opportunity to shape how we present our brand and reach new audiences. We’re looking for a hands-on and versatile person who enjoys both developing ideas and putting them into practice. You should be comfortable moving between planning marketing initiatives and managing their day-to-day execution, from creating visuals to coordinating events and running campaigns. Tasks Trade Shows & Events Plan and coordinate Goodweek’s participation in international trade shows and industry events. Manage all event logistics and visual branding, including booth design, signage, branded merchandise, localized brochures, interactive activities, and contests. Coordinate external vendors and suppliers to ensure smooth event execution. Organise networking events, partner meetups, and cocktail receptions alongside major industry events. Represent Goodweek on-site, engaging with prospects, partners, and industry professionals. Localisation, Multilingual Adaptation & Content Rollout Manage the localization and adaptation of marketing materials across Goodweek’s target markets. Develop scalable processes to roll out localized content efficiently, using multilingual templates and automated asset creation where possible. Ensure brand consistency and maintain high-quality standards across all translated and adapted content before publication. Digital Acquisition & Budget Management Develop and execute paid acquisition campaigns for each target market using LinkedIn Campaign Manager. Manage the overall acquisition budget and continuously optimize cost per lead (CPL) and marketing-qualified lead (MQL) generation across regions. Represent the partner marketing perspective in program design, working with Rev team, Operations, and Legal on how benefits, MDF, and tier criteria will work in practice. Build joint marketing plan templates for reseller partners, including campaign calendars and success metrics. Run Distributor-led acquisition campaigns using co-branded and localized kits for each market, and help Distributors customize them for their own MSP clients. Own Partner Marketing Funds (MDF) end to end: coordinate with Revenue Sales team on MDF, help Distributors build proposals, track approvals and documentation, and connect every funded activity to registered pipeline. Define KPIs, track campaign ROI, and prepare monthly performance reports and dashboards. Create, optimise, and A/B test localized landing pages and conversion forms to improve campaign performance. Marketing Automation & Workflow Optimisation Create automated lead follow-ups, including multilingual emails within 48 hours after events. Scale global communication workflows and develop modular email templates that can be adapted across markets. Automate repetitive marketing tasks and improve the efficiency of campaign execution. Brand, Design & Content Production Create visual assets for the business, including advertising banners, infographics, print materials, and event signage. Support organic LinkedIn growth by developing engaging post formats, carousels, key takeaways, and live event coverage. Create and coordinate high-value marketing content, including customer case studies, blog articles, and lead-generation materials such as use cases and customer testimonials. Requirements Proficiency in English and either Spanish or French. 3–5 years of experience in digital marketing or communications, ideally with initial experience in an international environment. Advanced experience in design tools such as Canva. Hands-on experience managing paid campaigns across multiple countries, particularly LinkedIn Ads, and working with marketing automation platforms. Strong organizational skills and a structured approach to managing multilingual marketing assets across different markets. Ability to work effectively in a dynamic environment, adapt quickly, and reprioritize when needed. Strong sense of ownership, initiative, and a hands-on approach to execution. Genuine enthusiasm for meeting and engaging with international prospects and partners at trade shows and industry events. Benefits Health insurance provided by the employer Meal vouchers and transportation cost reimbursement (50%) Flexible working hours Hybrid remote work Daily use of English through close collaboration with teams in the US and Spain Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Professional Services Consultant, Zero Trust
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong>Available Locations: </strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Austin, TX</strong></li> <li><strong>New York, NY</strong></li> <li><strong>Washington DC</strong></li> <li><strong>San Francisco Bay Area</strong></li> </ul> <hr> <h3><strong>About the role:</strong></h3> <p>Cloudflare provides consultative and hands-on-keyboard implementation and migration services for enterprise customers. As a Senior Zero Trust Consultant within Professional Services, you are a senior individual contributor in the post-sales landscape, responsible for the technical execution of our most complex Zero Trust / SASE solutions and for guiding our customers to get the most value possible from their Cloudflare investment. You are a technical leader in the room — trusted to own the hardest engagements end to end, unblock escalations, and set the standard for how the practice delivers.</p> <p>You are a security and networking specialist with deep, hands-on experience across ZTNA, Secure Web Gateway, DNS filtering, Data Loss Prevention, CASB, Remote Browser Isolation, Cloud Email Security, and the identity and network on-ramps that tie a SASE architecture together. You are equally comfortable designing an architecture, configuring it hands-on-keyboard (including as code), troubleshooting a packet capture, and explaining the outcome to a customer's security leadership.</p> <p>This position has working hours Monday to Friday, 09:00–18:00. Occasionally we support customers over weekends for specific changes that must be done outside their business hours. Less than 15% of travel is expected. Work is performed in English; fluency in Spanish or Portuguese is a strong advantage.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li style="line-height: 2;">Plan and deliver timely and organized services for customers, ensure customers see the full value in Cloudflare’s products and advice on product best practices.</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Gather business and technical requirements, use cases and any other information required to build, migrate and deliver a solution on behalf of the customer and transition the Cloudflare working environment to the customer. Produce a Solution Design, HLD, LLD, databuilds, procedures, scripts, test plans, drawings, deployment plan, migration plan, as-builts, and any other artifacts necessary to deliver the solution and transition smoothly into the customer’s technical teams.</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Implement changes on behalf of the customer in the Cloudflare environment following the customer's change-management process. Provide guidance to the customer to configure their CPEs and integration points (identity providers, endpoints/MDM, DNS, network on-ramps, SIEM).</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Troubleshoot implementation issues and collaborate with Customer Support, Engineering, and other teams to drive technical escalations to resolution.</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Contribute to the success of the organization through knowledge-sharing — internal and external documentation, technical Q&A, and iterating on best practices. Build operational assets such as templates, automation scripts, procedures, and workflows.</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Lead multi-workstream engagements and act as the senior technical owner for complex deployments; support pre-sales scoping and solution design; and mentor junior consultants, helping scale the practice through reusable intellectual property.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Experience might include a combination of the skills below:</strong></p> <ul> <li style="line-height: 2;">3+ years in a customer-facing technical implementation or onboarding team, security engineering team, security operations center, or other highly technical team, including 3+ years focused on Zero Trust / SASE.</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Strong command of the OSI model and core protocols: TCP/IP, TLS (including TLSv1.3 and mTLS), DNS, HTTP/2.</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Deep understanding of Zero Trust technologies: Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA), Secure Web Gateway (SWG), Remote Browser Isolation (RBI), Data Loss Prevention (DLP), CASB, and Cloud Email Security.</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Deep understanding of internet and security technologies: forward and reverse proxies with content filtering & DLP, sandboxing, firewalls/NGFW, WAF, bot management, rate limiting, and SSL/IPsec & SSL/TLS VPN appliances and services.</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Modern identity: SSO via SAML and OIDC, SCIM user/group provisioning and deprovisioning, LDAP/Active Directory, MFA/FIDO2, and the role of the IdP — with hands-on experience on Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, or Ping.</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">DNS in depth: DNS filtering, DoH/DoT, conditional forwarding / split-DNS, internal-zone resolution, and local domain fallback.</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Endpoints: software distribution and deployment across Windows, macOS, and Linux; Windows and Linux server administration; and client-endpoint troubleshooting across all three platforms.</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Networking troubleshooting: debugging network connectivity with standard tools (packet capture, DNS/HTTP tracing).</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Ability to manage a project, work to deadlines, and prioritize between competing demands.</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Work performed in English; fluency in Spanish or Portuguese is a strong advantage.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Demonstrated technical experience (hands-on-keyboard) with:</strong></p> <p><em>At the senior level we expect these to be hands-on-keyboard — configured, deployed, migrated, or troubleshot in production — not just understood conceptually.</em></p> <ul> <li style="line-height: 2;">Experience working with Reverse & Forward proxies with Content Filtering & DLP technologies</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Software distribution & deployment in Microsoft, Mac and Linux environments</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Detailed working knowledge of web based security, network segmentation, security proxies,  Firewalls and NGFWs, SSL/IPSec and SSL/TLS VPN appliances & services, etc</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Integrating identity providers with enterprise applications end to end — SSO (SAML/OIDC) and SCIM provisioning, group/attribute mapping, and troubleshooting the IdP handshake.</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Windows & Linux Server system administration</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Windows, MacOS and Linux client endpoints troubleshooting</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Experience debugging Network connectivity issues using Network Troubleshooting Tools</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred but not mandatory:</strong></p> <ul> <li style="line-height: 2;">Automation / Infrastructure-as-Code: Terraform (ideally the Cloudflare provider), REST APIs, Python/Bash scripting, Git, CI/CD, and policy-as-code.</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Cloud platforms: AWS / Azure / GCP networking — VPC/VNet, Security Groups / NSG / NACL, cloud-native DNS resolvers (Route 53 Inbound Endpoints, Azure Private DNS), cloud IAM, and deploying connectors in IaaS.</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">SASE on-ramp networking: IPsec/GRE tunnel configuration, BGP, Anycast, network segmentation for Zero Trust, and SD-WAN / MPLS / WAN-optimization background.</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">MDM software distribution (Intune, Jamf).</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Identity & directory tooling: Microsoft Active Directory, GPO, Entra ID, and Intune.</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Observability: log export (Logpush) and SIEM integration (Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, Elastic, Chronicle); Digital Experience Monitoring (DEX).</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Frameworks & compliance: NIST Zero Trust Architecture; GDPR, DORA, NIS2, ISO title: Senior Named Account Executive, Israel
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong>Available Location: London, United Kingdom <br></strong></h3> <hr> <h3><strong>About the Role</strong></h3> <p>We are seeking a highly accomplished and strategic Account Executive<strong> </strong>to join our Enterprise / Field Sales team. In this advanced role, you will be pivotal in driving significant growth by leading comprehensive sales cycles within a portfolio of assigned enterprise-level clients, and strategically acquiring new logos. The ideal candidate possesses a deep blend of advanced sales acumen and sophisticated technical understanding, enabling them to lead engagements at all levels, from the C-suite to technical leaders (e.g., Head of/VP of Networking or Security).</p> <p>As an Account Executive, you will consistently demonstrate advanced proficiency in all sales activities, ensuring highly accurate forecasting, proactive and strategic pipeline management, and consistently exceeding attainment targets. You will be a subject matter expert, speaking fluently about Cloudflare's products, features, benefits, and use cases across diverse customer segments. This role demands the ability to deeply understand complex customer IT Architectures, match them with relevant Cloudflare Reference Architectures, and orchestrate successful, large-scale platform sales. You will be a key driver of digital transformation for our customers, understanding their broader market trends and how Cloudflare uniquely enables their strategic initiatives.</p> <h3><strong>What You'll Do</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Strategic Revenue Generation:</strong> Architect and execute advanced territory and account plans to consistently exceed multi-million dollar sales targets and annual quotas, with a strong focus on new business acquisition and expansion within complex enterprise environments.</li> <li><strong>Expert Pipeline & Forecasting:</strong> Lead proactive and strategic pipeline management efforts, demonstrating a sophisticated understanding of sales cycles and customer buying processes. Deliver highly accurate forecasts, providing clear insights and strategic guidance to sales leadership.</li> <li><strong>Deep Customer & IT Architecture Understanding:</strong> Develop a profound understanding of customers' IT architectures, including applications and third-party technologies. Architect and align Cloudflare Reference Architectures to customer environments, driving comprehensive platform solutions.</li> <li><strong>Multi-Engagement Leadership:</strong> Orchestrate and manage multiple complex customer engagements simultaneously across various business units within an organization. Strategically connect disparate needs to strengthen Cloudflare's platform sale, actively involving and influencing technical C-level minus one executives.</li> <li><strong>Virtual Team Leadership:</strong> Set clear direction and lead a virtual team of in-GEO specialists, Product Managers, Deal Desk, and Legal to collaboratively manage and close complex customer opportunities. Proactively identify and navigate through situations to address colleague and customer needs, escalating as appropriate to drive urgency and efficient delivery.</li> <li><strong>Digital Transformation Authority:</strong> Act as an authority on digital transformation, understanding key drivers (e.g., new offering development, enhanced customer capabilities) and the broader market trends influencing these decisions. Lead with a strong focus on the "why," communicating the whole picture to both internal and external stakeholders.</li> <li><strong>Advanced Negotiation & Closure:</strong> Expertly lead and navigate complex contract negotiations, driving win-win scenarios for all parties. Demonstrate advanced closing skills across new business and expansion opportunities.</li> <li><strong>Trusted Advisor & Coach:</strong> Build long-term, executive-level strategic relationships, ensuring deep customer adoption, retention, and expansion. Consistently provide clear, direct, and constructive feedback to team members, coaching them to improve communication, learn from mistakes, and enhance the quality of work. Share learnings proactively to build trust across the organization.</li> <li><strong>Organizational Impact & Leadership:</strong> Consistently focus on the long-term needs of the team and the business, understanding how decisions impact other teams and openly sharing these insights. Leverage company-wide learnings to improve department and team execution. Serve as a leader within Cloudflare, making significant contributions while elevating the work of others by bringing diverse perspectives and strategic long-term thinking.</li> </ul> title: Technical Support Engineer
description: Join GLS/NXT as a Technical Support Engineer and help keep the future of out-of-home delivery running smoothly. We’re building the OOH Platform - a smart parcel locker platform that connects carriers, locker providers, and end customers across Europe. As a Technical Support Engineer, you make sure every incident is thoroughly investigated and resolved. You handle incoming tickets, analyze logs and data to find the source of a failure, and follow each case through until it’s fully fixed. When an error keeps coming back, you push until its root cause is found and eliminated - and you build the processes, metrics, and reporting that make support predictable and transparent. If you enjoy digging into complex problems, take ownership until things are truly fixed, and thrive in a collaborative and fast-moving environment, we’d love to have you on board. Let’s build the future of logistics - together. Tasks Own incoming support tickets from triage to resolution, prioritizing by business impact. Analyze logs (e.g. Datadog) and production data (SQL) to find where an issue originates. Escalate confirmed bugs to the right team with clear, reproducible reports. Act as a technical point of contact for external partners on incidents and integration issues, requesting missing details and following up until each issue is properly resolved. Identify recurring cases and drive them to a root-cause fix instead of closing each ticket as a one-off. Build deep knowledge of the parcel lifecycle (drop-off, collection, returns, labelless flows, state transitions) and of how carrier and provider integrations behave, including edge cases. Build and improve support processes, including triage rules, escalation paths, and follow-up routines. Define and track support metrics such as ticket volume, resolution time, recurring issues, and response quality, and prepare regular reports on open issues and trends to push for long-term fixes. Requirements 3+ years of experience in technical support , application support, or a similar engineering-facing role. Hands-on experience analyzing logs and working with monitoring tools (e.g., Datadog). Basic SQL skills for investigating production data. Understanding of REST APIs and integrations , with the ability to read request and response payloads. Experience with Postman or similar API tools. Experience with ticketing and issue tracking tools (e.g., Jira, Zendesk). Strong analytical thinking and a structured approach to troubleshooting. Persistence and ownership in driving issues to resolution. Experience using metrics and reports to drive process decisions. Clear written and verbal communication skills in English , with the ability to explain technical issues to partners and internal teams. Nice to have: a background in logistics, parcel delivery, or e-commerce, and experience managing third-party vendors or carrier integrations. title: Director of Sales, Named (Toronto)
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: Toronto, Ontario</strong></p> <p><strong>About the Department</strong></p> <p>The Cloudflare sales team is comprised of Account Executives, Business Development Representatives, Solution Engineers, Customer Success, and Sales Operations - all working together to acquire customers and help them adopt Cloudflare technologies to create great Internet-enabled experiences.</p> <p>The sales team at Cloudflare helps customers solve real security and performance challenges while creating the revenue streams that help the company provide free services to millions in our community.</p> <p><strong>What you'll do</strong></p> <p>We are looking for an experienced <strong>Sales Director</strong> to lead and grow the Enterprise and Public Sector  business in Ontario with responsibility for driving Cloudflare's revenue and brand awareness in the region. Based in the Greater Toronto Area and reporting directly to the Canadian VP, the Sales Director will require both strategic and hands-on leadership skills to lead the go-to-market strategy, including hiring, leading and growing the sales team, building pipeline, and driving sales to grow the business in the region. In this role you will work actively with prospects, customers, partners and field sales professionals to sell and close deals to build the region.</p> <p><strong>Additional responsibilities will include:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Design, build and execute strategies for the Region in collaboration with regional and global functional leaders</li> <li>Lead and grow the Central Canada Enterprise and Public Sector (Named) sales team working with global functional leaders and recruiting resources.</li> <li>Serve as the local point person for all Named functions in Canada including customer relationships, pipeline development, account management, sales and partnerships.</li> <li>Drive business cadence for forecast calls, business  reviews, deal reviews, customer account reviews, weekly team meetings and periodic company-wide meetings.</li> <li>Lead programs and campaigns - working across sales, marketing, customer success, solutions engineering, business development and support - to drive awareness, pipeline and sales results.</li> <li>Drive sales growth through successful leadership, organizational planning, customer service and outstanding execution of all regional sales and go-to-market strategies.  </li> <li>Represent Cloudflare as the single point of contact for all Regional operational concerns, ensuring proper and timely escalation and resolution.</li> <li>Ensure that corporate policy and regulatory initiatives are consistently applied and followed by team members.</li> <li>Outstanding leadership that inspires interpersonal effectiveness, develops talent and effects change. Willing and able to be a “doer” and “influencer”.</li> <li>Represent Cloudflare at external conferences and events.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Examples of desirable skills, knowledge and experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree required.</li> <li>10+ years of direct B2B sales experience, selling to large Enterprise accounts </li> <li>5+ years of direct sales management experience leading an Enterprise field sales team.</li> <li>Experience managing and coaching long, complex, high value Enterprise sales cycles </li> <li>Experience selling into top tier accounts in key verticals including Financial Services, Retail, Industrial. Energy and Media.</li> <li>Understanding of IaaS, Networking and Information Security services.</li> <li>Aptitude for learning technical concepts/terms (Technical background in engineering, computer science or MIS a plus).</li> <li>Strong leadership, presentation, interpersonal communication (verbal and written) and organizational skills.</li> <li>Self-motivated; entrepreneurial spirit.</li> <li>Comfortable working in a fast paced dynamic environment.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Founder's Associate
description: Intro Die Bauindustrie verliert jährlich 1,6 Billionen USD durch Ineffizienzen. Einer der Hauptgründe: Dieselben Fehler wiederholen sich immer wieder , weil entscheidende Informationen noch immer in Papierdokumenten und unstrukturierten Dateien verborgen sind. Genau hier setzt alago an. Wir sind ein Team von elf Personen und entwickeln KI-gestütztes Projektmanagement für die Baubranche . Bereits heute vertrauen uns mehr als 15 Kunden . Unsere Vision ist es, Risiken in Bauprojekten frühzeitig sichtbar zu machen – damit Großprojekte nicht mehr Jahrzehnte dauern oder scheitern. Wir haben letztes Jahr eine Pre-Seed-Finanzierung von über 1 Mio. € von führenden VCs der Baubranche sowie einem der größten Projektentwickler Deutschlands abgeschlossen. 75 % der Infrastruktur, die im Jahr 2050 existieren wird, ist heute noch nicht gebaut. Tasks In dieser Rolle baust du die Maschine, während wir sie skalieren . Du sitzt im Zentrum der Firma, bekommst direkten Zugang zu Produkt, Kunden und Foundern – und trägst ab Tag eins echte Verantwortung. 🧱 Operational Backbone (≈ 1/3) Du sorgst dafür, dass die Firma rund läuft und sauber mitwächst: Hiring – Du unterstützt den gesamten Recruiting-Prozess: Stellenanzeigen, Sourcing, Pipeline-Pflege, Terminkoordination und Kandidaten-Kommunikation. Operations – Du hältst unsere internen Abläufe, Tools und Dokumentation in Ordnung und schließt die Lücken, die im Alltag auffallen. Datenschutz & Compliance – Du unterstützt bei Datenschutzthemen: Kundenanfragen und Fragebögen vorbereiten, Dokumente und Verzeichnisse aktuell halten, Fristen im Blick behalten. Produkt-Setups – Du richtest neue Kundenprojekte im Produkt ein, bereitest Projektdaten auf und stellst sicher, dass alles startklar ist. AI-Setup der Company – Du hilfst, unsere internen KI-Workflows aufzubauen und zu pflegen, damit jedes Team mit den besten Tools und Automatisierungen arbeitet. 🚤 Speedboats (≈ 2/3) Du übernimmst schnelle, eigenständige Projekte, die direkt auf Wachstum einzahlen – zum Beispiel: Interne Prozesse mit Notion, Zapier oder n8n automatisieren Go-to-Market-Experimente aufsetzen und neue Kundensegmente testen Kunden-Discovery vorbereiten und Erkenntnisse verdichten Bei Pricing-Fragen und strategischen Analysen zuarbeiten Diese Rolle passt zu jemandem, der unternehmerisch denkt, mit Unsicherheit gut umgehen kann und eine Firma an der Schnittstelle von KI und echter Welt mitbauen will. Requirements Rahmen Du bist eingeschriebene:r Student:in oder absolvierst ein Pflicht-/freiwilliges Praktikum – idealerweise für mindestens 4–6 Monate , Vollzeit Standort München oder Bereitschaft, für die Dauer des Praktikums von hier aus zu arbeiten Deutsch auf Muttersprach-Niveau und sicheres Englisch Wie du arbeitest Umsetzung & Ownership: Du bringst Dinge zu Ende, ohne dass jemand nachfassen muss. Was du übernimmst, landet nicht im Nirgendwo. Systems Thinker: Du siehst nicht die einzelne Aufgabe, sondern das System dahinter. Statt zehnmal dasselbe manuell zu machen, baust du beim zweiten Mal den Prozess, der es überflüssig macht — und dokumentierst ihn so, dass ihn auch die nächste Person versteht. AI-Fanatiker: Du nutzt KI nicht gelegentlich, sondern reflexhaft. Du hast dir selbst schon Agents, Automatisierungen oder kleine Tools gebaut (n8n, Zapier, Lovable, Claude Code o. Ä.), probierst neue Modelle und Tools aus, sobald sie rauskommen, und hast eine Meinung dazu, was taugt. Struktur im Chaos: Du schaffst Klarheit in unübersichtlichen Situationen – ob durch eine saubere Notion-Seite, einen organisierten Hiring-Funnel oder ein aufgeräumtes Produkt-Setup. Sorgfalt bei sensiblen Themen: Datenschutz und Dokumentation sind für dich kein lästiges Beiwerk – du arbeitest hier genau und zuverlässig. Persönlicher Hintergrund DISC-Profil: Du bist extrovertiert und findest eine gute Balance zwischen People- und Task-Fokus Persönliche Eigenschaften: Du bist leidenschaftlich, neugierig, wettbewerbsorientiert und lernbereit / gut coachbar Du bist deiner Leidenschaft gefolgt und hast dir in einem kompetitiven Umfeld (z. B. Projekte, Sport, Musik, Kunst o. Ä.) messbare Erfolge erarbeitet Idealerweise bist du über eine persönliche Empfehlung aus unserem AAA-Netzwerk (Founders, Team, Partner, VCs etc.) auf uns aufmerksam geworden Pluspunkte Du hast bereits erste Praxiserfahrung gesammelt – Praktikum, Werkstudentenjob, eigenes Projekt oder eine studentische Initiative Du hast schon in der Baubranche gearbeitet oder hast einen engen Bezug zu ihr Du hast bereits selbst KI-Automatisierungen oder kleine Tools gebaut (z. B. mit Lovable, n8n, Zapier) Du hast schon in einem schnell wachsenden Startup gearbeitet Wenn du dich nicht in jedem Punkt wiederfindest, aber überzeugt bist, dass du gut zu alago passt, bewirb dich trotzdem. Entscheidend sind dein Potenzial und deine Lernkurve. Warum alago? Die meisten Praktika sind Zuarbeit. Dieses hier ist eine Abkürzung : Du sitzt sechs Monate im Maschinenraum eines Startups, das gerade von elf auf dreißig Leute wächst — und nimmst mit, wofür andere Jahre brauchen. Was du danach kannst Du hast ein Hiring von A bis Z begleitet und weißt, wie man gute Leute findet, bewertet und gewinnt. Du hast interne Systeme selbst gebaut – Automatisierungen, KI-Workflows, Prozesse – und nicht nur bedient. Du hast gesehen, wie ein Produkt bei echten Kunden ankommt, was es kostet und warum Deals gewonnen oder verloren werden. Du kannst erklären, wie eine Firma von innen funktioniert: Finanzen, Recht, Datenschutz, Produkt, Vertrieb – keine Blackbox mehr. Du baust Glaubwürdigkeit auf, bevor deine Kommiliton:innen anfangen Am Ende hast du keine Liste von Aufgaben im Lebenslauf, sondern Ergebnisse mit deinem Namen dran : Prozesse, die laufen, Leute, die du mit eingestellt hast, Automatisierungen, die noch nach dir funktionieren. Genau das ist die Währung, mit der du danach verhandelst. Zwei Türen, die danach offen stehen Eigene Gründung – Du hast aus nächster Nähe gesehen, wie man eine Firma baut: Fundraising, erste Kunden, erste Hires, die Fehler inklusive. Du startest nicht bei null, sondern mit einem inneren Playbook — und mit Zugang zu den Foundern, Coaches und VCs, die dir das ehrlich spiegeln. Der Startup-Job, den man nicht ausgeschrieben bekommt – Wer bei uns liefert, bekommt eine echte Referenz und Türen ins Münchner Startup-Ökosystem geöffnet. Und wenn es für beide Seiten passt, reden wir am Ende über eine feste Rolle bei alago. Wie du dabei wächst Arbeite direkt mit den Foundern: Du bist Tag für Tag Seite an Seite mit Janick (Go-to-Market & Strategy) und Ann-Christin (Product & Domain) — kein Zwischenlayer, kein Praktikanten-Sonderprogramm. Feedback in kurzen Zyklen: Du bekommst gesagt, was gut läuft und was nicht — wöchentlich, nicht zum Abschlussgespräch. Zugang zu erfahrenen Coaches, Trainern und Mentor:innen sowie wöchentlichen Trainings- und Coaching-Sessions. Eine umfangreiche Bibliothek, aus der du dir von den glaubwürdigsten Menschen der Welt etwas abschauen kannst. Wir bauen für Skalierung – aber gerade ist es noch früh. Das bedeutet viel Eigenverantwortung, kurze Feedback-Zyklen und die Freiheit, dich in die Richtung zu entwickeln, die am besten zu deinen Stärken passt – ob Operations, Product, Growth oder eines Tages die eigene Gründung . Standort WERK1: Arbeiten in einem der aktivsten Innovations- und Startup-Hubs Münchens mit direktem Zugang zur Startup-Community. Vergütung: Faire Praktikumsvergütung. Closing 1. Schick uns deine Bewerbung Neben deinem Lebenslauf freuen wir uns über ein kurzes Beispiel, in dem du Verantwortung übernommen oder anderen weitergeholfen hast. 2. So bekommst du ein echtes Gefühl für die Arbeit, und wir sehen, wie du denkst und kommunizierst. 5. Entscheidung Du erhältst innerhalb von 24 Stunden Rückmeldung. title: Manager Service Operations & AI
description: Ben jij een ervaren IT Operations Manager die niet alleen een supportorganisatie kan aansturen, maar ook kansen ziet om dienstverlening slimmer en efficiënter te maken met AI? Dan hebben wij een interessante uitdaging voor je. Voor Fivespark, een ambitieuze Managed Service Provider in Amstelveen, zoeken wij een Manager Service Operations & AI. In deze veelzijdige functie combineer je operationeel leiderschap met procesverbetering, automatisering en de verdere ontwikkeling van een eigen AI-agent. Je krijgt de verantwoordelijkheid over een team van 12 supportprofessionals én speelt een belangrijke rol in de transformatie naar een steeds verder geautomatiseerde IT-dienstverlening. Over Fivespark Fivespark is een innovatieve Managed Service Provider die bedrijven en overheden ondersteunt met moderne IT-oplossingen. De organisatie werkt aan de Managed Service Provider van de toekomst, waarin automatisering, kunstmatige intelligentie en datagedreven processen een steeds grotere rol spelen. Een belangrijk onderdeel hiervan is Sparkle, een intern ontwikkelde AI-agent die nu al ondersteunt bij ticketregistratie, triage, klantvragen en routering. De ambitie is om Sparkle verder te ontwikkelen tot een volwaardige digitale collega die steeds meer operationele processen zelfstandig en betrouwbaar kan uitvoeren. De organisatie kenmerkt zich door korte lijnen, een informele werksfeer en veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief en verantwoordelijkheid. Wat ga je doen? Als Manager Service Operations & AI ben je verantwoordelijk voor de dagelijkse aansturing en verdere professionalisering van de tweedelijns supportorganisatie. Tegelijkertijd speel je een centrale rol in het ontwikkelen en implementeren van AI en automatisering. Je werkzaamheden bestaan uit vier belangrijke onderdelen. Leidinggeven aan de supportorganisatie Je geeft leiding aan een team van 12 tweedelijns supportmedewerkers. Je coacht en ontwikkelt medewerkers en zorgt voor duidelijke prioriteiten, structuur en samenwerking. Je bewaakt de kwaliteit, capaciteit, continuïteit en prestaties van de dienstverlening. Je signaleert knelpunten en vertaalt deze naar concrete verbeteracties. Doorontwikkelen van AI-agent Sparkle Je bent functioneel eigenaar van Sparkle en bepaalt mede de visie, roadmap en prioriteiten. Je vertaalt operationele uitdagingen naar praktische AI-toepassingen. Je zorgt ervoor dat Sparkle veilig, betrouwbaar en gebruiksvriendelijk functioneert. Je werkt samen met technische specialisten aan de verdere ontwikkeling van deze digitale collega. Processen verbeteren en automatiseren Je analyseert bestaande operationele processen en identificeert mogelijkheden voor automatisering. Je optimaliseert workflows, kennisbanken en werkinstructies. Je zorgt voor een goede samenwerking tussen medewerkers en AI. Je draagt bij aan de ambitie om minimaal 75% van de standaard operationele processen met AI te ondersteunen of volledig te automatiseren. Verandering begeleiden Je werkt samen met Operations, Software Development, Business Consultancy en externe partners. Je begeleidt medewerkers in de overgang naar een meer AI-gedreven manier van werken. Je creëert draagvlak, communiceert helder en zorgt ervoor dat veranderingen daadwerkelijk worden doorgevoerd. Wie zoeken wij? Wij zoeken een operationeel sterke manager die structuur weet aan te brengen, medewerkers kan motiveren en tegelijkertijd vooruitkijkt naar de mogelijkheden van nieuwe technologie. Je begrijpt hoe een IT-supportorganisatie werkt, weet hoe je processen beheersbaar en voorspelbaar maakt en krijgt energie van het continu verbeteren van de dienstverlening. Daarnaast beschik je over: Hbo- of wo-werk- en -denkniveau. Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring binnen Managed Services, ICT Operations of IT Service Management. Ervaring met het aansturing, coachen en ontwikkelen van operationele teams. Goede kennis van ITIL-processen en servicemanagement. Affiniteit met AI, automatisering en digitale innovatie. Sterke analytische en organisatorische vaardigheden. Het vermogen om technische mogelijkheden te vertalen naar concrete operationele verbeteringen. Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en ervaring met verandermanagement. Je hoeft geen AI-developer te zijn. We zoeken juist iemand die begrijpt hoe je AI en automatisering succesvol inzet binnen een operationele IT-organisatie en medewerkers hierin weet mee te nemen. Wat kun je verwachten? Je komt rechtstreeks in dienst bij onze opdrachtgever en krijgt een sleutelrol binnen een organisatie die volop investeert in de toekomst van IT-dienstverlening. Je kunt rekenen op: Een bruto maandsalaris van €4.487 tot €6.494, afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring. Een mobiliteitsbudget van €850 per maand, vrij in te zetten op de manier die bij jou past. Een fulltime dienstverband. Flexibele werkmogelijkheden en ruimte om hybride te werken. Veel zelfstandigheid en directe invloed op de ontwikkeling van de organisatie. Ruime mogelijkheden voor persoonlijke en professionele ontwikkeling. De kans om actief bij te dragen aan innovatieve AI- en automatiseringsprojecten. Een informele en professionele werkomgeving met korte lijnen. Een betrokken team van collega's dat samenwerkt aan verbetering en innovatie. Waarom is dit een interessante functie? Wat deze rol bijzonder maakt, is de combinatie van peoplemanagement, operationele verantwoordelijkheid en AI-innovatie. Je krijgt niet alleen de opdracht om een bestaande supportorganisatie goed te laten functioneren, maar ook om deze klaar te maken voor de toekomst. Daarbij krijg je de ruimte om processen structureel te verbeteren, nieuwe technologie toe te passen en daadwerkelijk invloed uit te oefenen op de manier waarop IT-dienstverlening wordt georganiseerd. Een mooie uitdaging voor een ervaren Service Delivery Manager, IT Operations Manager of Support Manager die toe is aan een volgende stap. Interesse? Wil jij leidinggeven aan een IT-supportorganisatie én een belangrijke rol spelen in de verdere ontwikkeling van AI binnen Managed Services? Dan komen wij graag met je in contact! title: Data Center Operations Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: Boston, MA | Dallas, TX | Salt Lake City, UT  (This role requires you to be onsite 5 days a week in one of our locations)</strong></p> <h1>About the Department</h1> <p>Infrastructure Operations builds and manages the data center infrastructure behind Cloudflare's global network. The organization brings together engineering, operations, hardware and logistics teams that plan, deploy, operate and maintain our footprint in hundreds of cities worldwide. In this role, you'll help extend that footprint with a new generation of data center sites across the United States.</p> <h1>About the Role</h1> <p>We're looking for Data Center Engineers to be the hands, eyes and judgment on the ground at our new sites. You'll work on-site every day at your home data center, helping bring it online and keeping its hardware healthy once it's in production.</p> <p>You'll rack, cable and replace equipment, troubleshoot servers and network gear well past a simple parts swap, and keep every asset accurately documented from the moment it arrives. You'll work alongside colocation staff, integrators and partner teams, and support other sites remotely when the team needs you. Experienced engineers will have room to act as the technical lead for their site, mentor others, and help set the standards the team uses everywhere.</p> <p>We're building these sites to run with less manual effort than traditional data centers. When something breaks, we expect you to fix it for good, not just for today, and to use AI and automation to make the fix stick, whether that means a better runbook, a script, or a change to how the team works.</p> <p>This role is hands-on at the physical layer: hardware, cabling, and Layer 1/Layer 2 connectivity. You'll use the command line to troubleshoot servers and Layer 2 network issues, but network configuration and server provisioning are owned by partner engineering teams.</p> <h1>What You'll Do</h1> <h2>Site Builds</h2> <ul> <li>Support integrated site builds: receive and inspect hardware, rack and stack equipment, and run and dress structured cabling to standard.</li> <li>Verify integrator and contractor work against build specifications, drive defects to resolution, and make sure sites are production-ready before handoff.</li> </ul> <h2>Break/Fix and Troubleshooting</h2> <ul> <li>Triage and troubleshoot server hardware using BMC/IPMI, hardware logs, diagnostics and firmware tools. Find the root cause instead of swapping parts until something works.</li> <li>Replace components and whole systems, including servers, switches and optics, safely and with minimal disruption.</li> <li>Troubleshoot Layer 1 and Layer 2 issues: console into network devices, read interface and link state from the command line, inspect and clean optics, check light levels, and test fiber with a light meter or OTDR.</li> </ul> <h2>On-Call and Incidents</h2> <ul> <li>Take part in an on-call rotation and respond on site to incidents affecting hardware at your data center.</li> <li>Document what happened and what you did, and contribute to root-cause analysis and follow-up actions.</li> </ul> <h2>AI, Automation and Continuous Improvement</h2> <ul> <li>Solve problems for good. When an issue repeats, find the underlying cause and change the process, runbook or tooling so it doesn't come back.</li> <li>Use AI tools as part of your daily work: to speed up troubleshooting, interpret hardware and network logs, draft and improve documentation and runbooks, and summarize incidents.</li> <li>Find repetitive manual work and remove it with scripting, automation or AI-assisted workflows, or turn it into clear requirements for tooling teams.</li> <li>Share what works so the rest of the team can adopt it across every site.</li> </ul> <h2>Documentation and DCIM</h2> <ul> <li>Keep DCIM records accurate in real time, including rack elevations, cabling, power and asset location, from receipt through decommissioning.</li> <li>Follow and improve runbooks and build standards so work is repeatable across sites.</li> </ul> <h2>Logistics and Hardware Lifecycle</h2> <ul> <li>Own receiving, shipping and spares inventory at your site, and process RMAs end to end.</li> <li>Perform on-site decommissioning: unracking, serial number verification and chain of custody through handoff for secure destruction.</li> </ul> <h2>Vendors, Partners and Compliance</h2> <ul> <li>Escort and supervise colocation remote-hands staff, contractors and integrators working at your site, and hold them to our quality and safety standards.</li> <li>Work directly with partner teams to coordinate access, maintenance and escalations for your site.</li> <li>Follow physical security, access control and compliance procedures without exception, and help produce accurate evidence for audits.</li> </ul> <h2>Supporting Other Sites</h2> <ul> <li>Support other sites remotely, for example by guiding remote hands or reviewing documentation, and travel occasionally to help with builds or surges.</li> </ul> <h1>Who You Are</h1> <p><strong>Careful and precise.</strong> Clean cabling, correct labels and accurate records matter to you. If it isn't documented, it isn't done.</p> <p><strong>Dependable on your own.</strong> You're often the only Cloudflare person on site. You work independently, communicate clearly with a remote team, and know when to escalate.</p> <p><strong>Security-minded.</strong> You understand that access rules and chain of custody exist for a reason, and you follow them every time.</p> <p><strong>A troubleshooter, not a parts swapper.</strong> You want to know why something failed, and you use logs, diagnostics and the command line to find out.</p> <p><strong>Someone who makes the team better.</strong> You share what you learn, help newer teammates get up to speed, and take ownership of your site's outcomes.</p> <p><strong>AI-fluent and automation-first.</strong> Your first instinct is to solve a problem for good, not work around it again. You reach for AI tools and automation to troubleshoot faster, document better and improve how the team works, and you check the output before you trust it.</p> <h1>Required Experience</h1> <ul> <li>Hands-on experience in data center, network or server hardware operations, including working independently on site.</li> <li>Experience racking, stacking and cabling servers and network equipment, and replacing whole systems and components.</li> <li>Solid working knowledge of structured cabling standards, fiber and copper, and optics.</li> <li>Hardware troubleshooting beyond parts swaps, including BMC/IPMI, hardware logs, diagnostics and firmware.</li> <li>Comfort with the Linux command line and with network device CLIs to troubleshoot Layer 1 and Layer 2 issues.</li> <li>Experience with fiber inspection, cleaning and testing, including light meters or OTDR.</li> <li>Regular, hands-on use of AI tools in your technical work, such as troubleshooting, log analysis or documentation, and examples of improving a process instead of repeating a workaround.</li> <li>Experience with asset tracking, DCIM or inventory systems, and with receiving, shipping and RMA processes.</li> <li>Experience working in colocation facilities and with third-party vendors or contractors.</li> <li>Willingness to take part in an on-call rotation and respond on site.</li> <li>Clear written and verbal communication, including documenting work and updating tickets.</li> <li>A valid driver's license, reliable transportation, and proximity to your assigned data center.</li> <li>Ability to travel occasionally to other sites.</li> </ul> <h1>Preferred Qualifications</h1> <ul> <li>Experience as a technical lead or primary on-site contact for a data center, including leading on-site incident response.</li> <li>Experience mentoring or training other technicians or engineers.</li> <li>Experience writing runbooks, build standards or checklists used across multiple sites.</li> <li>Experience supporting or leading new data center builds or integrated rack deployments.</li> <li>Scripting experience (for example Bash or Python), or experience building automation or AI-assisted workflows that reduced manual work.</li> <li>Certifications such as CompTIA A+, Network+ or Linux+, CCNA, BICSI, or data center certifications (for example CDCP or CDCTP).</li> <li>Experience with DCIM and source-of-truth tooling such as NetBox or Nlyte, and Jira-based workflows.</li> <li>Experience at a hyperscaler, cloud provider, major CDN or similarly large infrastructure operator.</li> <li>Experience with ITAD and secure destruction processes.</li> </ul> <p>We also consider candidates earlier in their careers who bring strong fundamentals and a drive to learn.</p> <h1>Physical Requirements</h1> <ul> <li>Lift and move equipment up to 50 lbs, and handle heavier equipment with a team or lift assist.</li> <li>Stand, walk, bend, kneel and work in tight or elevated spaces for extended periods.</li> <li>Work in loud, cold, and tightly controlled data center environments.</li> <li>Use ladders, lifts and carts safely.</li> </ul> <p><em>These are essential functions of the role. Reasonable accommodations are available for qualified individuals with disabilities.</em></p

It runs automated checks: tests, linting, and security and misconfiguration scans. Propose. It opens a traceable Pull Request for human review and approval. Design the guardrails that make this safe: least-privilege access, approval steps, and predictable, repeatable runs. title: Founding Strategy & Operations
description: Alassio recherche son (sa) prochain(e) Founding Strategy & Operations ! Missions 🏗️ Alassio en quelques mots En France, la paie et le social comptent parmi les fonctions les plus réglementées qui soient. Entre inflation réglementaire et évolutions légales et conventionnelles incessantes, la conformité est devenue un véritable fardeau pour les cabinets de paie et les services RH : ce fardeau les empêche de se consacrer à ce qui compte vraiment, le conseil et l'accompagnement des salariés, qui en subissent donc eux aussi le poids ; c'est aussi l'un des métiers où l'attrition est la plus forte en France, notamment parce que 60 % du temps des gestionnaires de paie est encore consacré à de la saisie ou à de la relecture manuelle. Pourtant, des solutions technologiques majeures existent : l'IA permet en particulier d'automatiser une très grande partie des tâches les plus pénibles et de valoriser les données sociales. Mais le secteur reste largement à l'écart de cette révolution, et le problème n'est pas seulement réglementaire : le marché était verrouillé par des éditeurs historiques vieillissants, difficiles à quitter faute d'alternative crédible et de moyens pour migrer efficacement. Là aussi, l'IA fait voler ces barrières en éclats et ouvre la voie à une vague d'innovation attendue depuis des décennies. C'est pour y répondre qu'Alassio construit la plateforme de paie et de gestion RH moderne qui manquait à ce marché , au service des cabinets et de leurs clients TPE/PME. Notre ambition est de développer en un temps record : une plateforme collaborative et ouverte , qui s'intègre nativement aux outils des cabinets et de leurs clients, respecte leurs habitudes de travail et fluidifie les échanges entre gestionnaires de paie et entreprises ; l'automatisation de la tenue administrative : collecte des données, paramétrage des évolutions légales et des règles propres à chaque entreprise, génération automatique des rapports et formulaires, traçabilité juridique dynamique et en temps réel, etc. ; la valorisation des données de paie et sociales , pour offrir un conseil social à 360° et enfin répondre efficacement à l'ensemble des attentes des salariés, qui se sont de surcroît largement amplifiées depuis le Covid : gestion contractuelle, pilotage de la masse salariale, avantages salariés, fidélisation des talents, mutuelle… L'objectif : devenir le « People OS » sur lequel les cabinets et leurs clients TPE/PME s'appuient pour gérer l'intégralité de leurs problématiques paie et RH. 🚀 Tes responsabilités Ta mission est de concevoir et faire vivre les systèmes de fonctionnement d'Alassio . Concrètement, tu identifies partout dans l'entreprise ce qui empêche les équipes de travailler à l'échelle (un process défaillant ou absent, un passage de relais flou, une information introuvable, une tâche répétitive que personne n'a pris le temps d'automatiser) et tu le résous de bout en bout : un diagnostic précis, puis un cahier des charges documenté et actionnable, puis l'accompagnement de sa mise en œuvre jusqu'à son adoption effective par les équipes. Une solution que personne n'utilise n'est pas une solution. Tes leviers sont aussi bien managériaux (formalisme interne, rituels, répartition des responsabilités) que produit et techniques (modèle de données, outillage, automatisation des flux de travail), avec un parti pris constant : « Just build it ». Tu mettras en place, avec les équipes concernées, des solutions actionnables et des systèmes qui tournent. 🧭 Tes premiers chantiers Pour te donner une idée concrète, voici le type de chantiers que tu pourrais mener dans tes six premiers mois : Bâtir un réseau national de formateurs et d'intégrateurs certifiés , pour permettre aux cabinets de se former partout en France sans saturer nos équipes à chaque pic de déploiement : modèle économique et tarification, maillage du territoire avec les Sales, parcours de certification et suivi qualité avec l'équipe DnA (Déploiement & Accompagnement), cadre contractuel, et circuit de remontée des demandes des cabinets vers le support et le Product. En bref, tu contribueras à mettre sur pied une place de marché d'intégrateurs et de formateurs Alassio. Fluidifier le parcours d'un cabinet, de la signature à la production : formaliser les passages de relais entre les squads Sales, DnA, Métier & Juridique et Tech (ce qui est transmis, dans quel outil, dans quel délai, et qui tranche en cas de blocage). Ce travail se traduit par la mise en place de workflows au sein de Bedrock, notre OS interne : il rend l'ensemble du contexte d'Alassio interrogeable et permet de transformer quasi instantanément une solution que tu as formalisée en gain concret pour toute l'équipe. Améliorer en profondeur, en coordination étroite avec l'AI Engineer, notre OS Bedrock pour en faire le réflexe par défaut de toutes les équipes : identifier les cas d'usage transverses à plus fort impact, structurer le contexte métier qui alimente l'OS, travailler sur l'hébergement et la dimension collaborative, mettre en place des workflows d'agents déclenchés par événement, tenir à jour le catalogue des commandes, et mettre en place le suivi qui mesure la performance et l'adoption. description: Alassio recherche son (sa) prochain(e) Senior Software Engineer ! Nous nous appuyons pour cela sur : L'automatisation par l'IA pour simplifier la gestion de la paie et le suivi réglementaire : c'est dans la transformation des usages métiers que l'IA a le plus de potentiel, et le marché de la paie et du social, largement ignoré depuis plus d'une décennie, est un terrain d'innovation immense. Une plateforme collaborative et ouverte , connectée à l'ensemble des outils métiers des cabinets, qui fluidifie les échanges entre les gestionnaires de paie et leurs clients. Une gestion avancée des données pour offrir à plus long terme un conseil social à 360° sur l'ensemble des problématiques paie et social : budgétisation de la masse salariale, construction intelligente des grilles salariales, gestion contractuelle avancée, avantages salariés, mutuelle, etc. L'objectif : développer le « Pennylane de la paie », une plateforme centrale de gestion paie et social pour les cabinets comptables et leurs clients TPE/PME. Chez Alassio, tu t'attaqueras à un défi de taille, qui te permettra d'évoluer comme nulle part ailleurs : Construire un logiciel particulièrement complexe , par son volet réglementaire, mais surtout par ses logiques profondes, qui doivent permettre de gérer la paie de façon exhaustive. C'est un logiciel métier dense, avec un impact immédiat sur la vie de ses utilisateurs (des dizaines de milliers de gestionnaires de paie, des centaines de milliers d'entreprises clientes), sur une fonction parmi les plus sensibles pour les TPE/PME françaises. Faire partie d'une équipe Tech resserrée , où chacun porte un ou plusieurs de nos chantiers techniques structurants et pose les fondations de notre plateforme métier. Nos Founding Engineers ont vocation à évoluer à terme vers des responsabilités de direction , selon leur appétence pour le management. 💻 Stack technique Une stack efficace et robuste, adaptée pour construire un logiciel métier et livrer des fonctionnalités à un rythme industriel. Tout est pensé en interne pour favoriser la vélocité technique : chez Alassio, les problématiques managériales ne remplaceront jamais les problématiques techniques et intellectuelles . Nous faisons le choix d'une équipe resserrée au départ, car l'histoire du marché montre qu'une petite équipe peut produire plus, mieux et plus vite que des géants. 💸 Rémunération Nous valorisons un engagement à la hauteur des ambitions d'Alassio et proposons une rémunération fixe comprise entre 80 et 120 K€ , selon l'expérience et le niveau de responsabilité. description: About HIVED 📦 At HIVED, we’re steamrolling forward as one of Europe’s fastest growing startups, and our momentum shows no signs of slowing. Based in London, we are a climate and logistics start-up building the first sustainable parcel delivery network at scale, powered by a 100% electric fleet. In an ever-growing industry where unreliable service has long been the norm, HIVED has been built from the ground-up to meet the demands of modern consumers and disrupt parcel delivery. A tech company at heart, our talent and technology is laser-focused on delivering the best possible delivery experience for end-customers and meeting the needs of our retail partners. From our drivers to our data engineers, we are constantly working to improve this customer experience that makes us deliver better. We’re passionate about driving innovation and redefining the future of delivery. Role Overview 📝 At HIVED, as an Operations Coordinator, you are the unique point of contact with drivers. Your role is integral to ensuring HIVED maintains drivers at the centre of our operation while maintaining high delivery performance and quality. This is an on-site role embedded in day-to-day operations. Your shift pattern will be 4 days on, 3 days off, which will require you to work one day on the weekend. Our Operations team is organised into roles at different levels: this is a level 2 role where you will report into the Operations Manager. What you’ll be doing 🚀 Manage the day-to-day operations of an assigned driver team. Champion initiatives that foster a positive driver experience and promote retention. Overseeing of all aspects of assigned driver team, serving as the primary point of contact for driver inquiries and support at HIVED. Ensure driver compliance with HIVED's requirements and expectations. Partner with stakeholders to ensure driver excellence via check-ins and ride-alongs. What you’ll be accountable for 🤝 Achieving daily business Key Performance Indicators (KPIs). Comprehensive driver support, including scheduling, process implementation, and addressing on-the-road queries. What we’re looking for 🔎 We are seeking an engaging and approachable (Driver) Operations Coordinator who excels at building and maintaining positive relationships with drivers and stakeholders, with strong verbal and written communication skills and demonstrated stakeholder management abilities. 1-3 years of related working experience with logistics/last-mile preference. Possesses a hands-on approach to managing and developing team members. Proven ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment. Capable of rapid decision-making and efficient problem resolution. Ability to leverage available resources effectively and efficiently. Experience leveraging data for effective decision-making. Demonstrates exceptional resilience and professionalism when confronted with difficult situations, maintaining a positive and productive attitude. Valid UK driving license required. How we reward our team 🎁 Competitive market-related salary. Including the opportunity to work overtime when required. 25 days of holiday allowance plus public holidays. If you're on on 4 days on, 3 days off shift pattern, you are entitled to the equivalent of 20 days paid holiday plus public holidays 1 Birthday Day Off + 2 Tenure-Based Additional Days Off Subsidised Private Medical Insurance including dental, vision & mental health therapy Team lunch provided once a week Quarterly team socials and annual sports day (HIVED Olympics) Enhanced maternity/paternity/adoption policy as day 1 right MacBook Air or Windows Laptop (depending on your preference) Cycle to work scheme Our Values 😊 We Are Kind - We leave our egos at the door and aren't afraid to make difficult decisions. We must never confuse kindness with being "nice" - kindness requires us to be fair, consistent and work together to move HIVED forward. 🤝 We Are Tenacious - We fight every day to keep the customer promise, for every parcel entrusted to us. No matter how hard it gets or whatever stands in our way, we are relentless in our pursuit of excellence. 💡 We Are Curious - We never settle, constantly challenge convention and are never afraid to ask why. We believe there is always more to learn, always a better way, and that we're always only just getting started. 💰 We Are Resourceful - Resources are scarce and our business depends on our ability to use resources wisely. Waste is the enemy. We strive to do more with less, be more efficient and make the most of what we have. 🔍 Want to learn more? En tant que Head of Customer Engineering, vous pilotez une organisation de 50 personnes répartie en quatre équipes couvrant l'implémentation technique, la migration des données, le support engineering et le succès technique. Votre rôle est de définir la direction stratégique de la fonction, de faire grandir vos managers et d'accompagner l'organisation dans une période de transformation ambitieuse. Vous créez les conditions pour que les équipes performent avec clarté et confiance, en connectant les enjeux techniques aux priorités client et business. Vos responsabilités incluent, mais ne sont pas limitées à : Définir et communiquer la vision, les priorités et le modèle opérationnel du Customer Engineering. Piloter et développer les managers, clarifier les responsabilités et construire une culture managériale saine. Accompagner l'organisation dans sa transformation en apportant stabilité, contexte et cap dans les périodes de changement. Renforcer la collaboration entre le Customer Engineering et les équipes Sales, Account Management, Support, Tech et Produit. Garantir que l'implémentation technique, la migration des données, le support engineering et le succès technique génèrent une valeur mesurable pour les clients et le business. Améliorer la scalabilité via des modèles de service clairs, la planification des capacités, des standards de qualité, des outils, l'automatisation et une utilisation responsable de l'IA. Les qualités attendues en tant que Head of Customer Engineering Avant de poursuivre votre lecture, si vous n'avez pas le profil exact décrit ci-dessous, mais que vous pensez que cette description de poste correspond à vos compétences et à vos aspirations, nous vous encourageons tout de même à postuler. Vous pourrez être le prochain membre de notre équipe si vous : Justifiez d'une expérience significative à la tête d'une organisation technique orientée client (customer facing) d'environ 40 personnes ou plus, avec management de managers. Avez un solide bilan en matière de transformation organisationnelle et de conduite du changement. Faites preuve d'un style de leadership calme, empathique et crédible, avec la capacité de rassurer les équipes et de construire la confiance dans les périodes de changement. Disposez d'excellentes compétences en communication, notamment pour expliquer clairement des décisions complexes et influencer des parties prenantes senior. Maîtrisez le français et l'anglais à un niveau professionnel (C1 minimum). Ce serait fantastique si : Vous disposez d'une profondeur technique suffisante pour challenger les hypothèses, comprendre les architectures clients et prendre des décisions éclairées sur les intégrations, les API et la gestion des données. Vous avez déjà construit des modèles opérationnels scalables ou des organisations de services techniques orientées client. Vous adoptez une approche fondée sur les données pour la priorisation, la planification des capacités et l'amélioration continue.
