title: Senior AI Engineer - Search & Recommendation - Patient Team (x/f/m)
description: Join our mission, join Doctolib! We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to join the Patient team in Paris. The Patient domain sits at the heart of Doctolib's mission: ensuring everyone has better access to the care they need, receives better care from health professionals, and can actively prevent health problems to improve their wellbeing. You’ll design the search and recommendation engines behind our health companion, helping 100M patients across Europe instantly navigate to the exact care they need while delivering trusted, curated insights at every step. The retrieval and recommendation architecture you own will directly shape how relevant, fast, and trustworthy that experience is for every one of them. Your responsibilities include but are not limited to: Design and build the production search & recommendation architecture: full retrieval, ranking, reranking pipeline with standard and off-the-shelf components (vector search, semantic retrieval, LLM/managed rerankers). Establish strong baselines first (prompts, RAG, model selection) before reaching for custom ML. Build evaluation and observability into every stage, with offline and online evaluation. Set up the data/event feedback loops that drive iteration and feed deeper ML later. Improve search relevance and ranking on Patient facing products , raising result quality Own production quality: latency reliability, monitoring, and maintainability. Partner with ML Engineers and collaborate closely with PMs and SWEs to define, build, and ship AI-powered features that deliver measurable value to users and the business. Who you are Before you read on: if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply. You could be our next team mate if you have: Production deployment : ability to ship algorithms to production (ECS-based service on AWS) Strong analytical mindset: r esult-oriented, patient-first approach Significant experience as a Software or/and AI engineer shipping search or recommendation systems to production. Hands-on experience building end-to-end retrieval: ranking, reranking pipelines and familiar with nDCG, MAP, Recall@k, MRR AI-engineering proficiency : turning foundation models and off-the-shelf components into production systems: embeddings & vector search, semantic retrieval, RAG, LLM-based or managed rerankers (e.g. Vertex AI). You can succeed without training a model from scratch Architecture-first approach : you build the system, baselines, evals, and feedback loops with standard tooling before reaching for custom ML, and know when to partner with ML Engineers to break a ceiling Evaluation & observability built into every stage (retrieval, ranker, reranker) — offline and online eval, A/B testing, position-bias handling, monitoring Production deployment — ability to ship reliable, low-latency services to production (hundreds-of-ms SLAs), with care for data quality and long-term maintainability Now, it would be fantastic if you: Experience at a B2C marketplace (e-commerce, hospitality, travel) Additional ML methodologies: pattern mining, recommendation systems, experimentation, or causal inference Have experience with search engines or information retrieval concepts Have exposure to learning-to-rank or feature engineering (for breaking ceilings later, alongside ML Engineers) Have experience in a healthcare or other regulated domain (GDPR / HDS) Life at Doctolib Tech Our solutions are built on a single, fully cloud-native platform that supports web and mobile app interfaces, multiple languages, and is adapted to country and healthcare specialty requirements. Our stack is composed of Rails, TypeScript, Java, Python, Kotlin, Swift, and React Native. We leverage AI ethically across our products to empower patients and health professionals. Discover our AI vision here . We also invest in open, applied AI research. For example, our DoctoBERT project introduces open-source medical language models trained for French clinical text, with applications in named entity recognition, classification, and retrieval. Read the DoctoBERT practical guide to learn more about how we bring deep AI research into practical healthcare applications. Want to learn more about our tech culture and environment? Visit the Doctolib Tech site . What we offer Free comprehensive health insurance (basic package) for you and your children 25 days of paid vacation per year, plus up to 14 days of RTT Free mental health and coaching services through our partner Moka.care Work from abroad for up to 10 days per year thanks to our flexibility days policy Lunch vouchers (Swile card) worth €8.50 per working day, with €4.50 covered by Doctolib A subsidy from the work council to refund part of the membership to a sport club or a creative class 50% reimbursement of your public transport subscription Enrollment in Doctolib's long-term employee value sharing plan called DoctoGrowth ParentCare Program: Enjoy full salary coverage (100%) during your first month of birth leave, and 75% during the second, covered by Doctolib For caregivers and workers with disabilities, a package including an adaptation of the remote policy, extra days off for medical reasons, and psychological support The interview process A first interview with a member of the Talent Acquisition team A coding interview An agentics system design A behavioural interview Reference check Job details Permanent position Full Time Workplace: Levallois Start date : As soon as possible At Doctolib, we are committed to improving access to healthcare for everyone. This translates into our recruitment process. We evaluate candidates based solely on qualifications and motivation, without any form of discrimination. The more diverse ideas are heard, the more our product will truly improve healthcare for all. title: Customer Support / Support Technique B2B – Nantes (x/f/m)
description: Rejoignez l’équipe Product Support de Doctolib à Nantes Vous aimez aider les utilisateurs, comprendre leurs problématiques et trouver des solutions ? Rejoignez l’équipe Customer Support de Doctolib à Nantes et accompagnez les professionnels de santé dans l’utilisation de nos solutions logicielles. En tant que Customer Support, vous êtes leur premier point de contact lorsqu’ils rencontrent une question ou une difficulté. Vous analysez leur situation, les accompagnez dans la résolution de leur problème et leur apportez une réponse claire, efficace et pédagogique. Vous n’avez pas besoin d’être expert du secteur de la santé : nous vous formons à nos produits. Ce qui compte pour nous, c’est votre goût pour la relation client, votre curiosité pour les outils numériques et votre capacité à résoudre des problèmes. Vos missions Au quotidien, vous serez amené à : Répondre aux appels et aux emails des professionnels de santé. Les accompagner dans l’utilisation de nos solutions et répondre à leurs questions techniques. Diagnostiquer les problèmes rencontrés sur nos produits : agenda, dossier patient, téléconsultation, e-prescription, suivi de patientèle, etc. Identifier l’origine des difficultés et proposer des solutions adaptées. Guider les utilisateurs pas à pas, avec pédagogie et clarté. Assurer le suivi des demandes jusqu’à leur résolution. Coordonner les situations nécessitant l’intervention d’équipes spécialisées. Développer progressivement une expertise sur les produits Doctolib. Contribuer à l’amélioration continue de nos réponses, outils et procédures. Garantir une expérience client de qualité à chaque interaction. Le profil que nous recherchons Vous pourriez réussir dans ce rôle si : Vous avez une première expérience en relation client, assistance utilisateurs, support ou environnement à flux. Vous aimez comprendre un problème avant de proposer une solution. Vous êtes à l’aise avec les outils informatiques et apprenez rapidement. Vous possédez une bonne capacité d’analyse et faites preuve de rigueur. Vous savez expliquer simplement une solution à une personne qui n’est pas technique. Vous êtes à l’aise à l’oral comme à l’écrit. Vous disposez d’un excellent relationnel et d’une bonne capacité d’écoute. Vous savez rester calme, structuré et empathique dans une situation complexe. Vous avez envie d’apprendre et de développer votre expertise produit. Une expérience en support logiciel, SaaS, helpdesk, assistance utilisateurs, télécoms, banque-assurance ou service client technique est un plus, mais n’est pas indispensable. Votre formation initiale importe moins que votre potentiel, votre curiosité et votre envie d’aider les utilisateurs. Ce que nous vous proposons Une formation complète à nos produits et à notre métier via la Doctolib Academy. Des possibilités d’évolution vers des fonctions d’expertise, de qualité, de formation ou de management. Des bureaux situés sur l’Île de Nantes. Un restaurant d’entreprise. Des événements et activités d’équipe. Une mutuelle prise en charge à 100 % par Doctolib. Un programme de parental care. Deux jours de volontariat par an dans le cadre des Solidarity Days. Un programme de bien-être et de santé mentale avec Moka.care. Une carte déjeuner Swile. Une politique de travail hybride. Dix jours de travail possibles par an depuis un autre pays de l’Union européenne ou le Royaume-Uni. Une participation aux transports en commun. Une subvention pour l’achat d’un vélo. Une subvention du comité d’entreprise pour certaines activités sportives ou de loisirs. Une aide au déménagement en cas de mobilité internationale. title: Product Design Director - Patient (x/f/m)
description: Product Design Director - Patient (x/f/m) The opportunity Doctolib is a mission-driven healthcare technology company, founded in Paris in 2013. Today, nearly 3,000 people work across Europe to transform the way healthcare is delivered and experienced. More than 500,000 healthcare professionals use Doctolib’s solutions, and the patient app is used by approximately 90 million people across Europe. For patients, Doctolib began as a simple way to find a healthcare professional and book an appointment. We are now building something much more ambitious: an AI-powered Health Companion that helps people navigate care, understand their health and take the right next step throughout their health journey. This means moving beyond a primarily transactional product towards an experience that supports patients before, during and after care, through access to care, health information, patient data, messaging, recommendations, care plans and AI-powered assistance. We are looking for a Product Design Director to help define what this next generation of patient experience should look and feel like. What you will build and lead As Product Design Director, Patient , you will own the design vision and quality bar for Doctolib’s patient experience. You will report to our VP Design and work closely with the Product, Engineering, Medical, Data and Business leadership teams. Your scope will cover the full patient journey, including: access to care, search and booking; patient messaging and teleconsultation; the Patient Health Record and patient context; the app homepage and daily health experience; health content and prevention; recommendations, reminders and care plans; new patient services and subscription experiences; conversational and AI-powered experiences. The current team includes six Senior Product Designers and one Senior Content Designer . You will lead, coach and develop this team while shaping the organisation and operating model needed to support the next phase of the Patient product. Your mandate You will: Define and drive the design vision for the Patient stream, from a high-traffic booking experience to a trusted Health Companion used throughout the health journey. Bridge two equally important challenges: continuing to improve the core access-to-care experience while creating new reasons for patients to return beyond booking. Raise the quality bar for product design, interaction design and content across the patient experience. Stay close enough to the product and the craft to make high-quality design decisions, not only set direction from a distance. Shape AI-native experiences that are clear, useful and trustworthy, including recommendations, conversational interfaces and next-best actions. Establish strong design principles for transparency, explainability, uncertainty, user control and safe escalation in a healthcare context. Build a high-performing design organisation, including hiring, coaching, talent development and second-line leadership. Create effective ways of working across Design, Product, Engineering, Medical, Data and Business. Help scale a coherent experience across countries, languages and different healthcare contexts. Connect design decisions to user behaviour, product outcomes and business impact. What success looks like In your first year, you will have: established a clear and compelling design vision for the Patient stream; raised the quality bar across both core access-to-care journeys and newer Health Companion experiences; helped define a coherent interaction model for AI-powered patient experiences; strengthened collaboration between Design, Product, Engineering and Medical; developed a clear operating model and growth plan for the Patient Design organisation; helped Doctolib increase the value and relevance of the patient experience beyond appointment booking. What we are looking for You are likely to bring: Significant experience leading Product Design, 10+ years in product design including 3+ years in people leadership.. Experience in a consumer product organisation, ideally one used by millions of people. A track record of designing and scaling products across multiple markets, with an understanding of localisation, cultural differences and the balance between global consistency and local relevance. Experience managing at least five Product Designers, ideally a larger organisation including senior individual contributors and managers. Strong product design craft and creative judgement. You can recognise excellent work, make difficult quality trade-offs and stay close enough to the details to raise the standard of the product. Experience connecting design choices to measurable outcomes such as adoption, conversion, engagement, retention, satisfaction or user behaviour. A strong and practical understanding of AI-native product experiences. You have thought deeply about how AI changes interaction design, user expectations, trust, transparency and control. Experience designing with uncertainty, recommendations, personalisation or conversational interfaces is highly relevant. The ability to operate across complex products and stakeholders, while maintaining clarity and momentum. A concise and compelling communication style. You can articulate a clear point of view, align senior stakeholders and inspire teams to move in a new direction. Experience in healthcare or another regulated, trust-sensitive environment is valuable, but healthcare experience is not required. What matters is your respect for domain expertise and your ability to design responsibly in high-stakes contexts. Fluency in English. French or German would be a strong plus. A working style aligned with the Doctolib Playbook: User First, Medical Expertise, Forefront of Innovation, Bold, Drive, Passion, Humility. Why Doctolib, why now? Doctolib gives you the opportunity to work on a consumer product with significant reach, strong European scale and a mission that matters. The patient product already has a large and engaged audience. The next challenge is to make the experience more useful, more contextual and more present in people’s everyday health journeys. You will join at a defining moment: Doctolib is moving from appointment booking towards continuous health support. AI is becoming a core part of the product experience, not an isolated feature. The Patient Design organisation is being strengthened and reshaped. The product must work across multiple European countries, languages and healthcare systems. The design foundations for the next chapter are still being built. This is an opportunity to shape a new category at the intersection of consumer product design, healthcare and AI , and to define how people will discover, understand and manage their health in the future. Doctolib is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams build better products and improve healthcare for more people. We welcome applications regardless of gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity, disability or place of origin. You will work in a feature team developing the Patient Health Record, health trackers, patient account and online identity, contributing directly to the quality of the medical support we provide to both patients and practitioners. A patient record is built from four channels: what patients enter themselves, what they share when preparing a consultation, what we retrieve from health professionals' systems, and what they connect from third-party sources such as Apple Health, Google Health Connect and national health record services. Three of those channels belong to teams you will not manage. You will own the outcome across all four, the most leveraged place to sit in a health platform, and only reachable through other people. You will also work inside a hard regulatory perimeter: health data, GDPR, consent by design. What you'll do Your responsibilities include but are not limited to: Own the end-to-end patient data collection programme across every channel a patient record is built from, and be accountable for the result across all four Define what a useful record actually means for the teams that depend on it, make that definition measurable, and instrument it rather than inheriting a dashboard Partner with the channel-owning teams inside and outside the group: set the inter-team contracts, agree how each channel contributes, and arbitrate collection priorities Own record quality and freshness rather than volume, alongside health data storage consent, patient account and online identity Ship the layers that serve this data to the rest of the product: the patient feature store, the patient context service and the Patient Health Record feature Lead the Patient Profile team's roadmap and delivery, from PHR (patient health record) and trackers through to the feature store and context service Who you are Before you read on: if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply. You'll be a great fit if you: You have owned a coverage, completeness or data quality metric as your primary objective, and can say what it went from, to what, and over how long You have worked at millions-of-records scale You have moved that metric through teams that did not report to you, setting interfaces, contracts and SLAs with partner teams You have shipped under a hard regulatory or consent constraint, in health, finance or identity, with privacy and consent by design You have real technical depth: you have owned a data platform component as a product, a feature store, a context or profile service, or an identity layer. title: Platform Security Engineer (x/f/m)
description: Set a new pulse for healthcare! We are looking for a Platform Security Engineer to join the Security team at Doctolib. Your mission will be to protect sensitive healthcare data while enabling rapid, secure innovation. You will be responsible for securing Doctolib's cloud infrastructure and application ecosystem, combining multi-cloud security expertise with hands-on platform engineering — contributing directly to the safety of millions of patients and care teams who rely on our platform every day. Working in the tech team at Doctolib means building innovative products and features to improve the daily lives of care teams and patients. What you'll do Your responsibilities include but are not limited to: Own a platform security workstream end to end, from architecture to enforcement: scope it with your tech lead, design the control, roll it out progressively (report-only, then enforce), handle exceptions, and see it through to full coverage. Typical examples: hardening IAM across our AWS accounts, tightening cluster admission policies, or closing a class of misconfiguration for good. Ship every change as code: Terraform and GitHub pull requests, peer-reviewed and always reversible. No console clicking, no undocumented state. Harden our cloud and infrastructure baseline and keep it hardened: IAM permissions and access reviews, secrets management, network and cluster guardrails, CI/CD and supply chain controls — building the guardrails and driving remediation of what they surface with platform and engineering teams, turning recurring findings into automation rather than tickets. Investigate and improve: lead incident investigations on the platform perimeter end to end, and continuously improve detection rules and response playbooks in our Elastic SIEM. Work in the open: write clear technical notes, drive adoption of your changes with the engineering teams they affect, and grow through code review and pairing with the rest of the team. Who you are Before you read on: if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply. You'll be a great fit if you: Have 1 to 3 years of hands-on experience in security engineering, security operations, SRE, infrastructure or platform engineering, including some exposure to a cloud environment (AWS, GCP or Azure) in production — an internship or apprenticeship in one of those roles counts. Work daily with infrastructure as code and GitHub: you have written and shipped your own Terraform through reviewed pull requests, and you are comfortable operating and debugging workloads on Kubernetes. Use AI coding assistants (Claude or equivalent) as a normal part of how you work. Have carried at least one project through to production — security or not — and stayed with it past the first deployment until it was actually adopted. Have solid fundamentals: Linux, networking, cloud, Kubernetes and development/scripting, a pragmatic mindset, the ability to make decisions under uncertainty and follow through, and strong written communication skills — you can carry a proposal from draft to cross-team adoption. Are fluent in English (working language in writing); daily team conversations happen mostly in French, so being a French speaker or willing to learn is a strong plus. It would be fantastic if you: Have worked with a SIEM (Elastic, Splunk, or equivalent), writing and tuning your own queries. Have done detection engineering, incident response, threat hunting, or CTFs. Can point to public write-ups, open-source contributions, or a home lab. Have prior experience in a regulated industry (healthcare, fintech, or public sector). Our stack is composed of Rails, TypeScript, Java, Python, Kotlin, Swift, and React Native. We leverage AI ethically across our products to empower patients and health professionals. title: AI Researcher - Pre-training (f/m/d)
description: Our Mission Aleph Alpha is one of the few companies in Europe doing serious foundation model pre-training like our recently released Kolibri-1 model . Our customers - in finance, manufacturing, public administration - need models that understand German, meet European regulatory requirements, and work reliably in high-stakes settings. We're building that in Heidelberg. We are hiring an AI Researcher (f/m/d) to join our Pre-training team and help advance the architecture and training of our next generation of foundation models. If you are excited about how large models learn, want to run experiments that feed directly into production training runs, and want hands-on time on large-scale clusters (thousands of NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs), we would love to hear from you. Team Culture We foster a culture built on ownership, autonomy, and empowerment. Teams and individual contributors are trusted to take responsibility for their work and drive meaningful impact. We maintain a flat organizational structure with efficient, supportive management that enables quick decision-making, open communication, and a strong sense of shared purpose. We collaborate closely on complex technical problems, working in pairs or using mob programming to resolve challenging issues. New team members learn through real work: from your first weeks you will pair with experienced researchers on live problems, and take on more ownership as you grow into it. About the Role As an AI Researcher in Pre-training (f/m/d) , you will work on the technical levers that determine the success of our next-generation models: architecture, optimization, stability, and scaling. Working at the intersection of research and engineering, you will learn to translate mathematical reasoning and empirical observations into principled training decisions, from small-scale proxy experiments to multi-thousand-GPU runs. You will start with well-scoped problems alongside senior researchers and progressively take ownership of larger parts of the training recipe. We are looking for someone with strong fundamentals, sharp experimental instincts, exceptional skills, and the drive to go deep fast. You learn as much from a failed run as from a paper, you write code others can build on, and you want to become an expert in large-scale pre-training. Your Responsibilities Recipe & Architecture Experiments: Design and run ablations on core elements of the training recipe (optimizers, schedules, initialization), and implement PyTorch-based architectural changes. Evaluate their effect on convergence, stability, and training efficiency. Scaling Experiments: Run and analyze small-scale proxy experiments, and contribute to the hyperparameter scaling laws and scale-up methods we use to predict behavior at multi-thousand-GPU scale. Run Monitoring & Debugging: Help monitor large-scale training runs and investigate convergence issues such as loss spikes and divergence. Work with the team to track down distributed training failures. Research to Practice: Follow the literature, reproduce promising results at small scale, and bring ideas worth testing to the team. Cross-Team Collaboration: Work with the Compute Performance, Data, Evaluation, and Post-Training teams to understand how hardware constraints and the rest of the model lifecycle shape pre-training decisions. Core Qualifications You are proficient in Python and have hands-on experience with PyTorch. You have a strong foundation in machine learning, shown through research (e.g., a PhD, a strong MS'c thesis, or publications), open-source contributions, or substantial professional or substantial personal projects. You have a solid mathematical background (linear algebra, probability, optimization) and enjoy reasoning formally about why models train the way they do. You understand how transformers work and have pre-trained LLMs from scratch yourself, even at small scale. You design experiments carefully, report noisy and negative results honestly, and can explain clearly what your evidence does and does not show. You have a track record of picking up unfamiliar technical areas quickly and going deep, for example by reimplementing papers, ramping up on a large new codebase, or debugging a problem well outside your comfort zone. You write clean, maintainable code and care about reproducible experiments. You communicate clearly, raise problems early, and actively seek out and act on feedback. Preferred Qualifications Distributed Training: Experience training models on multi-GPU or multi-node setups, or familiarity with distributed frameworks (e.g., Megatron-LM, DeepSpeed, torchtitan) and parallelism strategies (data, tensor, pipeline, expert). Training Dynamics: Familiarity with scaling laws, hyperparameter transfer (e.g., µP), or recent work on optimizers and training stability. Efficient Architectures: Exposure to Mixture-of-Experts, efficient attention variants, or other inference-efficient designs. Research Output: Publications at top-tier venues (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR) or contributions to open-source ML training libraries. Systems Curiosity: Low-level kernel optimization is not required, but we highly value a strong curiosity about the hardware and systems constraints that shape scale. title: Senior Backend Engineer, Development Health
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2>An overview of this role</h2> <p>As a Senior Backend Engineer on Development Health, you'll help make the systems that engineering teams rely on more reliable, maintainable, and easier to extend. You'll build and improve the automation, tooling, and data that help teams spot problems early and ship with less friction.</p> <p>As customer zero for GitLab, we support engineering workflows on GitLab's own product at scale. You'll use the product in demanding, real-world ways, surface the friction and gaps you find, and contribute to improvements that get built into the product for GitLab's customers.</p> <p>You'll support work such as:</p> <ul> <li value="1">Health alerting and remediation routing for GitLab's core continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines</li> <li value="2">Flaky and slow test detection systems</li> <li value="3">Engineering analytics and reporting that engineering teams use to make decisions</li> </ul> <h2>What you’ll do</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Own and evolve core Development Health systems, from design through production.</li> <li value="2">Improve the reliability, maintainability, and test coverage of long-lived automation, and reduce reliance on undocumented knowledge by documenting and simplifying legacy systems.</li> <li value="3">Partner with engineering managers and product teams to identify workflow pain points and turn them into well-scoped, measurable improvements.</li> <li value="4">Work with data to show whether changes improve engineering health, and use it to prioritize.</li> <li value="5">Mentor intermediate engineers through code review, design feedback, and pairing.</li> <li value="6">Communicate clearly in writing and asynchronously, including status, tradeoffs, and proposals for stakeholders across Engineering.</li> <li value="7">Monitor the health of production systems, troubleshoot incidents, and contribute to root cause analysis.</li> <li value="8">Use artificial intelligence (AI) agents and assistants to analyze issues and problem areas to help shape the team's product roadmap.</li> <li value="8"><span data-sheets-root="1">Take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it.</span></li> </ul> <h2>What you’ll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Substantial experience as a backend or tooling engineer, with a track record of owning production systems end to end.</li> <li value="2">Strong proficiency in Ruby, or the ability to become productive quickly.</li> <li value="3">Experience maintaining or modernizing legacy codebases safely.</li> <li value="4">Comfort with CI/CD systems, application programming interfaces (APIs), and automation at scale.</li> <li value="5">Independent problem-solving and clear, concise written communication: you spot problems early, raise risks proactively, and drive work to completion without close direction.</li> <li value="6">Experience writing automated unit and integration tests and taking part in collaborative code review.</li> <li value="7">Experience using AI coding assistants to speed up development while critically reviewing their output.</li> <li value="8">Optional experience: Rails; developer productivity, engineering analytics, or internal tooling; GitLab's product and open source contribution workflow; data pipelines or metrics reporting; or agent-based workflows that run in production.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>Development Health is part of Developer Experience. Our work is mostly internal, and our customers are GitLab team members across an engineering organization of hundreds of engineers.</p> <p>We're all-remote, asynchronous by default, and documentation-driven, in line with GitLab's values of collaboration, results, efficiency, diversity, inclusion and belonging, iteration, and transparency.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  </p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#equal-employment-opportunity-policy" target="_blank">GitLab’s EEO Policy</a> and <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/labor-and-employment-notices/#eeoc-us-equal-employment-opportunity-commission-notices" target="_blank">EEO is the Law</a>. If you have a disability or special need that requires <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#reasonable-accommodation" target="_blank">accommodation</a>, please let us know during the <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/interviewing/#adjustments-to-our-interview-process" target="_blank">recruiting process</a>.</p></div>

title: Dev Experiences and Community Lead (SF)
description: ABOUT SUPABASE Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth. ABOUT THE ROLE Supabase is looking for a Dev Experiences and Community Lead (SF) to help grow and scale our developer community initiatives and industry event programs. You’ll work closely with the Head of Global Events and Field Marketing to build programs that connect Supabase with developers and the broader ecosystem. This includes initiatives such as meetups, workshops, hackathons, and community activations that bring Supabase into the spaces where developers learn, build, and collaborate. As an early member of the events team, you’ll help shape how Supabase shows up in person around the world while building the playbooks and frameworks that allow these programs to scale globally. This role sits within Field Marketing and works cross-functionally across Marketing, DevRel, Partnerships, Sales and Design to support programs that deepen developer engagement, strengthen ecosystem relationships. You will also support programming around Supabase Select, our flagship user conference, including partner and community programming connected to the event. We’re a lean, remote-first team, so this role requires someone who is comfortable operating independently, experimenting with new ideas, and helping build the systems that will power Supabase’s events program as it grows. WHAT YOU’LL DO Own and Scale Community Programs - Scale Supabase developer meetups, workshops, and hackathons globally - Partner with DevRel to align community events with product launches and developer education initiatives - Coordinate community meetups around major industry events and Launch Week - Support community programming connected to Supabase Select - Support the SupaSquad advocate network through community activations Support Industry Event Activations - Support Supabase’s presence at conferences such as AWS re:Invent, KubeCon, Stripe Sessions, Dash, and other events - Coordinate developer-focused side events, meetups, and partner activations around major conferences - Collaborate with Partnerships on co-hosted events Turn Experiments Into Scalable Programs - Build playbooks and frameworks for community and ecosystem programs - Identify opportunities to scale successful initiatives across regions - Standardizing event formats and processes as program grow Collaborate Across the Events Team - Partner with the events team on logistics and execution for community programs - Support promotion and event readiness with Marketing - Help ensure strong attendee experiences and post-event follow-up WHO YOU ARE - 5–7+ years in field marketing, developer marketing, community programs or partner marketing - Experience working with developer communities or technical audiences - Strong project management and organizational skills - Comfortable collaborating cross-functionally - Curious about developer ecosystems and the communities around modern infrastructure - Able to manage multiple initiatives in a fast-moving environment Comfortable working remotely and independently - Willing to travel for events as needed NICE TO HAVE - Experience supporting developer meetups, hackathons, or workshops - Experience with community-led growth or developer advocacy programs - Experience running ecosystem or partner-led event programs WHAT WE OFFER - Fully Remote We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world. - ESOP Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together. - Tech Allowance Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work. - Health Benefits Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us. - Annual Off-Sites Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year. - Flexible Work We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when. - Professional Development Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth. ABOUT THE TEAM Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love. - ~400 team members - 60+ countries - 20+ languages spoken - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F) - 540,000+ community members We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

title: System Performance Intern
description: About Pangea Propulsion: We are a company dedicated to developing advanced propulsion systems for the space industry based on three key principles: high efficiency, sustainability, and reusability. We are revolutionizing the space industry with ground-breaking innovations that allow us to offer the best performance to cost propulsion systems. Our goal is to be the propulsion provider for the next generation of spacecraft, which is essential to meet demands and compete in the booming space market of the next decade. We are a passionate, multicultural, and multidisciplinary team pushing the boundaries of what is possible in space propulsion technology. We have already made history by successfully testing the world's first 3D-printed Methalox Aerospike engine, marking a significant milestone for the space industry. We are looking for talented professionals to join our international teams in Barcelona and Toulouse. We want to be a key player in improving diversity in the Aerospace sector as, in Pangea, we believe that diversity (gender, age, race, sexual orientation, beliefs, disability, culture, etc.) is a key to success. Within Pangea, everyone can grow with the same opportunities. We encourage you to apply. Individually we are different, but together we are an amazing team! We are looking for a System Performance Intern in Toulouse . About the role: We are seeking a motivated System Performance Intern to join our System Performance team in Toulouse. During this six-month internship, you will support system-level design, modelling and performance analysis activities for Kronos full-flow staged-combustion rocket engines. You will work closely with System Performance engineers and specialists in combustion, fluidics, turbomachinery and other disciplines to connect engine requirements and design choices with cycle modelling, subsystem characteristics and overall engine performance. You will be involved in the development and execution of engine models, investigating nominal, throttled and off-nominal operating conditions, and assessing how evolving subsystem designs influence the complete propulsion system. The work will include sensitivity studies, design trade-offs and support to the definition of operating and control strategies. This internship requires strong fundamentals in thermodynamics and fluid mechanics, an understanding of liquid rocket-engine cycles, and the ability to interpret numerical results critically rather than treating simulation tools as black boxes. You will contribute to transient analyses covering start-up, throttling and shutdown, and consolidate results into engineering conclusions, performance maps, operating envelopes, subsystem requirements and technical documentation for design reviews. Key Responsibilities: · Develop, modify and execute system-level engine models in EcosimPro/ESPSS. · Analyse nominal operating points and engine operational envelopes, including throttled and off-nominal conditions. · Support engine-cycle optimisation and system-level design trade-offs. · Perform sensitivity studies on key design and operational parameters. · Translate simulation results into engineering conclusions, performance maps, operating envelopes and subsystem requirements. · Support preparation and maintenance of System Performance documentation for project design reviews. · Work with combustion, fluidics, turbomachinery and other disciplines to integrate evolving subsystem designs into the system model. What you need to be successful: · MSc in Aerospace Engineering or equivalent, preferably with a background in propulsion, fluid mechanics, thermodynamics, energy systems or numerical modelling. · Experience with numerical modelling and engineering analysis through academic or professional projects. · Strong fundamentals in thermodynamics, fluid mechanics and heat transfer. · Understanding of liquid rocket propulsion and the fundamental operation of rocket-engine cycles. · Ability to analyse coupled engineering systems and critically interpret simulation results. · Basic programming or engineering scripting capability, preferably Python and/or MATLAB. Soft Skills: · Strong analytical problem-solving skills. · Ability to communicate technical results clearly in English through documentation and presentations. · You are expected to work in a structured and analytical manner, communicate your results clearly, and progressively take ownership of defined modelling and analysis tasks while receiving guidance from experienced engineers. Other useful skills: · Experience with EcosimPro/ESPSS or another 0D/1D system-simulation environment. · Knowledge of staged-combustion or full-flow staged-combustion rocket-engine cycles. · Understanding of turbopumps, turbines, pre-burners, combustion chambers, regenerative cooling circuits, valves and feed systems. · Experience with transient simulation, controls or system dynamics. · Experience with sensitivity analysis, uncertainty propagation or Monte Carlo methods. · Experience processing engineering data using Python or MATLAB. · Familiarity with Git/version control and structured engineering-development processes. · A university project, thesis or previous internship involving propulsion-system modelling. Not hitting every requirement? Research suggests that some people tend to hesitate when it comes to job applications if they don't meet all the desired qualifications. Here at Pangea Propulsion, we're committed to fostering a workplace that values diversity, inclusivity, and authenticity. So, if you're enthusiastic about this role but your prior experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification mentioned in the job description, we still strongly encourage you to apply. You might just be the ideal candidate for this position or other opportunities within our organization. Pangea Propulsion is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We consider all applications without discrimination on any legally protected grounds. We welcome applications from persons with disabilities and we can provide reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process and in the workplace. More about us… We are an international and very multicultural team. Our work is guided by these core values: Teamwork : We strive to work together as an aligned team towards our common goals. Respect & tolerance : we value people with integrity that treat other people with respect. We enjoy having diverse views to enrich the debate and take better decisions. Passion for growth : we are passionate about space and about being pioneers; also, we value personal and organizational growth aiming to a constant improvement. Sustainability : because a long-term vision and strategy is not possible if sustainability is not in the team’s core values. Daring : we do things that sometimes seem impossible, but we always go the extra mile to find a path to do them and we are ready to take the necessary risks to achieve our goals. Deine Aufgaben dabei sind: Projektunterstützung in komplexen technischen IT-Infrastruktur- und Serviceprojekten über alle Projektphasen hinweg Projekt-Controlling in Bezug auf Termine, Meilensteine und Kosten sowie Sicherstellung von Maßnahmen zur Qualitätssicherung Aufzeigen und Koordinieren von Abhängigkeiten, Änderungen und Risiken in der Projektplanung Aufbau und Umsetzung eines strukturierten Anforderungs- und Changemanagements Unterstützung der Gesamtprojektleitung im Tagesgeschäft sowie eigenständige Zuarbeit bei Sonderthemen Erstellung und Pflege von Projektplänen, Statusberichten, Protokollen sowie Projektlisten (Personal-, Kommunikations-, Abwesenheits- und Vertreterregelungslisten) Aufsetzen und Durchführen der Regelkommunikation (Terminkoordination) sowie Management der gesamten Projektablage Dein Profil Folgende Kenntnisse und Fähigkeiten solltest Du auf jeden Fall mitbringen: Mindestens 6 Jahre praktische Berufserfahrung in IT-Projekten, idealerweise im Umfeld komplexer technischer Infrastrukturen in Behörden oder Großkonzernen (ab 10.000 Usern) Anerkannte Projektmanagement-Zertifizierung nach IPMA Level C, PMI PMP oder PRINCE2 Practitioner Sicherer Umgang mit Jira sowie gängigen Projektplanungs- und Office-Tools Strukturierte, proaktive und analytische Arbeitsweise sowie souveräne Kommunikationsstärke Für die effektive Kommunikation im Projektumfeld sowie mit unseren deutschsprachigen Kunden ist ein sehr gutes mündliches und schriftliches Deutsch erforderlich. Das bieten wir Dir Deine Ideen. Deine Entwicklung. Unsere gemeinsame Zukunft. Bei uns erwarten Dich nicht nur spannende Technologien, sondern auch die Freiräume, um eigene Ideen einzubringen, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und gemeinsam innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln. Zukunft aktiv gestalten: Arbeite an innovativen Technologien und gestalte digitale Entwicklungen mit. Flexibel arbeiten: Profitiere von unserem hybriden New-Work-Modell. Sicher durchstarten: Wir bieten Dir einen unbefristeten Arbeitsvertrag. Mehr für Dich: Nutze Deine givve Card als steuerfreien Unternehmensbenefit. Freiraum für Deine Ideen: Übernimm Verantwortung und nutze Deinen Gestaltungs- und Entscheidungsspielraum. Persönlich weiterkommen: Entwickle Dich mit individuellen Karriereperspektiven gezielt weiter. Gemeinsam mehr erreichen: Profitiere vom Wissenstransfer und Zusammenhalt in einem starken Team. Technologie erleben: Entdecke vielfältige Technologien und arbeite an anspruchsvollen, sicherheitsrelevanten Systemen. Und das Wichtigste: spannende Herausforderungen, echte Teamarbeit und die Möglichkeit, etwas zu bewegen. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Director, Head of Quality & Responsible Person, International
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong><span data-contrast="auto">Mavericks Wanted</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":true,"134233118":true,"201341983":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">When was the last time you achieved the impossible? If that thought feels overwhelming, you might want to pause here, but if it sparks excitement...read on</span> <br><span data-contrast="auto"> </span> <br><span data-contrast="auto">In 2015, we pioneered a “moneyball for biotech” approach, pooling projects and promising early-stage research from academia together under one financial umbrella to reduce risk and unleash innovation. This model allows science and small teams of experts to lead the way. We build bridges to groundbreaking advancements in rare disease, and develop life-changing medicines for patients with unmet needs as fast as humanly possible. </span> <br><span data-contrast="auto"> </span> <br><span data-contrast="auto">Together we define white space, push boundaries, and empower people to solve problems. If you're someone who defies convention, join us and work alongside some of the most respected minds in the industry. Together, we'll ask "why not?" and help reengineer the future of biopharma. At BridgeBio, we value curiosity and experimentation—including the ethical & thoughtful use of AI to improve clarity, speed, and quality of work.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":true,"134233118":true,"201341983":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></p></div><p><strong><u>What You’ll Do</u></strong></p> <p>The Sr Director, Head of Quality & Responsible Person, International, leads quality for infigratinib, and will be the designated Responsible Person on the entity's wholesale distribution authorisation. The role reports to the Head of Quality, QED, with a dotted line to local managing director, and is based in the Netherlands. If the entity becomes the marketing authorisation holder for infigratinib, the role also covers the related MAH quality duties. The role holds an unrestricted right of escalation to the entity's full board and is independent of commercial operations and of manufacturing/supply with EU-GDP guidelines, relevant EU directives (including the Falsified Medicines Directive), Dutch Medicines Act, and public service requirements. This role acts as a QA liaison of BridgeBio's contract service providers (CSPs), providing oversight of lot release activities. This role includes reviewing and approving batch records, certificates of analysis, and compliance documents, providing quality review of deviations, change controls, and CAPAs related to assigned CSPs, collaborating closely with CSPs and internal teams such as quality control, manufacturing, regulatory affairs, and supply chain. The role builds and leads a small quality team (deputy RP, QA compliance/QMS, QA operations/GDP), owns the quality management system across the Skeletal Dysplasia assets, and leads WDA licensing, inspection readiness and potentially subsequent MIA readiness, if needed in the future.</p> <p><strong><u>Responsibilities</u></strong></p> <p><strong>Major Responsibilities / Accountabilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Serve as the named Responsible Person on the WDA: release for distribution, recall decisions, and GDP compliance of the entity</li> <li>Leads and develops the entity's quality team: deputy RP, QA compliance/QMS, and QA operations/GDP; and QP</li> <li>Manages and improves the Quality Management System (QMS) across the entity's assets in alignment with the established QMS</li> <li>Lead the WDA application and IGJ inspection readiness; prepare subsequent MIA readiness (QP recruitment, import and batch-certification processes)</li> <li>Own the quality agreement matrix: includes Quality oversight of contract service providers, 3PLs, distributors and intercompany interfaces</li> <li>Act as a Quality liaison and provide oversight and quality support of assigned contract service providers</li> <li>Perform quality review of assigned quality events such as deviations, change controls, supplier notifications</li> <li>Review master manufacturing batch records, including related documents such as specifications, analytical and microbiological methods, stability study protocols, and label proofs</li> <li>Manage lot release activities and communication of lot release schedules to key stakeholders</li> <li>Communicate manufacturing deficiencies/non-conformances to management and work with CSPs to ensure timely resolution</li> <li>Review process and method validation protocols and reports</li> <li>Review analytical test results to ensure compliance with approved specifications</li> <li>Assist in updating CMC sections of regulatory and quality documents</li> <li>Participate in internal and external project team meetings</li> </ul> <p><strong>Other QA/Responsible Person related responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Ensure accuracy of quality of records per GDP requirements including GDPs are implemented and maintained in the quality management system requirements for WDA license</li> <li>Support and coordinate return, rejected, falsified products, recall operations of medicinal products</li> <li>Provide oversight of GDP and GMP activities of active pharmaceutical ingredients (API)</li> <li>Ensure WDA and API registration is current with commercial supply chain</li> <li>Participate and leads EU/ROW regulatory inspections</li> <li>Participate and oversee GMP vendor qualification program</li> <li>Oversee the EU/ROW internal audit program, internal training program and ensure data integrity</li> <li>Write and review governing procedures as needed (e.g., SOPs, WIs, etc.)</li> <li>Other duties as assigned</li> </ul> <p><strong><u>Where You’ll Work  </u></strong></p> <ul> <li>This is a Netherlands based remote role</li> <li>Travel 30% of time is expected</li> </ul> <p><strong><u>Who you are</u></strong></p> <ul> <li>BS/MS degree preferably in operations, science, pharmacy</li> <li>A diploma, certificate, or other evidence of formal qualifications on completion of GDP/GDP-API training required for registration as an RP by the competent authorities in the Netherlands</li> <li>10+ years in pharmaceutical quality, including significant GDP / distribution quality experience; prior appointment as (or eligibility to be) a Responsible Person strongly preferred</li> <li>Experience leading regulatory inspections with EU competent authorities (IGJ preferred)</li> <li>Prior experience of managing third party vendors (CMOs, CTLs, 3PLs, etc.)</li> <li>Prior relevant knowledge and experience related to the distribution of medical products</li> <li>Strong understanding of supply chain concepts, supplier management, inventory management</li> <li>Extensive knowledge of US/EU GMPs /GDPs and associated guidance</li> <li>Working in a highly regulated environment</li> <li>Proven leadership of quality teams; experience building quality functions or systems</li> <li>Understanding the EU and particularly IGJ regulations in relation to the wholesale distribution of medicines</li> <li>Strong planning and time management skills with ability to prioritize workload</li> <li>Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with keen attention to detail</li> <li>Proficiency in document and presentation office tools (Microsoft Office, Google Docs, etc.)</li> <li>Basic understanding of data concepts and enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems e.g., SAP</li> <li>Ready to embrace company core values and diverse corporate culture</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong><u>Rewarding Those Who Make the Mission Possible</u></strong></p> <p>We have high expectations for our team members. We make sure those working hard for patients are rewarded and cared for in return.</p> <ul> <li>Market leading compensation</li> <li>Hybrid work model - we value your flexibility in how you work, but encourage time in the office to strengthen our culture, collaboration, and sense of community</li> <li>We provide career development through regular feedback, continuous education and professional development programs</li> <li>We celebrate strong performance with financial rewards, peer-to-peer recognition, and growth opportunities.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>As a global company, our comprehensive benefits may vary based on location.  <span data-contrast="auto">We have high expectations for our team members. title: Senior Global Mobility Manager (all genders)
description: <h2><strong>About the role</strong></h2> <p>The Global Mobility Team at HelloFresh is looking for a <strong>Senior Global Mobility Manager </strong>who will use their expert knowledge to help think and develop Global Mobility within a young, rapidly expanding company, and consider this as a strategically important topic within the People Team. As a successful applicant, you will also always have an open ear for the questions of your stakeholders and our employees, manage to organize and structure your tasks independently, and own and lead internal initiatives and projects.</p> <p>Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.</p> <p>This role is based in Berlin and reports to the Head of Global Mobility and Travel</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Strategic Advisory to the Business:</strong> Have a business impact by assisting the business to onboard new hires and retain international employees via mobility programs, along with an impact on new hires and employees' lives by taking part in their relocation, immigration, and settling-in journey </li> <li><strong>Tier 3 Case Management: </strong>In your daily work, you will have diverse responsibilities, such as: strategically consulting on complex relocation, immigration, and internal mobility cases, managing escalations and exceptions, and accompanying executive cases of senior leaders.</li> <li><strong>Project management:</strong> you will be responsible for some of our key projects, such as reviewing and improving policies and processes, working on benchmarking, globalization, and constant automation and efficiency. </li> <li><strong>Continuous improvement of our policies and title: Business Analyst - Enterprise & AI Solutions
description: <div class="content-intro"><h4><strong>Who We Are</strong></h4> <p>WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. In a world where Al is reshaping how companies drive growth, we lead clients in business transformation and marketing modernization, connecting strategy directly to execution. Our 12,000 experts in engineering and platforms, commerce, consulting, content transformation, CRM, and CX work within a unified global operating unit across 40+ markets. WPP Enterprise Solutions works alongside best-in-class partners including Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, and Shopify, as well as innovators in AI, to deliver growth solutions tailored to the needs of our clients’ businesses. VML, part of WPP, supports WPP Enterprise Solutions by helping brands activate transformation through creativity and experience.</p></div><h3>Working in technology & innovation with WPP Enterprise Solutions</h3> <p>At WPP Enterprise Solutions Netherlands, we create connected brands to drive growth. Our expertise spans the full customer journey, with deep capabilities in commerce, consultancy, CRM, CX, data, production, technology, content, media and more. We deliver end-to-end solutions for ambitious B2B and B2C brands, supported by the wider WPP network.</p> <p>Our work combines strategy, product thinking, experience design, data, engineering and AI to solve real business problems, from enterprise commerce modernisation and digital shelf excellence to AI-enabled content operations, marketing automation, GEO, workflow orchestration and custom AI agents.</p> <h3>About the team</h3> <p>You’ll join the Product Management & AI Solutions team: the group that bridges business strategy, customer experience and technology to deliver scalable commerce and enterprise solutions. We work closely with UX/CX, Data & AI, SEO/GEO, Content, CRM, Paid and Retail Media, Engineering and Delivery teams.</p> <p>Our ambition is to move beyond isolated skills and build repeatable, outcome-led propositions around commerce growth topics such as Search & Discovery, Personalisation, CRO & Experience Optimisation, Product Data/PIM & Digital Shelf, Content Supply Chain & AI Content Operations, CRM & Lifecycle Growth, Performance & Retail Media, SEO/GEO and Composable Commerce Modernisation. Alongside this, we are growing our applied AI work: shaping and delivering custom AI agents and AI-enabled workflows for clients, from discovery and pilot through to production and continuous improvement.</p> <h3>Why this role exists</h3> <p>Clients are increasingly asking for integrated solutions rather than isolated delivery capacity. They need people who can understand the business problem, shape the product direction, define the right solution, translate it into clear specifications and guide teams through delivery. At the same time, AI is changing how commerce, content, marketing and operations work, creating a need for analysts who can combine structured requirements thinking with product ownership, enterprise technology understanding and the design of AI-enabled workflows and agents.</p> <p>This role is designed for someone who can operate as a strong Business Analyst, step into Product Owner responsibilities when needed, advocate for product thinking inside the organisation and help turn our AI and commerce capabilities into scalable client value. You will work across both our commerce and enterprise product work and our applied AI work. The mix depends on client demand, and we expect the AI share to grow over time.</p> <h3>The role</h3> <p>As Business Analyst, Enterprise & AI Solutions, you bridge business needs, product direction and technical delivery across enterprise digital commerce and martech ecosystems. You analyse business processes, clarify user and stakeholder needs, define requirements and support solutioning across the commerce stack: CMS, Search, PIM/PXM, DAM, ERP, OMS, CDP, CRM, analytics, marketing automation, paid/media platforms and integration layers.</p> <p>You will also work on AI initiatives such as custom AI agents (for example for pricing, search or customer service), content and marketing automation, product/content enrichment, GEO and organic discoverability, AI orchestration and workflow automation. You do not need to be a machine learning engineer or a domain expert, but you must be technically curious and comfortable working with APIs, data flows, automation tools, LLM-based workflows, AI quality evaluation, governance requirements and human-in-the-loop processes.</p> <p>Depending on your experience and the project context, you may act as a hands-on BA, a product-minded discovery partner, a proxy Product Owner or a work stream lead. In all cases, your job is to make ambiguity manageable, decisions explicit and delivery focused on measurable value.</p> <h3>What you will do</h3> <ul> <li>Collaborate with Solution Architects and Product Owners and translate business goals into clear requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, tech architecture, data flows and integration specifications that delivery teams can act on.</li> <li>Work across commerce, martech and enterprise ecosystems, including CMS, Search, PIM/PXM, DAM, ERP, OMS, CDP, CRM, analytics, marketing automation and media platforms.</li> <li>Identify, shape and specify practical AI, automation and workflow orchestration opportunities across content, marketing, commerce and operational processes, from process mapping and readiness checks to a scoped pilot with a clear business case.</li> <li>Specify AI agents and LLM-based workflows: define the task, data sources, tools and integrations, guardrails, human-in-the-loop steps and escalation paths, plus the evaluation criteria that decide when a solution is ready to go live. After launch, help measure quality, adoption and business impact.</li> <li>Act as a Business Analyst or proxy Product Owner when needed by supporting prioritisation, backlog refinement, sprint planning, UAT, release preparation and stakeholder alignment.</li> <li>Connect business, UX, data, SEO/GEO, content, engineering, legal and delivery teams to make sure solutions are valuable, feasible, scalable and well governed.</li> <li>Help make our AI work repeatable and sellable: contribute to proposals, scoping and estimates, and build reusable assets such as discovery templates, requirement patterns, evaluation sets and playbooks.</li> <li>At the senior end of the role, independently lead workstreams, own parts of the client relationship and coach junior analysts or product team members.</li> </ul> <h3>Who you are</h3> <ul> <li>A structured problem-solver who starts with the business problem, not only the requested feature.</li> <li>A product-minded Business Analyst who can move between discovery, specification, prioritisation and delivery support.</li> <li>Comfortable acting as a proxy Product Owner when a project needs stronger product ownership.</li> <li>Technically fluent enough to discuss APIs, data flows, integrations, platform dependencies and implementation trade-offs with engineering teams.</li> <li>Curious and pragmatic about AI: you use AI tools in your own work and understand the opportunity, but also the need for governance, quality, reliability and human oversight.</li> <li>Comfortable with fast-moving technology: you focus on the problem and the outcome rather than a specific tool, and you pick up new platforms quickly.</li> <li>Strong in workshops, stakeholder alignment and decision-making, with the confidence to challenge constructively.</li> <li>Able to represent the Product Management & AI Solutions team inside WPP and help other teams understand the value of product thinking and applied AI.</li> <li>Commercially aware: you can connect requirements and solutions to client value, efficiency, scalability, conversion, discoverability or operational impact.</li> <li>Collaborative and low-ego, with the ability to work across Commerce, UX/CX, Data, SEO/GEO, Content, CRM, Media, Engineering and Delivery.</li> </ul> <h3>What you’ll need</h3> <h4>The basics</h4> <ul> <li>3-5 years of experience as a Business Analyst, Product Owner, Solution Analyst or similar role, ideally in commerce, martech, enterprise platforms, consulting or a digital agency environment.</li> <li>Experience with digital commerce ecosystems, preferably B2B and/or B2C enterprise environments.</li> <li>Working knowledge of platforms and domains such as CMS, Search, PIM/PXM, DAM, ERP, OMS, CDP, CRM, analytics, marketing automation and paid/media technology.</li> <li>Strong experience writing user stories, acceptance criteria, functional specifications, process flows and integration requirements.</li> <li>Good technical understanding of REST APIs, web platforms, data flows, system integrations and common delivery dependencies.</li> <li>Hands-on familiarity with generative AI tools and a working understanding of how LLM-based solutions behave, including their limitations and how to test the quality of their output.</li> <li>Experience working in Agile delivery environments with tools such as Jira, Confluence or similar.</li> <li>Excellent communication, facilitation, documentation and stakeholder management skills.</li> <li>Fluent professional English.</li> <li>Currently residing in the Netherlands with a valid work permit.</li> </ul> <h3>Bonus points</h3> <ul> <li>Hands-on experience with automation tools such as n8n, Zapier or similar.</li> <li>Experience shaping AI, LLM, agentic or workflow orchestration use cases in a business or delivery context, ideally including at least one that went live.</li> <li>Familiarity with AI and agent platforms such as Microsoft Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI or the OpenAI and Anthropic APIs, and with concepts such as retrieval (RAG), tool use and evaluation.</li> <li>Familiarity with AI governance and regulation, such as the EU AI Act, and with responsible AI practices.</li> <li>Experience with search and personalisation platforms, composable commerce, PIM/PXM, CDP, CRM or marketing automation platforms.</li> <li>Experience with GA4, BigQuery, SQL, Python, Postman, Figma, Miro or similar tools.</li> <li>Proficiency in Dutch.</li> </ul> <h3>In return, this is what we offer</h3> <p>You’ll get access to an international network of clients, colleagues, technology partners and resources. We have a listening ear for ambitious ideas, and together we keep stretching our boundaries. We want you to follow the path you’re building, and we invest in your personal development in a dynamic, collaborative workplace.</p> <h2>Our compensation</h2> <ul> <li>A monthly salary between <strong>€4,800 and €5200</strong> gross, depending on your experience, seniority and fit with the role.</li> <li>A gross annual 8% holiday allowance.</li> <li>Access to our commuting package to suit your individual needs.</li> <li>Competitive pension benefits.</li> <li>A choice of a Mac or Windows laptop.</li> </ul> <h2>Our culture</h2> &

en synergie avec les pôles experts de l’agence (<em>Content Strategy</em>, Production, Événementiel, Média).</li> <li><strong>Delivery & Satisfaction :</strong> Suivi rigoureux de la relation client, underline;">Développement Commercial & Offre</span></li> </ol> <ul> <li><strong>New Business & Croissance :</strong> Pilotage des briefs entrants (Inbizz et NewBizz) et participation active au méthodologies et outils (GOAT, outils de veille/social listening) et développement des relations avec les créateurs de contenu, agences de management et maisons artistiques.</li> </ul> <ol> <li><span title: Nyx Software Functional System Verification & Validation Engineer
description: Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecraft for humanity. We want you as a talented Software Functional System Verification & Validation Engineer to help us in our mission by making sure that Nyx's flight software does exactly what the system needs it to do, and that this is proven at the right level of test. Key Responsibilities In your capacity as a Software Functional System V&V Engineer, your role will be continuously evolving, but day to day your duties will include: Keep a holistic view of the system-level software functional requirements and ensure they are correctly implemented and verified. Decide, per requirement, the right verification level: low-level unit test, SIL scenario, PIL run, HIL run, or vehicle-in-the-loop run. Define, plan, and execute verification campaigns across these levels, and analyse and report the results. Work day to day with the functional chain responsible in each subsystem team to define functional chains, test cases, and required test facilities. Dive into the details when needed: analyse failures in the code and make hands-on adjustments to test scripts, test harnesses, and software, in coordination with the FSW team. Maintain traceability from system requirements to implementation and verification evidence. Review test descriptions, expected inputs and outputs, and verification reports for completeness and correctness. Triage test failures, drive issue resolution with the FSW team, and manage related deviations and waivers. Prepare test readiness and review material, and report verification status to the FSW lead and the Chief Engineer. What we would love to see from you In the role of Software Functional System V&V Engineer, ideally you will have the following: What we would love to see from you Degree in Aerospace, Software, Electrical, or Computer Engineering, or a related field. 5-10 years of experience working on complex space projects, including software verification and validation of embedded, real-time, or safety-critical systems. Hands-on experience with at least two of: SIL, PIL, HIL, or vehicle-level test campaigns. Holistic system thinker who is also ready to go into the code and make adjustments when the details require it. Strong C/C++ reading and debugging skills, plus scripting for test automation (e.g., Python). Solid understanding of spacecraft subsystems and how functional chains span them (e.g., AOCS, power, thermal, propulsion, avionics). Experience with requirements management and traceability tools. Structured, precise, and ownership-driven, with the ability to align multiple subsystem teams. Clear written and verbal communication in English. Nice to have Experience in flight software on spacecraft or launch vehicles. Familiarity with NASA & ECSS standards for space software and verification. Experience operating or setting up SIL, PIL, HIL and/or vehicle-in-the-loop facilities. Why you should join us! What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is: We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge? We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly. The Exploration Company is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Relocation assistance is provided for those willing to relocate including visa sponsorship where applicable. All offers are contingent upon the successful completion of a background check, which will be subject to the country, role, and project you applied for. By submitting your application, you acknowledge and agree that any offer of employment may be conditional upon successful condition of this check. The Exploration Company partners with Zinc Work Limited located in the UK (Zinc), a third-party provider, to ensure this process as efficient and transparent as possible. If applicable, you will receive an email from Zinc upon acceptance of your offer with a link to a secure portal where you can provide the required information to Zinc.
