title: Technical Support Manager (m/f/d) L2
description: 🎤 Why voize? Because we’re more than just a job! At voize, we believe the greatest gift to frontline workers is time - time to care, connect, and be present. Today, that time is lost to busywork and complex systems that pull them away from what matters most: people . Our vision is to change that by building AI companions that seamlessly take over digital workflows. We don't replace humans with technology - we amplify their impact. Our mission is backed with a $50M Series A funding led by Balderton Capital, with support from HV Capital, Y Combinator and other leading VCs. Today, 2,000+ facilities trust voize, and over 200,000 users rely on our AI companion to ease their daily workload. As a dynamic team, we combine first-in-class technology with meaningful social impact. And now, we’re looking for you to join us on this mission! 💡 Your Mission: Keep 2,000+ care facilities running When voize works, nurses get 39 minutes of their shift back. When something breaks, a firewall silently blocking sync, an interface mismatch with a facility's care software or a regression after a release; documentation stops and care teams feel it immediately. Your mission: make sure that downtime is minimum, and never happens twice. As Technical Support Manager , you own our technically hardest customer cases end-to-end. You work at the intersection of our AI product, real-world facility IT, and the German care software ecosystem - with a direct line to our Engineering team, not a ticket queue between you. And your work has leverage: one root cause you find and fix can resolve an issue for dozens or hundreds of facilities at once. 🚀 Your Daily Business - No two days are alike Own escalated cases from 1st-level support end-to-end: reproduce , isolate the fault across app, backend, customer network, and third-party systems and keep the customer clearly informed until it's solved Debug integrations with leading German care documentation systems : interface errors, data and schema mismatches, and on-prem configurations in customer environments (Windows/Linux) Untangle customer-side IT - firewalls, proxies, certificates, MDM-managed shared devices - often in direct coordination with a facility's IT Take the lead in critical incidents : assess which facilities are affected, drive resolution together with Engineering, and own clear, timely communication to customers and internal stakeholders Turn recurring issues into permanent fixes: root-cause analyses with Product & Engineering , input into pre-release QA, runbooks and knowledge-base articles - and mentor 1st-level colleagues along the way as you help shape our escalation playbooks 🤝 Your Skillset — What you bring to the table Hands-on experience with observability/monitoring tools (Grafana, Sentry) and strong networking fundamentals (firewalls, proxies, DNS, TLS/certificates) - you can use logs, metrics, and traces to figure out why systems can't talk to each other Solid Windows and/or Linux system administration in enterprise or customer environments - you're at home in logs, configs, and the command line Hands-on experience with APIs and system integrations - you can read a payload and trace where data breaks between systems Experience owning 2nd/3rd-level escalations in complex environments German proficiency at C2 / billingual level - our customers work with us in German , so this is a hard requirement 🌱 Growing together – what you can expect at voize We are a fast-growing startup, that means you will tackle challenges, grow quickly, and make a real impact, giving healthcare professionals more time for real patient care We foster an open, collaborative culture with regular team events, whether you work from our Berlin office or remotely from Germany Become a co-creator of our success with stock options Generous perks: 30 vacation days plus your birthday off, Germany Transport Ticket, Urban Sports Club, regular company off-sites, and access to learning platforms such as Blinkist and Audible You decide when you work best, that means flexible working hours and a good hybrid set-up ✨ Ready to talk? description: 🎤 Warum voize? Weil wir mehr sind als nur ein Job! Wir bei voize sind überzeugt: Das Wertvollste, was wir Pflegekräften zurückgeben können ist Zeit – Zeit, um sich zu kümmern, Beziehungen aufzubauen und wirklich präsent zu sein. Heute geht diese Zeit für Bürokratie und unübersichtliche Systeme verloren, die sie von dem abhalten, worauf es eigentlich ankommt: den Menschen. Genau das wollen wir ändern. Wir bauen AI-Companions, die digitale Arbeitsabläufe nahtlos übernehmen. Wir ersetzen Menschen nicht durch Technologie – wir verstärken ihre Wirkung. Unsere Mission wird von einer Series-A-Finanzierung über 50 Mio. US-Dollar getragen, angeführt von Balderton Capital und mit Beteiligung von HV Capital, Y Combinator und weiteren führenden VCs. Heute vertrauen über 2.000 Einrichtungen auf voize, und mehr als 200.000 Nutzer:innen setzen unseren KI-Companion ein, um ihren Arbeitsalltag zu erleichtern. Als dynamisches Team verbinden wir erstklassige Technologie mit echtem gesellschaftlichem Mehrwert. Und jetzt suchen wir dich, um diese Mission mit uns weiterzutragen! 💡 Deine Mission: Du verantwortest den Erstkontakt und baust unsere Pipeline auf Wir suchen eine proaktive und empathische Persönlichkeit als Sales Development Representative (SDR) , die den ersten Schritt im Vertriebsprozess übernimmt: herausfinden, wer unsere nächsten Kund:innen sein sollten, den passenden Weg zu ihnen entwickeln und mitgestalten, wie sich unsere Go-to-Market-Strategie weiterentwickelt, während wir in neue Segmente wachsen. Integrate agentic workflows with GitHub, CI, test infrastructure and code review, so the agentic path becomes the easiest path for engineers. Extend the loop beyond coding: connect earlier signals like product research and customer requests, and later ones like production metrics, so agents contribute across the whole cycle. Open it up beyond engineering, so PMs, designers and others can turn a well-defined issue into a reviewed, mergeable change. Shape review practices, such as PR evidence that shows what changed, what ran, what risks remain and where human judgment is needed. Measure what works Build benchmarks from real historical engineering tasks to evaluate output quality, failure modes, review burden and production risk. Define and track quality and adoption signals, such as reviewer acceptance rate, CI pass rate, rework rate and developer satisfaction. Use data and feedback to change course, retire what doesn't work, and build trust across engineering. Requirements Must-haves 🔥 Frontier obsession: You live at the frontier. title: Staff Site Reliability Engineer (x/f/m)
description: Your Impact We are looking for a Staff Site Reliability Engineer to join our SRE team dedicated to platform reliability within Platform Engineering. Your mission will be to act as a technical leader driving Doctolib's reliability and scalability at a European scale, ensuring our platform remains reliable, debuggable, and resilient across infrastructure, observability, and cross-cutting reliability initiatives. You will play a pivotal role in a team driving reliability standards across 170+ applications, contributing directly to supporting 520,000 health professionals and 90 million patients in their daily healthcare journey. This role sits at the intersection of infrastructure, developer experience, and product engineering. You'll act as a technical leader and strategic partner to SREs, software engineers, and product teams, guiding decisions, mentoring engineers, and driving cross-cutting initiatives that elevate our operational maturity. What you'll do Your responsibilities include but are not limited to: Lead large-scale cross-cutting reliability initiatives across the platform, spanning infrastructure automation, observability, and incident management Identify and drive improvements to incident detection, response, and postmortem analysis capabilities Define and evolve SLOs, error budgets, and alerting standards across multiple product teams Take part in the on-call rotation, and actively contribute to improving our on-call experience by refining alerting, reducing noise, and ensuring actionable telemetry Serve as a mentor and technical coach to senior engineers, helping elevate the craft of reliability engineering across the company Influence strategic decisions by providing technical guidance to leadership and representing reliability engineering in architectural reviews and platform discussions Partner with software engineering teams to embed reliability practices early in the development lifecycle Who you are Before you read on: if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply. You'll be a great fit if you: Have extensive experience (8+ years) in SRE, platform engineering, or infrastructure roles within a large-scale, multi-team production environment Have proven experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure Have strong experience with containerization and orchestration technologies, Kubernetes is a must, its deployment and scaling strategies ecosystem Have implemented and operated SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets in production Have experience managing on-call rotations and leading incident response in high-stakes environments Have a strong systems engineering background with fluency in at least one backend programming language (e.g., Go, Python, Ruby) Have a proven ability to lead through influence: setting technical direction, driving consensus, and mentoring engineers across teams Are comfortable balancing long-term architecture work with fast, iterative improvements Have clear, concise communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to drive alignment in ambiguous environments Partner with feature teams to accelerate their production readiness, providing hands-on guidance on reliability best practices, launch reviews, and operational standards before go-live Are fluent in English It would be fantastic if you: Have deep expertise in observability tooling and architecture (logging, tracing, metrics) Have experience designing and operating high-scale telemetry pipelines and working with developers to improve instrumentation quality Appreciate working in regulated environments, healthcare, fintech, or similar; at Doctolib, data privacy and compliance are part of every engineering decision Care about reliability enablement, golden paths, runbooks, shared libraries Life at Doctolib Tech Our solutions are built on a single fully cloud-native platform that supports web and mobile app interfaces, multiple languages, and is adapted to country and healthcare specialty requirements. Our stack is composed of Rails, TypeScript, Java, Python, Kotlin, Swift, and React Native. We leverage AI ethically across our products to empower patients and health professionals. Discover our AI vision here . Want to learn more about our tech culture and environment? Visit the Doctolib Tech site . What we offer A Deutschlandticket (Germany-wide public transport pass) fully paid for by Doctolib 28 vacation days + 1 additional day for each full calendar year of employment (up to a maximum of 30 days) Work from abroad for up to 10 days per year thanks to our flexibility days policy Company health insurance with great supplementary benefits through our partner Allianz Company pension scheme (bAV) through Allianz with an employer subsidy of 40% (15% within the probationary period) The Doctolib Parent Care program, which includes one month additional parental leave and much more Enrollment in Doctolib's long-term employee value sharing plan called DoctoGrowth Free mental health and coaching services through our partner Moka.care Subsidized sports membership through our partner Urban Sports Club A flexible workplace policy offering both hybrid and office-based mode Alongside healthy snacks and our regular breakfast buffet, we provide a subsidized meal benefit For caregivers and workers with disabilities, a package including an adaptation of the remote policy, extra days off for medical reasons, and psychological support Relocation support in case of international mobility Access to the best AI tools for coding, development and dedicated training Our interview process Recruiter Interview System Design Interview Technical SRE Interview Behavioral Interview At least one reference check We want your experience to be clear, respectful, and transparent. Learn more about our hiring process on our candidate experience page . Job details Permanent position Tech stack: Kubernetes, Terraform, AWS / GCP, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, Datadog, ArgoCD Full-time Berlin, Germany Hybrid work setup (up to 2 remote days per week) Start date: as soon as possible We welcome everyone At Doctolib, we are committed to improving access to healthcare for everyone. This translates into our recruitment process. We evaluate candidates based solely on qualifications and motivation, without any form of discrimination. The more diverse ideas are heard, the more our product will truly improve healthcare for all. title: Software Engineer Intern - Fullstack (x/f/m) - Berlin - March 2027
description: Software Engineering Intern - Fullstack (x/f/m) Set a new pulse for healthcare! We are looking for a Software Engineering Intern to join the Engineering team. Your mission will be to build innovative products and features that improve the daily lives of care teams and patients. You will work in a feature team developing solutions that directly impact healthcare professionals and patients across Europe, contributing to our Operating System powered by AI to manage all clinical and administrative activities. Working in the tech team at Doctolib means building innovative products and features to improve the daily lives of care teams and patients. What you'll do Your responsibilities include but are not limited to: Build and own features alongside experienced engineers — from design and development to testing and shipping — with a direct impact on real users Collaborate with engineers, product managers, and designers to solve complex technical challenges and build scalable, secure, and user-friendly healthcare tools Write clean, efficient code following industry best practices in design, testing, and peer review Solve real-world problems that directly enhance patient care and improve doctor-patient relationships Explore new tools and technologies, including AI and distributed systems, as part of your continuous growth Contribute to a culture of learning and collaboration by sharing knowledge and engaging actively with your team Who you are Before you read on: if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply. You'll be a great fit if you: You love problem-solving and are driven by curiosity — you're not afraid to dive into complex issues and find creative solutions You thrive in a collaborative environment and enjoy working with cross-functional teams, sharing knowledge, and learning from your peers You have a passion for technology and product development, and always keep the user experience in mind You are comfortable coding, with the help of AI agents like Claude Code, in multiple languages and eager to learn our tech stack You are in your final year of a degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field and looking for a 6-month full-time internship Eager to learn and work in a team of builders You are fluent in English It would be fantastic if you: Have experience with web development or building products in a fast-paced environment Have worked on side projects or contributed to open-source communities Are familiar with AI-assisted coding tools and eager to integrate them into your daily workflow. Life at Doctolib Tech Our solutions are built on a single fully cloud-native platform that supports web and mobile app interfaces, multiple languages, and is adapted to country and healthcare specialty requirements. Our stack is composed of Rails, TypeScript, Java, Python, Kotlin, Swift, and React Native. We leverage AI ethically across our products to empower patients and health professionals. Discover our AI vision here . Want to learn more about our tech culture and environment? Visit the Doctolib Tech site . What we offer A Deutschlandticket sponsored by Doctolib if you work from the office or in a hybrid setup. Company health insurance with excellent additional benefits. Free mental health and coaching sessions provided through an external partner. In addition to healthy snacks and a regular breakfast buffet, we offer meal vouchers. A subsidized sports program with our partner Urban Sports Club. Tech masterclasses throughout the internship. Free breakfast at the office. Access to the best AI tools for coding and development, as well as dedicated training. Our interview process Coding Game (1h) Recruiter Interview (30 minutes) Feature Building Interview (1h) Behavioral Interview (1h) Job details Internship (6 months) Berlin Hybrid work setup (up to 2 remote days per week) Start date: March 2027 We welcome everyone At Doctolib, we are committed to improving access to healthcare for everyone. This translates into our recruitment process. We evaluate candidates based solely on qualifications and motivation, without any form of discrimination. The more diverse ideas are heard, the more our product will truly improve healthcare for all. You are welcome to apply to Doctolib, regardless of your gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity, or disability. To ensure equal opportunities, we invite you to exclude personal information (e.g., pictures, age) from your applications. If you require any accommodation, please let us know for support during the hiring process. Join us in building the healthcare we all dream of! title: Medical Data Intern (x/f/m)
description: Medical Data Intern (x/f/m) Set a new pulse for healthcare! We are looking for a Medical Data Intern to join the Terminology and Ontology team within the Medical Excellence department at Doctolib in Berlin . At Doctolib, we're setting a new pulse for healthcare. We create AI-powered solutions that help health professionals focus on care and help people prevent, detect, and treat health problems earlier. In this role, you will contribute to making medical information clear, structured, and usable across products for patients, healthcare professionals, and technical teams. What you'll do Your responsibilities include but are not limited to: Collect and format sets of terms describing pathologies, allergies, treatments, and other medical concepts, based on standard medical terminologies such as ICD-10 and SNOMED CT. Adapt medical labels to create versions that are understandable to patients and healthcare professionals. Translate labels from English into German. Map medical lists of terms across different products. Select and filter terms, then validate your choices with medical experts. Share your work and methodology with the Terminology and Ontology team and product teams. Deliver sets of terms to technical teams in the correct format. About our data environment Our solutions are built on a single fully cloud-native platform that supports web and mobile app interfaces, multiple languages, and is adapted to the country and healthcare specialty requirements. Our stack is composed of Dagster, dbt, Google Cloud Platform, BigQuery, and other technologies. We leverage AI ethically across our products to empower patients and health professionals. Discover our AI vision here and learn about our first AI hackathon here ! If you would like to find out more about tech life at Doctolib, feel free to read our latest Medium blog articles ! Who you are Before you read on, if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply. You could be our next teammate if: You have medical skills gained through a diploma or degree that includes medical-domain learning. You have knowledge of data management. You are familiar with medical terminologies such as ICD-10 and SNOMED CT. You have strong spreadsheet skills, including Google Sheets or Excel and the use of formulas. You are attentive to detail and demonstrate rigour in your work. You speak German and English, which is a must have for this role. Nice to have: Experience using AI tools such as Claude. Python programming skills. Additional depth of medical knowledge. Dutch language skills. What we offer A structured and personalized onboarding program through our Doctolib Academy , as well as a wide range of in-house training opportunities and masterclasses throughout the internship. title: Anti-Financial Crime Training Specialist
description: Our mission and customers: We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.8 on Trustpilot, based on 55,000+ reviews. Our culture puts customer satisfaction at the core of what we do, as proven by our Net Promoter Score of 75 (more about our culture here ). Our journey: Founded in 2017 by Alexandre and Steve , Qonto has grown to 1,700 Qontoers serving over 750,000 customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started. Our beliefs: We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, of which 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit. AI at Qonto: AI is deeply embedded in how we work ( here ) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it. ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ Join us as a Financial Crime Training Specialist to help protect Qonto by sharing essential financial crime prevention knowledge across our European markets. You will work closely with Joseph, our current Training Specialist, who has built and delivered our AML/CFT training program to employees across all levels of the organization. ➡️ What you’ll do • Design and deliver engaging training content for diverse audiences across all Qonto markets • Help shape the future of our training program by contributing to our digital learning initiatives • Conduct specialized training for FinCrime teams , including hands-on shadowing sessions • Collaborate with Risk & Compliance teams to maintain up-to-date training materials • Deliver and track completion of mandatory regulatory training sessions across the organization ➡️ What we’re looking for • Financial Crime Expertise : You have over 3 years of experience in AML/CFT operations, either from a fintech or traditional banking background. This practical knowledge is essential for creating relevant training content. • Communication Skills : You can explain complex regulatory concepts clearly and engagingly, adapting your style to different audiences and language levels. • Language Proficiency : You are fluent in English and ideally another European language (French, Italian or German is a plus), with excellent presentation skills in your native language. • Training Mindset : While prior training experience is valuable, we're more interested in your ability to share knowledge effectively and your enthusiasm for teaching others. • Analytical Thinking : You can process complex regulatory information and transform it into digestible, engaging content for various audiences. ➡️ What we can offer you • Market/Team Context : You'll join our FinCrime Central team at a pivotal time as we expand across Europe. You'll work in a dynamic environment where regulatory requirements and financial crime trends constantly evolve. • Training Impact : As a regulated financial institution, training is crucial to our compliance. Your role ensures we meet our regulatory obligations while making complex topics engaging and accessible to all employees. • Diverse Stakeholder Interaction : You'll work with multiple departments including Sales, Customer Success, Product teams, and Risk & Compliance, adapting your communication style to each audience. • Tools & Methods : You'll combine live training sessions with modern learning management systems, helping us scale our training program while maintaining high engagement levels. ➡️ Your future manager Your manager will be Joseph , our Financial Security Officer who joined Qonto to lead and transform our Financial Crime Training function. • His background? Joseph has spent several years at Qonto, first as an AML-CFT Analyst and, as a Financial Security Officer Trainer. There he analyses companies’ transactional flows, handles AML-CFT alerts and has trained several teams on financial security practices, helping to spread compliance expertise as the company scaled. Before Qonto, he spent three years at CIBC in Toronto, moving from card-products customer support into National Risk Monitoring, where he investigated unusual transactional activity. • What does he bring to the team? This is a unique opportunity to join Qonto at an exciting time and work closely with a manager who combines strong regulatory expertise with a modern approach to compliance training. About the role We are looking for a motivated engineering intern to join our Combustion Devices team and contribute to the development of engineering tools supporting the design and analysis of liquid rocket engine injectors. During this internship, you will work on computational tools to automate and accelerate the preliminary design and assessment of injector configurations. Your work will focus on three main areas: Injector layout & manifold modelling: develop tools to automate injector element layouts and associated fuel and oxidiser manifolds, based on geometrical, fluid-dynamic and engineering design rules. Injector spray-pattern visualisation: develop a qualitative visualisation of spray/jet directions, cone angles, spatial coverage and interactions between neighbouring injector elements. Face-plate thermal assessment: contribute to a physics-based methodology to assess thermal loads based on injector configuration, local mixture ratio, spray angle, injection conditions and combustion behaviour. The developed tools will support the team in rapidly comparing injector configurations, identifying potential performance and thermal risks, and improving the overall preliminary design process. Key Responsibilities Review existing injector design methodologies, engineering rules and relevant technical literature. Develop algorithms for automated injector layout and fuel/oxidiser manifold generation. Implement engineering models and methodologies in MATLAB and Python . Develop an injector spray-pattern visualisation tool. Develop preliminary models to assess injector face-plate thermal loads. Use relevant parameters such as injector configuration, local mixture ratio, spray angle and injection/combustion conditions. Define relevant CFD analysis needs and interpret available CFD and experimental data. Validate models and tools against available analytical, numerical, experimental or literature data. Document methodologies, assumptions, limitations and recommendations for future development and integration into the Combustion Devices design process. What you need to be successful Final-year student or recent graduate in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Energy Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science, Software Engineering , or a related technical field. Strong programming skills, particularly in MATLAB and Python . Good understanding of: Fluid mechanics Thermodynamics and heat transfer Numerical methods and computational modelling Experience with data processing, numerical analysis or scientific computing. Ability to translate physical and engineering requirements into computational models and algorithms. Ability to analyse numerical results and identify relevant physical trends. Critical thinking when assessing modelling assumptions and engineering correlations. Interest in rocket propulsion, combustion devices and liquid-propellant injection systems . Fluent written and spoken English. Soft Skills Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Autonomous, structured and methodical approach. Curiosity and willingness to explore unfamiliar technical topics. Ability to collaborate within a multicultural and multidisciplinary engineering team. Good technical communication and documentation skills. Attention to detail and critical thinking. Nice to have Any of the following would be a plus, but is not required : Experience with liquid rocket engine injectors, combustion chambers or other combustion systems. Knowledge of coaxial, impinging-jet, swirl or pintle injectors. Knowledge of multiphase flows, sprays, atomisation or propellant mixing. Knowledge of combustion physics, reacting flows or turbulent heat transfer. Experience with thermal modelling or heat-transfer correlations. Experience with CFD tools, post-processing or interpretation of reacting-flow/heat-transfer simulations. Experience analysing parameters such as local mixture ratio, spray angle, wall heat flux or wall temperature. Experience developing engineering correlations from numerical or experimental data. Experience with geometrical algorithms, optimisation or automated engineering design tools. Experience developing graphical interfaces or engineering visualisation tools. Familiarity with Git or other version-control tools. Expected internship outcomes By the end of the internship, you will have contributed to: A functional MATLAB/Python tool for automated injector layout and manifold definition. An injector spray-pattern visualisation tool . A preliminary physics-based methodology for assessing injector face-plate thermal loads . Validation of the developed methodologies against available literature, CFD, experimental or reference data. Technical documentation covering the tools, methodologies, assumptions, limitations and recommendations for future integration. Supervision and collaboration You will be supervised by an engineer from the Combustion Devices team and collaborate closely with the future users of the tools. Technical priorities, verification cases and acceptance criteria will be reviewed regularly to ensure that the tools address practical engineering needs. Not hitting every requirement? title: Product & Operations Management Apprentice
description: Hi, we’re Back Market. We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new . We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new. Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have. Are you ready to join us? JOB DESCRIPTION: Back Market is the world’s leading refurbished electronics marketplace, with a team of 650 people powering operations across 18 countries and counting. Our mission is simple: empowering people to consume tech more sustainably by offering a high-quality, accessible and more eco-friendly alternative to buying new electronics. Be part of an exciting and growing international adventure that is changing the way the world consumes tech. We are looking for a curious, organized and proactive Product & Business Operations Apprentice to join our Partnerships team . The Partnerships team works with telecom, retail and other strategic partners to make refurbished technology more accessible to customers. We manage a growing portfolio of partnerships, launch new commercial opportunities and continuously improve the customer journeys and operating processes that support them. This apprenticeship is an opportunity to work at the intersection of Product, Business Operations, Partnerships, Analytics and Commercial Operations . You will help the team scale its operating model by taking ownership of structured recurring activities, supporting launches and experiments, and identifying opportunities to improve our processes. YOUR MISSION (IF YOU ACCEPT IT): 🥇 Monitor partnership health by updating dashboards, reviewing customer journeys, tracking incidents and preparing portfolio summaries. Contribute to new partnership features and drive continuous improvement by managing product partnership initiatives, documenting requirements, coordinating delivery and contributing to experiments. Coordinate launch and QA activities, including test plans and launch-readiness updates. Support business operations through reporting, basic analysis, meeting follow-ups, documentation and invoicing reconciliation. Be an active part in onboarding new partners to Back Market. Contribute to new partnership projects by researching potential partners, preparing benchmarks and helping improve or automate recurring processes. TOOLS YOU’LL USE: ⚒️ Google Workspace, especially Google Sheets and Google Slides, Slack, Jira, Confluence, Tableau or other business intelligence tools, and internal Back Market tools. YOU ARE IN THE RIGHT PLACE IF: ⭐ You are enrolled in a French higher-education programme that includes an apprenticeship contract. You are looking for a multi-year apprenticeship, ideally in product management, business operations, partnerships, analytics, business, engineering or a related field. You are fluent in both written and spoken French and English, as we are an international team. This is mandatory. You are organized, rigorous and comfortable managing several topics at the same time. You enjoy working with data, spreadsheets and recurring reports, and can identify trends or discrepancies. You take ownership, ask good questions and follow through on commitments. You are a clear and structured communicator who enjoys coordinating with different stakeholders. You are curious and comfortable switching between detailed execution and a broader understanding of business objectives. You are interested in product, partnerships, e-commerce, telecom, marketplaces or business operations. You enjoy improving processes rather than simply repeating them. You are comfortable learning new tools and working in an evolving environment. You have a strong team spirit and enjoy collaborating with Product, Engineering, Finance, Analytics, Operations and customer-facing teams. Bonus points if: You have previous experience in product management, business operations, project management, partnerships or analytics. You have worked with dashboards, QA processes, experiments or reporting workflows. You have used automation or no-code tools. You have experience in e-commerce, telecom, retail or marketplace environments. ABOUT THE APPRENTICESHIP ℹ️ Starting date: January 2027 Duration: Ideally for 12 months (24months to be discussed). Location: Bordeaux, France Contract: You must already be enrolled in a work-study program in a French school (contrat d'alternance / d'apprentissage) RECRUITMENT PROCESS: 📅 HR Interview with Campus Recruitment Manager Interview with the Hiring Manager focused on your motivation, organization and analytical approach. Team/Cultural fit interview with with stakeholders from tech and data. WHY SHOULD YOU JOIN US ? ✌🏼 At Back Market, we’re committed to hiring and supporting diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives — it’s one of the reasons we’re such a high-scoring certified B Corp company (93.2). No matter your role and seniority level, you’ll enjoy impact-driven work with hands-on career development in an innovative, driven, and fast-paced environment — with benefits to match, like: - A mission driven work environment where your day to day makes an impact on the planet. Seriously. - Hybrid work environment, with 2 remote days a week and 1 remote work week per quarter, plus 3 flex days. - Employee Resource Groups, including mentorship programs, comprehensive accessibility policies, and cultural competency training. At Back Market, we strive to create a workplace that embodies the world we’re trying to change. We’ve embedded our diversity, equity, and inclusion principles into our DNA — from dedicated staff to employee resource groups to our company values. We know that the perfect background for a role doesn’t mean the perfect fit — we encourage you to apply for a role even if you think you may not have all the qualifications. If reasonable accommodations are needed for the interview process, please do not hesitate to discuss this with the Talent Acquisition Team. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Data Engineer
description: De IT-afdeling van Den Hartogh (25 collega's) werkt als één team aan de groei en doelstellingen van ons familiebedrijf, verdeeld over clusters als IT Operations, Architecture & Security en Data Integration & Analytics. Als Data Engineer binnen dat laatste cluster help je de business proactief bij het behalen van haar zakelijke en financiële doelen, met data in de breedste zin van het woord. Via applicaties, dashboarding en ad-hocanalyses moderniseer je ons datalandschap, en er is volop ruimte om te innoveren met predictive & generative AI, Data Science en Process Automation (RPA) . Je rapporteert rechtstreeks aan de Teamlead Data Integration & Analytics. Wat ga je doen? Je slaat de brug tussen organisatie en processen enerzijds en techniek anderzijds; Als sparringpartner voor de business til je de managementinformatie naar een hoger niveau, in innovatieve en complexe dataprojecten; Je onderhoudt en breidt onze data pipelines in SQL uit en bouwt een semantisch model ; Je voert ad-hocanalyses uit met SQL (en R) en stimuleert continue verbetering via data- en procesanalyse; Je werkt nauw samen met data professionals om de bruikbaarheid van interne en externe data te verbeteren. Jij bent onze ideale kandidaat als je: Een bachelor of master hebt in Technische Bedrijfskunde, Business IT & Management, Data Science, Analytics of vergelijkbaar; Minimaal 4 jaar ervaring hebt in een vergelijkbare functie én minimaal 4 jaar met SQL ; Sterk bent in SQL, DAX, dimensioneel modelleren, data vault modeling, versiebeheer en Scrum ; Uitstekend communiceert in Nederlands en Engels (woord en geschrift) en een scherpe, kritische blik hebt, daarnaast durf je tegen de business aan te schuren; Proactief en resultaatgericht bent, met een sterke drive om te blijven verbeteren en jezelf te ontwikkelen; Pré : 2+ jaar ervaring met Machine Learning-modellen, geavanceerde Power BI-kennis en ervaring met het implementeren van AI-modellen in een organisatie. Wat bieden wij? Een salaris tussen € 4.000,- en € 5.400,- bruto per maand (naar kennis en ervaring), plus laptop en telefoon van de zaak, 30 vakantiedagen (o.b.v. fulltime), 8% vakantiegeld , een feestdagengratificatie van € 550,- bruto, reiskostenvergoeding en een goede pensioenregeling; Ruimte om te ondernemen : een uitdagende functie met veel zelfstandigheid, flexibiliteit en verantwoordelijkheid, binnen een groeiende en informele organisatie met ambitieuze doelen; Hybride werken vanuit ons Basecamp in Rotterdam (bij fulltime 3 dagen kantoor, 2 thuis): een moderne werkomgeving met uitzicht over de Waterweg, een inhouse gym, restaurant en de Den Hartogh Academy met meer dan 500 trainingen; Een internationale, maar familiaire werkomgeving, met betrokken collega's van over de hele wereld; Oog voor elkaar : een fijne werksfeer, een caring- en vitaliteitsbudget en toegang tot Benefits at Work met aantrekkelijke kortingen. title: Senior Account Manager
description: Op duizenden werkvloeren in Nederland wordt dagelijks gewerkt met gevaarlijke stoffen. Dat kan veilig, als je weet wat je in huis hebt, wat het doet en welke regels erbij horen. Daar helpt Sdu Toxic organisaties bij. Toxic is de meest complete SaaS-oplossing voor wet- en regelgeving rond gevaarlijke stoffen in Nederland. Organisaties registreren er hun stoffen mee, beoordelen blootstelling, leggen maatregelen vast en informeren hun medewerkers. Zo helpen we QHSE-professionals om mensen veilig te laten werken en aan de arbowetgeving te voldoen. Achter Toxic staat een team met diepgaande kennis van chemische producten en de regels die erbij horen. En een succesvol marketing- en salesteam dat zorgt dat steeds meer organisaties ons vinden. Toxic is onderdeel van Lefebvre Sdu, dat al 200 jaar bouwt aan juridische en fiscale kennis, en van Lefebvre Group, de Europese leider op dat gebied. De vraag groeit. Onze Commercieel Medewerkers Binnendienst en marketing plannen meer afspraken in dan we nu kunnen afronden. Daarom zoeken we een Senior Accountmanager die van die gesprekken klanten maakt. HOE JIJ ONS VERDER BRENGT Jij bent het gezicht van Toxic. Voor de veiligheidskundigen, managers en directies die met ons werken, word jij degene die ze kennen en vertrouwen. Je leert hun organisatie kennen, luistert naar wat er speelt en denkt mee over wat ze nodig hebben. Zo bouw je relaties die jaren meegaan, en groeit Toxic met je klanten mee. Je leert je klanten kennen: hun mensen, hun processen en wat er bij hen speelt. Zo word je hun vaste gesprekspartner en denk je mee over de volgende stap. Elke nieuwe relatie begint met een goed gesprek. De binnendienst en marketing plannen de afspraken, jij bereidt je voor en ontdekt wat een organisatie nodig heeft. Daarnaast zoek je zelf nieuwe kansen. In je demo's laat je zien hoe Toxic werkt en wat het oplevert. Gaat de vraag verder dan het standaardplatform? Dan werk je met collega's een oplossing op maat uit, met API-koppelingen en AI-toepassingen. Je bouwt relaties met veiligheidskundigen, inkopers en directie, brengt hun belangen samen in 1 voorstel en sluit deals met een hogere dealwaarde. Met strategische accountplannen houd je overzicht op je belangrijkste klanten. Je ziet kansen voor up- en cross-sell en herkent retentierisico's vroeg. Samen met Customer Success zorg je dat nieuwe klanten goed starten. Je houdt je pipeline en forecast actueel in Salesforce en deelt wat je bij klanten hoort met marketing en product. Als senior ben je mentor en sparringpartner voor collega-accountmanagers. DIT ZOEKEN WIJ Je bent iemand bij wie klanten zich gehoord voelen. Je luistert goed, stelt de juiste vragen en vertaalt een complex vraagstuk naar een helder voorstel. De markt van gevaarlijke stoffen hoef je nog niet te kennen. Wat je wel meebrengt, is ervaring met het opbouwen van klantrelaties en interesse in software. Je hebt meerdere jaren ervaring als accountmanager, bij voorkeur in SaaS of met digitale oplossingen. Je hebt interesse in software en wilt begrijpen hoe een platform als Toxic werkt, inclusief API-koppelingen en AI-toepassingen. Je bouwt relaties met meerdere stakeholders tegelijk en beheerst het volledige salesproces, van eerste kennismaking tot getekend contract. Je stuurt op data en haalt je targets, met nieuwe klanten en binnen je eigen portefeuille. Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands. Je hoeft de markt nog niet te kennen. Klanten, stoffen en regelgeving leer je bij ons, van collega's die het vak door en door kennen. HIER TEKEN JE VOOR Je tekent voor een rol die past bij je ambitie. Je werkt aan grotere deals, bouwt je eigen netwerk op en ontwikkelt je in een groeiend SaaS-team. Dat doe je binnen Lefebvre Sdu, een legaltechbedrijf met 200 jaar kennis en de energie van een scale-up. Dit krijg je ervoor terug: Een inwerkperiode waarin je Toxic, de markt en onze klanten leert kennen. Een plek waar je vanaf dag 1 invloed hebt op de aanpak, de processen en de richting. Collega's met diepgaande kennis van stoffen en regelgeving, van wie je elke dag leert. Doorgroeimogelijkheden naar Teamlead, Key Accountmanager of Propositiemanager. Een salaris vanaf €4.477 per maand, op basis van een werkweek van 36 uur. Een variabele bonusregeling die kan oplopen tot 30% van je jaarsalaris. 23 vakantiedagen en een persoonlijk keuzebudget van 12%, waarvan 8% vakantiegeld en 4% vrij besteedbaar aan extra vakantiedagen of salaris. Een goede pensioenregeling via PGB, inclusief aanvullende partnerverzekering. Een leaseauto of een reiskostenvergoeding van €0,25 per kilometer, en een aantrekkelijke fietsregeling. Voor een reisafstand onder de 10 km of boven de 60 km geldt een aangepaste regeling. Thuiswerkvergoeding en hybride werken: reken op 2 dagen per week op kantoor in Den Haag. MEER WETEN? Benieuwd hoe Toxic werkt? Kijk alvast op toxic.nl/en. We vertellen je graag meer over het team en de rol. Stuur je cv en je hoort binnen 2 werkdagen van ons. Eerst nog vragen? title: Stage - Juriste chargé·e de recouvrement / contentieux

title: Inside Sales Representative
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: London, the UK</strong></p> <p><strong>About the role</strong></p> <p>The Inside Sales Representative (ISR) is a critical sales role responsible for driving high-volume, high-velocity net new business acquisition sales in a remote selling model within the commercial segment across EMEA, specifically UKI. Operating as full-cycle territory owners similar to an AE, ISR manages the end-to-end sales process from self-sourcing pipeline, qualifying opportunities and closing deals in partnership with SE and Partner Organisation.</p> <h4><strong>What you'll do</strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>Build your own pipeline:</strong> Find new business across your assigned territory (UKI) through high-volume outreach by phone, email, LinkedIn and social selling, using tools like Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo and AI outreach</li> <li><strong>Run the whole sales cycle remotely:</strong> Lead discovery and qualification calls using MEDDPIC, give engaging virtual presentations and live product demos, and negotiate and close new business against an ACV quota.</li> <li><strong>Explain the value of Cloudflare's platform:</strong> Connect commercial-segment customers' business and technical problems to the right Cloudflare products, such as Application Security and Performance, Zero Trust/SASE and the Developer Platform, and show the value they'd get.</li> <li><strong>Work closely with other teams:</strong> Partner with Solutions Engineers on technical validation, and with the Partner Organisation to co-sell and close deals faster. Work with Marketing and BDR teammates on campaigns and events that create pipeline.</li> <li><strong>Run your territory with data:</strong> Keep your Salesforce pipeline accurate and your forecasts reliable, track your activity and conversion numbers, and use what you learn to consistently meet or exceed your targets</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience:</strong></h4> <ul> <li>1 - 3 years of experience in a sales role, preferably in SaaS or tech sales, such as: </li> <ul> <li>BDR/SDR background with strong outbound experience in a high-paced environment</li> <li>SMB or Transactional sales experience with high volume, high velocity sales motion</li> </ul> <li>Strong track record of meeting or exceeding quota </li> <li>Strong discovery and qualification skills using frameworks like BANT, MEDDIC </li> <li>Excellent presentation and interpersonal communication skills (verbal and written) as well as time management skill</li> <li>Experience using CRM like Salesforce, outbound/prospecting sales tools (e.g. LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, Salesforce Sales Engagement Outreach etc)</li> <li>Tech-savvy and technically curious - quick to learn technical products, comfortable to run live demos independently, data-driven mindset  </li> <li>Highly accountable and self-driven, customer-centric individuals</li> <li>Multilingual abilities (depending on the coverage regions)</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Lead Acquisition B2C
description: Green-Got en bref Green-Got est une alternative complète et moderne aux grandes banques, du paiement à l'investissement. En finance, on ne construit pas à côté du système. Nous y prenons du pouvoir pour en changer la direction. Ce que nous refusons : nous excluons strictement l'expansion fossile, sur tous nos produits. Et notre assurance-vie et notre PER, c'est zéro financement d'entreprise dans le pesticide. Ce que nous dévoilons : ce que les banques traditionnelles font de l'argent de leurs clients. Et nous sommes transparents jusque sur nos propres limites. Ce que nous construisons : les paiements de nos membres financent des enquêtes, du lobbying et du plaidoyer qui s'attaquent aux causes. Les banques ont des lobbyistes ; nos membres en ont un aussi. Quelques repères : Plus de 3 milliards d'euros déjà passés par les comptes et les cartes de nos membres 150 M€ d'épargne sous gestion 15 millions d'euros levés auprès de notre communauté, à chaque fois en un temps record Pourquoi ce poste compte autant. Chaque compte ouvert envoie un message aux grandes banques : le marché a changé. Et plus nous grandissons, plus nous pesons. Notre ambition est assumée : devenir un actionnaire qui pèse au conseil des entreprises qui freinent la transition. Nous commencerons une fois le cap du milliard d'euros d'épargne franchi. Entre nos 150 M€ et ce milliard, il y a ton travail. Le poste Tu prends en main toute l'acquisition B2C haut de funnel de Green-Got : faire venir de nouvelles personnes sur notre app, et les amener à ouvrir un compte ou à investir. Tu as deux grands objectifs : les ouvertures de compte (compte + carte de paiement) et la collecte (investissement). Notre north star, c'est l'ARR : ce qui compte, c'est ce que tu rapportes vraiment à la boîte, pas le nombre de clics. Tu ne pars pas de zéro. Nos canaux existent et tournent déjà. Ton job : les reprendre, les améliorer, les scaler, et en inventer de nouveaux. Le budget que tu pilotes se compte en centaines de milliers d'euros. On cherche un doeur, pas un stratège qui délègue. Tu mets les mains dans le cambouis, tu testes, tu shippes, et tu n'attends pas qu'on te dise quoi lancer. Ce que tu vas faire Site et trafic : tu es autonome sur le site. Landing pages, SEO, GEO, CRO, A/B tests. Acquisition payante : Google Ads, Meta et autres réseaux sociaux. Ciblage, créas, landing, tests, optimisation, toujours pilotés par le chiffre d'affaires final. Affiliation : tu trouves, négocies et pilotes nos partenaires. Tu contrôles ce qu'ils font, tu mesures ce qui marche vraiment et tu arbitres le budget, sans tout miser sur un seul levier. Budget et rentabilité : tu répartis le budget entre les canaux selon ce qu'ils rapportent, et tu le réorientes quand il le faut. Tracking : tu t'assures que tout ce que tu lances est mesuré correctement. Tu peux te faire aider sur la partie technique. Opérations avec l'équipe Wealth Management : tu lances avec elle les opérations sur nos produits d'investissement. Nouveaux leviers : tu imagines et testes des canaux auxquels personne n'a encore pensé. Une personne, des agents IA Pendant des années, une règle a joué contre nous : pour rivaliser avec une banque, il fallait ses effectifs, ses agences et ses milliards. Cette règle vient de tomber. L'intelligence artificielle ne récompense pas la taille. Elle récompense les organisations alignées, rapides et capables de décider. C'est l'asymétrie du renard, et pour la première fois elle joue pour nous : elle nous permet d'avoir dans dix ans l'impact que nous devions avoir dans cent. Pendant ce temps, les quatre grandes banques françaises portent 260 milliards d'euros d'actifs fossiles, et chaque mois que nous perdons est un mois qu'elles gagnent. C'est pourquoi tu seras une personne autonome, épaulée par un agent IA pour chaque canal (site, GEO, affiliation, ads…). Notre stack est très moderne, car nous n'avons pas d'autre choix que de nous décupler pour peser. L'équipe autour de toi Chez Green-Got, l'acquisition est une boucle complète portée par des profils complémentaires : Awareness : l’équipe qui fait connaître Green-Got au plus grand nombre Acquisition haut de funnel : toi CRM et Product Growth : ceux qui transforment et activent les personnes que tu amènes Tu travailles main dans la main avec le CRM, avec le Product Growth et avec l'équipe Wealth Management. Tu es rattaché au Head of Growth, qui est là pour te mentorer, t'aider et te guider. Notre Head of Growth, Clément Jaunault, fait de la growth depuis dix ans, de la legaltech au SaaS. Arrivé chez Green-Got avant le lancement, il l'a fait passer de 0 à 100 000 utilisateurs et de 0 à 300 M€ d'encours, et il mentore déjà de jeunes growth hors de l'entreprise. Ton profil Indispensable Au moins 2 ans d'expérience en acquisition, growth ou traffic management (tes side projects comptent) Tu es un faiseur : tu livres, tu shippes, tu passes vite d'un sujet à l'autre Tu es data driven. Tu as de l'instinct, mais tu valides tout avec la data. Tu utilises l’IA au quotidien et tu as déjà construit des outils ou des automatisations avec. Tu es autonome, débrouillard et problem solver : face à un problème, tu trouves une solution Tu as un mindset business : tu raisonnes en chiffre d'affaires, pas en vanity metrics Tu t'intéresses vraiment à la finance. Tu es sensible aux enjeux d'écologie, de transition à l'échelle française et européenne, et de santé Tu es créatif, proactif, organisé et rigoureux Tu parles anglais Ce qui nous fera vraiment craquer Tu as déjà lancé tes propres projets : une boutique e-commerce, un site d'affiliation, des side projects. Tu as tenté des choses. Tu viens d'agence, mais tu as des projets à côté et tu veux maintenant aller plus loin : un seul annonceur, beaucoup de budget, de vrais résultats à porter. Tu as déjà travaillé dans la finance ou la fintech, et tu connais les règles de la communication sur les produits financiers. Ce poste n'est probablement pas pour toi si… Tu préfères concevoir la stratégie et laisser d'autres l'exécuter Tu présentes tes résultats en clics, en impressions ou en leads sans te soucier du resultat final Tu attends qu'on te dise quoi faire et quoi tester Ce qu'on t'offre Un package entre 52 et 62 k€ (fixe + variable) et des BSPCE Paris, avec 1 jour de télétravail par semaine Mutuelle santé Alan Un vrai budget, de vrais canaux qui tournent déjà, et la liberté de les faire grandir Un mentor en interne et une équipe aux compétences complémentaires Un métier qui fait bouger l'argent dans le bon sens Le process Un exercice à faire chez toi Un call avec le Head of Growth et le lead CRM Un entretien avec le Head of Brand Un entretien avec la CMO Un entretien avec le CEO Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Spécialiste Support Services Financiers (Télétravail complet possible depuis Marseille)
description: Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ? Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance. Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière. Notre vision Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes. Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise. Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients. À propos de Pennylane Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen. En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à : 💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant 💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches! 🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible 🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours 🚀 Déjà plus de 900,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France ! Pourquoi ce rôle est-il si important chez nous ? En tant que Spécialiste Support Services Financiers, tu te positionnes comme un expert métier et plateforme. Tu es l'interlocuteur privilégié de notre base clients qui a choisi Pennylane comme logiciel central de leur gestion comptable et financière. Tu te trouves donc au cœur de l'expérience client 360 et fais profiter les clients et leurs comptables de la pleine puissance de Pennylane au service de leur croissance. Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ? En tant que membre de l'équipe Support applicatif et technique, tu es le point de relais central entre nos clients Dirigeants, leurs Comptables internalisés et l'équipe Support. Tu es en contact quotidien avec les utilisateurs et cherches à comprendre les problèmes qu'ils rencontrent. Après investigation, ton but est d'apporter une réponse ou solution à ton interlocuteur, ou quand cela est nécessaire, d'escalader le problème aux équipes techniques. Quelles seront tes missions au quotidien ? 3 premiers mois : - Tu intègres la CSM Academy et tu te formes en continu sur le produit et les rouages de l'équipe. - Tu apprends tout ce qu'il faut savoir sur notre entreprise, notre vision, et nos différents départements. - Tu apprends à identifier toutes les parties prenantes et à collaborer efficacement au sein de ton équipe, ainsi qu'avec les différents départements. - Tu commences à répondre à des demandes des clients liées à nos services financiers : tu réceptionnes les demandes, les qualifies et apportes des réponses rapides et impactantes. 4 à 6 mois : - Tu gagnes en autonomie et prends intégralement les commandes de ton portefeuille client. - Tu commences à gérer des demandes clients de plus en plus complexes. - Tu contribues à la création et à l’actualisation des supports d’aide à disposition du client afin de développer leur autonomie. - Tu partages à tes collègues tes connaissances comptables et ton expérience "terrain". - Tu portes la voix et l’usage du client et partages aux équipes produit des retours construits. Et ensuite... : - Tu deviens un expert produit et fais gagner en efficacité ton équipe en identifiant les axes d'amélioration - Tu prends le contrôle et mènes au succès des projets qui te tiennent à cœur et qui te font progresser Profil recherché - Expérience de plusieurs années au sein d’une “néo-banque”, d’une banque en ligne ou d’une banque traditionnelle. - Excellente compréhension du système bancaire. - Expérience précédente en support B2B requise. - À l’aise avec des échanges téléphoniques quotidiens avec les clients. - Un travail en direct avec le dirigeant est un plus (conseil interne par exemple). - Disponible pour des horaires roulants et adaptés aux besoins des clients. - Un intérêt pour la technologie est un plus avec notamment la connaissance des produits des Fintech actuelles du marché. Poste ouvert au télétravail avec 2 jours de déplacements à Paris au sein de nos locaux par mois (frais pris en charge). Process de recrutement - Entretien en visio avec Simon Peraldo - Senior Recruiter (30 min) - Entretien en visio avec Vincent Lambert - Responsable de l’équipe (1h) - Dernier échange visio avec Johan Chrzanosvski - Head of Customer Care, et Maxime Leclercq - Head of Financial Services (45 min) 🎁 Ce que l’on peut t'offrir : 🏥 Une mutuelle parmi les meilleures sur le marché (Alan Blue et Alan Mind) 🍜 Des tickets restaurants (Carte Swile) 🏝 Entre 6 et 12 jours de RTT supplémentaires aux 5 semaines de congés payés 🇬🇧 La possibilité de perfectionner ton anglais grâce à Busuu 🧑‍💻 Un budget dédié chaque mois pour tous nos Pennylaners, favorisant le travail depuis la maison ou en espace de coworking 🏢 Une facilité d’accès à nos bureaux, situés à quelques minutes de Saint Lazare en plein cœur de Paris 💵 Une enveloppe de BSPCE 🏃‍♀️ Un accès à 8000 salles de sport partout en France et plus de 300 activités de bien-être via notre partenaire Gymlib 💻 Un Mac 🎉 Nous pratiquons de nombreux sports ensemble et avons à cœur de nous réunir régulièrement autour d’événements d’entreprise tels que les Tech Days (qui permettent aux Pennylaners en remote de se réunir tous les 3 mois) ou notre séminaire d’entreprise qui a lieu une fois par an, et qui favorise de grands moments de cohésion pour toutes et tous. Pour t'épanouir chez Pennylane, il faudra: -Parler anglais (le niveau est évalué et apprécié en fonction du département auquel tu postules) -Apprécier travailler dans un environnement en changement constant -Faire de la collaboration une priorité au sein de son équipe ou avec d'autres parties prenantes -Avoir un recul suffisant pour prioriser les actions à fort impact business dans son activité quotidienne. Nous savons que certaines personnes sont moins susceptibles de postuler que d'autres si elles estiment ne pas remplir l'intégralité des critères. Si tu hésites, nous t'encourageons à postuler quand même : qui sait, cela pourrait être le début d'une collaboration significative et durable ! Information importante à destination des candidat(e)s Les tentatives d’arnaque au recrutement sont en hausse. Nous vous invitons à rester vigilant(e) lors de vos échanges. Candidature uniquement via nos canaux officiels : postulez exclusivement via nos offres publiées sur nos supports officiels (site carrière, pages officielles partenaires). Vérifiez systématiquement l’adresse e-mail de l’expéditeur : nos communications sont envoyées depuis des adresses professionnelles avec les domaine @ pennylane.com ou ----- . Nous ne vous demanderons jamais de paiement, ni d’informations financières (coordonnées bancaires, paiement pour un entretien, achat de matériel, etc.) dans le cadre du recrutement. Si une telle demande vous est faite, il s’agit d’une fraude. Nous vous invitons à ne pas répondre et à nous le signaler immédiatement ." Encourageant la diversité, équité et inclusion sous toutes ses formes, Pennylane offre un environnement de travail inclusif, bienveillant et propice à l’épanouissement, dans nos bureaux et en remote. Nous nous engageons à fournir les mêmes chances à tous nos candidats, indépendamment de leurs origines sociales et ethniques, genres, religions, orientations sexuelles ou handicaps. 🇫🇷 Données personnelles Pennylane traite vos données pour gérer votre candidature et évaluer votre adéquation au poste. Si votre candidature n’aboutit pas, vos données peuvent être conservées 2 ans à compter de notre dernier échange ou de la clôture du recrutement afin de constituer & gérer un vivier de candidats. Vous pouvez vous opposer à tout moment et demander la suppression de vos données en écrivant à : Notre data policy 🇬🇧 Personal Data Pennylane processes your data to manage your application and assess your suitability for the position. If your application is unsuccessful, your data may be retained for 2 years from our last exchange or the closing of the recruitment process, in order to build and manage a candidate pool. You may object at any time and request the deletion of your data by writing to Learn more 🇩🇪 Personenbezogene Daten Pennylane verarbeitet Ihre Daten, um Ihre Bewerbung zu bearbeiten und Ihre Eignung für die Stelle zu beurteilen. Sollte Ihre Bewerbung nicht erfolgreich sein, können Ihre Daten bis zu 2 Jahre ab unserem letzten Austausch oder dem Abschluss des Rekrutierungsverfahrens gespeichert werden, um einen Kandidatenpool aufzubauen und zu verwalten. Sie können jederzeit Widerspruch einlegen und die Löschung Ihrer Daten beantragen, indem Sie an Mehr erfahren 🇪🇸 Datos personales Pennylane trata sus datos para gestionar su candidatura y evaluar su idoneidad para el puesto. En caso de que su candidatura no sea seleccionada, sus datos podrán conservarse hasta 2 años a partir de nuestro último contacto o de la finalización del proceso de selección, con el fin de constituir y gestionar una reserva de candidatos. Puede oponerse en cualquier momento y solicitar la eliminación de sus datos escribiendo a Más información Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow
