title: Production & ESG Data Engineer
description: Are you passionate about data, technology and sustainability? ONE-Dyas is looking for a Production & ESG Data Engineer to ensure the accurate collection, administration and reporting of production, hydrocarbon and ESG data. You will turn complex data into reliable insights that support operational and business decisions. What will you do? · Maintain and improve databases containing validated production and ESG data. · Collect and integrate data from production sources and operated and non-operated assets. · Prepare clear monthly, quarterly and annual reports and visualizations. · Support Production, Engineering, HSE and ESG teams with data supporting operational and business decisions. · Explore opportunities for automation, machine learning and AI to improve collection, administration and reporting. · A bachelor’s level in Engineering, Accounting, Computer Science, Environmental Sciences or a related field. · Experience in data engineering or ESG reporting, preferably within the energy or oil & gas industry. · Knowledge of database management, data visualization and data governance. · Preferably experience with Python, SQL or similar tools. · Strong communication and problem-solving skills. · A proactive, independent and team-oriented approach with an interest in sustainability. Meet ONE-Dyas ONE-Dyas B.V. is the largest privately owned exploration and production company in the Netherlands. As entrepreneurs in Dutch offshore gas and oil, the company aims to make a significant contribution to the energy transition, working at the forefront of sustainability and technological innovation. Extracting gas and oil close to home contributes to the national economy, security of supply, and climate goals by employing local services, products, and know-how, reducing the reliance on imported fuels, cutting emissions, and complying to the highest environmental standards in the industry. With its roots dating back to 1893 in the mining industry, ONE-Dyas has a long history of successfully pioneering energy solutions. Today, its operations span the full lifecycle of offshore assets in the Netherlands, Germany and the UK, including the flagship N05-A development project in the Dutch and German part of the North Sea, set to be the first of its kind to integrate natural gas, wind power and green hydrogen. ONE-Dyas is also actively exploring carbon capture and storage, and green hydrogen opportunities as future energy solutions. Headquartered on the Zuid-as in Amsterdam with around 150 employees, ONE-Dyas has a strong entrepreneurial culture, short lines across all disciplines and a strong relationship with its shareholders leading to a focused and effective work environment. ONE-Dyas has an excellent reputation in the Netherlands, the UK and Germany for its experience and skills across the entire oil & gas energy supply chain. ONE-Dyas is known for getting things done safe, reliably and efficiently. Interested? Would you like to contribute to reliable production and ESG reporting at ONE-Dyas? We look forward to hearing from you! You can apply for this position via the application form (see link below). If you have any questions about the position, please contact Gerlof Visser (Head of Production Engineering & HCA): Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Manager, APJC Outreach
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available location: </strong>Singapore</p> <p>Cloudflare is one of the most dynamic and innovative companies providing services on the Internet. Regulation of the Internet is exploding -- across a number of subject areas and jurisdictions -- at a rate previously unseen in the history of the Internet. We’re looking for a new team member who can help foster and promote our corporate philosophy and approach, in which the security and privacy of our customers are paramount. </p> <p>We are looking for an exceptionally talented and energetic person to join our Public Policy team in Singapore, with a strong background in India policy. You will work on some of the most complicated and rapidly evolving policy issues in the world, such as content moderation, user privacy, and intermediary liability, and you’ll help us develop and communicate real-world solutions to addressing these challenges. You will also build and run programs that further Cloudflare’s reputation and standing in the region by partnering with governments, trade bodies, and civil society organisations. This person has a deep understanding of technology as well as regulatory environments. The ideal candidate can seamlessly go from a technical conversation with engineers to a high-level discussion with regulators and policymakers regarding where Cloudflare fits in the Internet stack. This person should be an expert at presenting technical topics at a level any audience will be able to understand.</p> <p>This role has non-standard working hours.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Engage with policymakers, regulators, trade associations, industry partners, civil society groups and others in India and across the APJC region, to educate stakeholders on Cloudflare’s trust & safety processes and policy positions.</li> <li>Lead programs and advocacy campaigns that showcase our policy principles  to demonstrate what a better Internet looks like in practice.</li> <li>Develop talking points, policy narratives and presentation materials for use at external events and meetings and for other communication purposes (company blog, position papers, etc.).</li> <li>Coordinate with cross-functional teams to address government and law enforcement requests, as appropriate.</li> <li>Provide timely updates to colleagues from the Cloudflare Public Policy, Legal, Trust & Safety Teams and other internal stakeholders.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Minimum Qualification</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree or preferably master's degree in public policy, law, economics </li> <li>8+ years of related experience handling law enforcement matters at a large technology company and experience handling public policy issues. </li> <li>Strong understanding of the Indian political, regulatory and legal system and protocols, particularly as they relate to digital services.</li> <li>Experience in designing, running, and managing stakeholder, community, or partnership programs and events (for example, workshops, hackathons, or training programs)</li> <li>Ability and willingness to work off hours, including weekends and holidays, to support emergency matters and interact with globally-based company employees</li> <li>Right to work in Singapore, or eligibility and willingness to relocate to Singapore</li> <li>Ability to analyze technical data and present to a less technical audience</li> <li>An ambitious mindset that enables you to successfully work independently with little guidance, but also to use good judgment and escalate / call out issues when needed.</li> <li>A sense of humor.</li> </ul> <p>Preferred Qualification</p> <ul> <li>Knowledge of Cloudflare products and the broader technology industry, including security, networking, Zero Trust, and AI services.</li> <li>Experience in reviewing, processing, and tracking legal documents, particularly in India (e.g., civil and criminal subpoenas, court orders, and search title: Site Reliability Engineer, Cells Infrastructure
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2>An overview of this role</h2> <p>We're looking for an Intermediate Site Reliability Engineer to join the Cells Infrastructure team in GitLab's Scale & Architecture organization. In this role, you'll help build and operate Cells, the architecture that lets GitLab.com scale horizontally. Cells splits GitLab.com into many independent units, each with its own application and data stack, behind a shared routing layer.</p> <p>This is a build-it-and-run-it role. You'll provision cells, route traffic to them, deploy them safely, and keep them reliable in production. You'll also help move customer organizations onto Cells, one of GitLab's most important scaling initiatives.</p> <h2>What you'll do</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Operate Cells in production: join the on-call rotation, respond to incidents, lead post-incident reviews, and drive corrective actions to completion.</li> <li value="2">Define and monitor service level objectives (SLOs) for routing and cell health, and build the dashboards, alerts, and runbooks behind them.</li> <li value="3">Provision and operate cell infrastructure on Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including Kubernetes, networking, Identity and Access Management (IAM), PostgreSQL, Redis, and object storage.</li> <li value="4">Develop infrastructure as code with Terraform, Helm, and GitOps tooling such as Argo CD.</li> <li value="5">Operate and extend the global routing layer, built on Cloudflare Workers, Envoy, and a Go service backed by Cloud Spanner, and expand routing to more protocols and services.</li> <li value="6">Improve the continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines behind ring-based deployments, covering promotion, database migrations, quality assurance validation, and rollback.</li> <li value="7">Support organization migrations by preparing destination cells and helping with dry runs and production cutovers.</li> <li value="8">Work with product teams to make their services cell-compatible, and write documentation so others can operate Cells with confidence.</li> <li value="8">Take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it.</li> </ul> <h2>What you'll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Professional experience running production infrastructure at scale on AWS, GCP, or both, including Kubernetes, along with strong Terraform and Helm skills.</li> <li value="2">Proficiency in Go, or strong experience in another systems language and willingness to work in Go daily.</li> <li value="3">Solid grounding in site reliability engineering (SRE) best practices: SLOs and error budgets, blameless post-incident reviews, reducing toil through automation, capacity planning, and designing for graceful degradation.</li> <li value="4">Experience owning services in production, including on-call, incident response, and monitoring with tools such as Prometheus and Grafana.</li> <li value="5">Practical knowledge of progressive delivery: how to roll changes safely across a fleet and how to roll them back.</li> <li value="6">A strong understanding of distributed-systems fundamentals, such as request routing, proxies, consistency, and failure domains.</li> <li value="7">Experience working effectively in distributed, all-remote teams: you default to asynchronous, written-first communication, document decisions in issues and merge requests, hand off work cleanly across time zones, and stay transparent about progress and blockers.</li> <li value="8">Experience with Cloudflare, Spanner, Argo CD, TypeScript, or operating GitLab at scale is a plus, not a requirement.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>Every team in our organization owns its services end to end, from design through on-call.We own the control plane that tracks cells and decides where each request belongs, and keep the fleet in step with GitLab's release cadence.We work closely with delivery, database, migration, and product teams across GitLab. Feature teams own how their services behave on the platform; we own the underlying infrastructure.We're an all-remote, asynchronous team. We make decisions in GitLab issues, use directly responsible individuals (DRIs) to own technical direction, demo our work weekly, and use AI-assisted workflows every day.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  </p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#equal-employment-opportunity-policy" target="_blank">GitLab’s EEO Policy</a> and <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/labor-and-employment-notices/#eeoc-us-equal-employment-opportunity-commission-notices" target="_blank">EEO is the Law</a>. If you have a disability or special need that requires <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#reasonable-accommodation" target="_blank">accommodation</a>, please let us know during the <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/interviewing/#adjustments-to-our-interview-process" target="_blank">recruiting process</a>.</p></div>

title: Account Executive - Mid-market - €60–80K + BSPCE
description: Our team shared’s mission is deploy AI agents to transform how patients and doctors connect We believe healthcare shouldn’t be defined by missed calls, endless waiting lines, and overwhelmed staff. Patients and professionals deserve better. Vocca builds AI voice agents that answer every call instantly, schedule and reschedule appointments, and free up staff to focus on what matters most: care. Already trusted by 15 000+ providers, we’re transforming the patient–provider relationship, one call at a time. Want to shape the future of healthcare? Join us ! Discover our company culture and values Here is a product teaser Eliott's interview for Welcome to the jungle Eliott's quick interview for Speedinvest Articles on our A round ( techfundingnews , Maddyness , les echos , our blog ) Context Vocca builds AI voice agents that answer patient calls, book and reschedule appointments, triage emergencies, and free up administrative staff so care teams can focus on care. The product is live and used daily in hundreds of healthcare facilities, just a few months after launch. We are scaling fast: our target is €1M of signed ARR per month by the end of December 2026. The liberal segment (private practices and groups, ~€10–30k ARR per account) needs to contribute heavily. This is a full-cycle new-business role: you own everything from cold outreach to signature, and you build your own territory. Your mission Generate €400k ARR in year one in new business on the liberal segment, owning the full cycle from prospecting to signed deals. Expected outcomes 1 month: Get up to speed on our pitch, our product, and our market (types of centers, buying journey…) Make your first prospecting calls , demos , and initial sales conversations Close your first simple deals independently. 3 months: Build a stable pipeline , with at least 30 active opportunities at different stages Improve our call scripts and email sequences Work closely with the Ops team to ensure smooth deployments Identify weak signals from the field and feed into the product roadmap Full autonomy by month 3 on pitch, product, ICP, and qualification 6-12 months: Manage complex sales cycles (groups, multi-site, multiple stakeholders) Contribute to structuring our sales playbook Participate in training new Sales hires (onboarding, coaching, sharing learnings) What the role looks like day to day Build your own pipeline Generate qualified meetings across every sales channel: cold calling first, plus email, LinkedIn, events, and networking Create your own network and get referred to new decision-makers Run phoning, email campaigns, and inbound screening from day one Own the full sales cycle Deep discovery, sharp pitch, and efficient closing with practice and group decision-makers Master the Vocca sales playbook to move deals stage to stage Work closely with Ops to ensure smooth deployments (~1 month post-signature) Make the engine better Keep Attio (CRM) spotless and your week tightly planned across prospecting, meetings, and networking Surface field signals into the product roadmap and improve our scripts and sequences What sales look like on the liberal segment Deal size from 15K to 30K 1 month sale cycle ICP : group of independent practitioners This role is for you if The prerequisites: You build qualified pipeline from cold. You've done real cold calling on cold targets : people you're interrupting, not warm inbound or an existing book you upsell. You know how to create a network and earn referrals from new decision-makers. You've run SMB/mid deals end to end. You've personally sourced and closed your own deals for at least 6 months, on fast, slightly pushy cycles (€10–20k average basket). You listen actively, you're convincing and assertive, and you're comfortable being pushy. You have a solar, high-energy presence with the gravitas to deal with doctors: they need to be won over, so we want sharp closers. You adapt your posture and vocabulary from group GMs to individual practitioners with the same professional posture. What we'll evaluate in interviews: Demanding with yourself, highly coachable: your track record shows you don't settle for the status quo (academic, athletic, or professional over-achievement; you hit or beat your targets). No ego : you take feedback, apply it next time, and stay curious about a sector you may not know yet. Team-first: you put collective success before personal recognition. Problem solver, not problem builder. You question yourself when things don't work. Rigor, discipline, organization: you plan your week, arrive prepared and on time, keep the CRM discipline tight. You're reliable. Requirements: 1–3 years of B2B SaaS sales with genuine cold prospecting + closing experience Native-level French and good written and spoken English for internal communication Top-tier background: a strong school, or a demanding company Entrepreneurial mindset Nice to have: Experience in healthcare / healthtech, or selling a product with regulatory constraints Grounding in sales theory (you've read the fundamentals) Familiarity with Attio, Notion, Slack, Apollo This role is NOT for you if You've only ever been a BDR/SDR booking meetings, or you've only "sold" by upselling a warm existing portfolio. This role is cold sourcing + closing from scratch. You optimize for individual recognition over team outcomes. Perks and Benefits Equity (BSPCE) Executive contract (cadre) on a forfait-jours basis, with ~8–12 RTT days per year (depending on the year's public holidays). Hybrid rhythm from Paris: 3-4 days at the office, 1-2 day per week remote. MacBook provided. Meal vouchers: €9 per working day (55% covered by the company). EGYM Wellpass (Gymlib). Health insurance: 50% of Alan covered. Public transport: 50% of Navigo covered. Annual offsite and multiple team events throughout the year. You’ll receive continuous feedback throughout. Why should you join Vocca? An entrepreneurial adventure , with a supportive, high-energy, execution-focused team A product already live , with delighted customers in a fast-growing market (healthcare automation, voice AI) A true scaling phase , with everything still to build Real responsibilities from day one We hire people, not roles. If you're excited about our opportunities but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success. If you identify yourself as a woman : Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements? We'll be thrilled to receive your application! title: Lead Software Engineer, Integrations (TypeScript)
description: Our team shared’s mission is deploy AI agents to transform how patients and doctors connect We believe healthcare shouldn’t be defined by missed calls, endless waiting lines, and overwhelmed staff. Patients and professionals deserve better. Vocca builds AI voice agents that answer every call instantly, schedule and reschedule appointments, and free up staff to focus on what matters most: care. Already trusted by 15 000+ providers, we’re transforming the patient–provider relationship, one call at a time. Want to shape the future of healthcare? Join us ! Discover our company culture and values Here is a product teaser Eliott's interview for Welcome to the jungle Eliott's quick interview for Speedinvest Articles on our A round ( techfundingnews , Maddyness , les echos , our blog ) Vocca in a few words Vocca is an AI voice agent that answers 100% of the calls of medical centres. The patient calls, the AI books the appointment or answers the question, and the medical secretaries keep their time for the cases where a human is really needed. $20M raised, with the founders of Alan and Datadog as investors Close to 1 million calls a month going through the platform Opening the US market The problem Every medical practice runs on software that holds its calendar and its patients. There are dozens of different ones. Most were built twenty years ago and some have no API at all. To book an appointment during a call, our AI agent has to read and write in that software in real time, while the patient waits on the line. On several of these systems, Vocca is the only integrator in the world. This is the work with the most direct impact on the business. A clinic whose software is connected to our agent does not switch. Retention, pricing power, our lead over competitors: it all depends on these integrations. Every software we cannot connect is a clinic we cannot sign. The next step is writing back. Today the agent reads and books. Tomorrow it updates records in EHR, PMS and RIS systems, which raises the reliability bar a lot. In the US, we are opening the dental software ecosystem, with the compliance work that comes with it (HIPAA, SOC2). There is no product manager on this scope. You would be the one deciding. What you will own The architecture of our booking layer. Today it is code written provider by provider, under pressure, partly in Python. It is becoming one unified layer in TypeScript that handles the rules of each medical centre, where adding a new software takes days, not weeks. Speed and reliability at close to 1M calls a month. A call to a clinic software can take several seconds, and the patient cannot wait. You decide how we detect a booking failure in a clinic within 24 hours and what a healthy integration looks like. The roadmap of your scope. You decide which software we connect first, with the sales, ops and support teams and the clinics themselves, and you prove it worked with a number: bookings that go through, failures caught, clinics signed. The relationship with the software vendors, in France and in the US. The hard integrations are the ones nobody else wants to do. They are what makes Vocca hard to replace. The team. You define how this scope works (reviews, documentation, technical decisions), you take part in hiring the next engineers and you help them ship in their first week. How we build Experimental, not R&D. You test, you prove with data, you ship. Challenging a decision means coming back with a result, not a debate. Ship, then fix the last 1%. We ship the version that works, then fix the last 1% when it shows up. With AI, this trade off is much cheaper than before. The judgment about what not to touch is yours. AI, seriously. Agents in every workflow, Claude Max provided. A migration estimated at 3 months was done in 2 weeks. Close to the field. You talk every day with the ops team that deploys clinics, the support team that hears when something breaks and, when it matters, the clinics and the software vendors themselves. Stack TypeScript everywhere (Node, monorepo), PostgreSQL, REST and SOAP APIs from software vendors. We are migrating our last Python services to TypeScript over the coming months. Who does well here 6 to 10 years building products in production, mostly in startups that were growing fast, with at least one place where you stayed long enough to see your system live in the long run. You have built something that mattered: an early engineer at a startup that took off, a system you launched that real users depended on. You can tell us who it was for, what problem it solved and which number moved. You have integrated systems you did not control and you know the difference between a clean API and the real world. Strong in TypeScript and Node, comfortable across the stack. You think about the product and the business as much as the code. You can say no, reduce the scope and explain a technical decision to a founder in two minutes. You are at ease with clients and partners, in French and in English. Probably not for you if you want to manage without coding, or if you need a stable, fully specified environment before you move. What we expect from you First week. Onboarded on the stack, your first fix on a live integration is in production. First month. You own one integration end to end, from the software vendor to production, and show what it changed. You write down how our booking layer should evolve. First 3 months. The unified booking layer in TypeScript is the standard. Adding a new software takes days, not weeks. We detect a booking failure in any clinic within 24 hours. 6 to 12 months. Our first US integrations run in production. You have hired at least one engineer and they ship on their own. Process: 4 steps, fast 45 min with Nans (Talent). 45 min with Pierrick, Head of Engineering. 2h in our office with the engineering team: coding without AI and a real conversation about architecture. 30 min with Hugo, CTO. Then references and an offer. When the match is obvious, we have made an offer in 24 hours. You get feedback at every step. Practical Paris, rue d'Alexandrie (Sentier), new offices. Hybrid, 3 days at the office. BSPCE. Claude Max provided. We aim to keep the process within 30 days . You’ll receive continuous feedback throughout. Why should you join Vocca? title: Executive Assistant - Developer Platform
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: Austin, TX or New York</strong></p> <h2><strong>About the Role</strong></h2> <p>Cloudflare is looking for a bright, proactive, and detail-oriented Executive Assistant to support three leaders in our Developer GTM organization. We are looking for a dynamic and dedicated candidate who is comfortable with multi-tasking and prioritization in a fast-paced, product-first environment with close attention to detail, accuracy, and timeliness. </p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Calendar & Conflict Management:</strong> Proactively manage complex calendars with a strong understanding of business priorities. Independently resolve scheduling conflicts and anticipate meeting requests and logistical needs before they are explicitly stated. </li> <li><strong>Travel & Logistics:</strong> Manage and coordinate complex international and domestic travel, including visa and passport needs, as well as end-to-end logistical arrangements for executives and teams.</li> <li><strong>Executive Support & Business Context:</strong> Develop a deeper understanding of the managers' roles, our products, and the broader market and context for Cloudflare. Serve as a trusted gatekeeper who can confidently answer routine questions on behalf of the executives.</li> <li><strong>Expenses Meeting Coordination:</strong> Prepare and manage expense reports..</li> <li><strong>Projects & Process Improvement:</strong> Contribute significantly to ad-hoc/special projects. Recognize where operational processes can be improved and actively suggest and implement those process improvements.</li> <li><strong>Meetings & Event Planning:</strong> Coordinate and assist with large meetings, external stakeholders, and event planning with precision.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Requirements</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>6+</strong> years experience as an Administrative Assistant, in Ops, or equivalent experience.</li> <li><strong>Scope & Judgment:</strong> A seasoned professional with proven experience handling problems of diverse scope and demonstrating excellent judgment in selecting administrative and operational methods.</li> <li><strong>Proactiveness & Autonomy:</strong> Strong sense of urgency, proactiveness, and the ability to manage your own time with limited or no supervision.</li> <li><strong>Communication & Networking:</strong> Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to network and build strong relationships with executives and team members.</li> <li><strong>Organizational Skills:</strong> Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail.</li> <li><strong>Mindset:</strong> A "no task is too small" attitude combined with the strategic mindset needed to anticipate executive needs.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Drive: Experience working in a tech and AI-native, product-led environment.</strong></h2> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location and level.</p> <p>Estimated Salary for New York:  $114,000 - 157,000</p> <p><strong>Equity</strong></p> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. title: Stage Bouw
description: Hé stage topper! Kom jij, net als vele andere stagiaires, stagelopen bij Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Hengelo? Bij ons krijg jij de kans om mee te denken, werken én ontwikkelen aan gave projecten binnen Noord, Midden en Oost-Nederland. Wij hebben weer volop stageplekken vanaf Februari 2027 op onze bouwen en op kantoor! Dit wordt jouw stage Als stagiair bij Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Hengelo ga je aan de slag op ons kantoor of op één van onze projecten. We kijken in overeenstemming welke afdeling of welk project het beste bij jou en/of de opdracht past. Tijdens je stage word je goed begeleid door één van onze collega’s en krijg je de ruimte om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen! Jij staat aan het stuur van je eigen ontwikkeling tijdens je stageperiode: Hoe meer jij wil leren, hoe meer jij kan leren! Naast dat je zelfstandig aan een opdracht kan werken wordt je ook begeleidt door een senior collega die jou alle kneepjes van het vak gaat leren. We hebben door heel ons werkgebied verschillende bouwen waar we ruimte hebben voor een stagiaire, stuur ons vooral een berichtje zodat we samen kunnen kijken wat passend is! Meer bij Dura Vermeer Dura Vermeer is een familiebedrijf. Een onafhankelijke bouwonderneming actief in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek in Nederland. Al sinds 1855 vormen onze onafhankelijkheid en langjarige continuïteit de basis voor onze strategie. Met een omzet van circa € 1,8 miljard en ruim 3.000 medewerkers behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Samen realiseren we prachtige projecten. Iconische, en soms ook alledaagse projecten waarmee we nieuwe antwoorden bieden op maatschappelijke vraagstukken. Waarmee we de beste oplossingen voor morgen garanderen en het verschil maken voor Nederland, juist op de langere termijn. We hebben stevige ambities – en daarvoor geldt dat we die alleen kunnen waarmaken dankzij onze mensen. Als beste werkgever maken wij ons er daarom hard voor dat jij elke dag opnieuw kiest voor Dura Vermeer. Dat jij net zo trots bent op wat we maken als wij dat zijn. Dat iedereen die bij ons werkt gelukkig is. Dat je bij ons jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je kunt uitspreken. En dat je tot je recht komt. En het beste uit jezelf kunt halen. Hier zit je goed! Wij zijn Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Hengelo, een ontwikkelende bouwer in het werkgebied Noord-, Oost- en Midden-Nederland. Als onderdeel van de divisie Bouw & Vastgoed combineren we de kracht van een groot bedrijf, met de fijne sfeer en cultuur van een kleinere organisatie. Bij ons vind je echte doeners en waarmakers. We ontwikkelen en bouwen, samen met onze klanten, partners en collega’s. Wat ons ons maakt? Gewoon dóen en gewóón doen. Dat zit er nou eenmaal in, en zie je terug in alles wat we doen. Wil jij nou werken op een plek waar vakmanschap, samenwerking en heel veel plezier samenkomen? Mooi! Wij zoeken nieuwe collega’s binnen onze disciplines ontwikkeling, woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, renovatie & transformatie en beheer & exploitatie. Dit breng je mee Je volgt een MBO, HBO of WO opleiding (pre: opleiding Bouwkunde); Je bent proactief, nuchter en een harde werker, net als wij! Dit bieden wij jou Een stagevergoeding van €700 per maand op basis van 40 uren per week; Je krijgt ruimte voor eigen initiatieven; De beste collega’s om het vak van te leren en zij zorgen voor een ongekende goede werksfeer; Een familiebedrijf waarin we voor elkaar klaarstaan! Meer weten? Wij beantwoorden je vragen graag of denken graag met je mee voor het invullen van je stagewens. Schroom niet om contact op te nemen met Nikki Koehorst via 0628362285 of Hopelijk spreken we elkaar snel! Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: CDI - Manager AI Strategist - Paris
description: <p></p> <p><strong><em>Pilotez les missions où se jouent les paris IA des grands groupes, et transformez-les en résultats mesurables</em></strong><strong><br></strong>L’IA, et en particulier l’IA agentique, figure parmi les priorités des comités de direction. Delivery, livrables & collaboration</strong></p> <p>Vous dirigez les missions au quotidien en donnant de la visibilité aux sponsors clients : vous découpez chaque mission en streams, anticipez les risques et challengez le client lorsque c’est pertinent. Vous orchestrez les équipes Engineering pour la faisabilité technique et les équipes AI Adoption pour ancrer l’adoption sur le terrain.</p> <p><strong>IV. Relation client & développement commercial</strong></p> <p>Vous êtes l’interlocuteur de confiance des directeurs métiers et des responsables de projets (Comex-1) : vous cartographiez les rapports de force entre les parties prenantes, animez les restitutions pour emporter l’adhésion et maximiser le NPS client, et gérez les tensions et escalades en préservant la confiance. Équipe & connaissances</strong></p> <p>Vous encadrez et faites grandir les consultants juniors et seniors, êtes counsellor de plusieurs collègues et participez au recrutement des futurs talents. dirigeants, et si vous préférez mettre une démo entre leurs mains plutôt que leur décrire une vision.</p> <ul> <li>5 à 8 ans d’expérience au sein d’un cabinet de conseil en stratégie, en management ou en transformation data / IA.</li> <li>Une formation supérieure de niveau licence ou master, issue d’un cursus académique d’excellence.</li> <li>Une expérience de pilotage de missions complexes, de la vision aux résultats, avec des business cases qui résistent à l’examen d’un Comex.</li> <li>Une solide compréhension des enjeux opérationnels de l’IA (IA générative et agentique, gouvernance, cas d’usage métiers), avec la capacité de l’expliquer simplement à des dirigeants.</li> <li>Une expérience de pilotage de projets de refonte de processus métier, avec une maîtrise avérée de certains processus métier.</li> <li>Une expérience du développement commercial (propositions, développement de comptes, relation avec des décideurs de haut niveau).</li> <li>Une expérience d’encadrement d’une prototyper rapidement des démos fonctionnelles (low-code, no-code, outils agentiques) qui rendent la valeur tangible pour le client.</li> <li>Maîtrise parfaite du français et de l’anglais (oral et écrit).</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>À propos d’Artefact</strong></p> <p>Artefact est un cabinet de conseil spécialisé en data et en intelligence artificielle, qui accompagne les entreprises pour transformer ces technologies en impact business concret et mesurable. aux enjeux de transformation de nos clients.</p> <p>Notre accompagnement couvre l’intégralité de la chaîne de valeur : <strong>AI Strategy</strong> (cadrage stratégique, opportunités à fort impact, trajectoires, modèles opératoires), <strong>Engineering</strong> (industrialisation, architectures agentiques, produits data) et <strong>AI Adoption</strong> (conduite du changement, montée en compétences, usage quotidien de l’IA).</p> <p>Pour en savoir plus sur Artefact, nos expertises et notre culture : <a href="https://www.artefact.com">https://www.artefact.com</a></p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>De la stratégie à la réalisation</strong></li> </ul> <p style="padding-left: 40px;">Ne pas s’arrêter aux recommandations : participer à la conception et à la concrétisation de solutions IA répondant à de véritables enjeux métiers.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Une collaboration entre expertises</strong></li> </ul> <p style="padding-left: 40px;">Occuper un rôle à la croisée de la stratégie (AI Strategy), de la technologie (Engineering) et de l'humain (AI Adoption).</p> <ul> <li><strong>Piloter ce qui compte</strong></li> </ul> <p développer.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Une trajectoire qui accélère </strong></li> </ul> <p style="padding-left: 40px;">Un parcours clair vers Senior Manager puis Directeur, dans un environnement d’apprentissage continu axé sur la transmission des connaissances et le pragmatisme technologique.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Processus de recrutement</strong></p> <ol> <li>Un <strong>entretien de fit RH</strong> (45') avec HR / Talent Acquisition</li> <li>Un <strong>business case AI-driven</strong> (60') avec un AI Strategist Senior Manager ou Directeur</li> <li>Un <strong>business case de prototypage IA hands-on</strong> (60') avec un AI Strategist Senior Manager ou Directeur</li> <li>Un <strong>jeu de rôle AI Strategist Manager</strong> (45'-60') avec un AI Strategist Directeur ou Partner</li> <li>Un <strong>entretien de fit final</strong> (30') avec un AI Strategist Partner ou Managing Partner</li> </ol> <p> </p> <p><strong>Rémunération : 66 000€ à 75 000€ brut annuel (fixe) + 10 000€ de variable, selon expérience et séniorité</strong></p> <p> </p> <p><em>Chez Artefact, nous sommes convaincus que la diversité des parcours, des expériences et des perspectives fait la title: Enterprise Sales Lead (French market)
description: Health can’t wait . Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t. Alan exists to end the wait. Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way. So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience. We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture . We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR. Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond. ⭐️ Why we are hiring ⭐️ We’re opening an Enterprise Sales Team Lead role in France to lead a growing team of 4 Senior Account Executives, who are in charge of acquiring customers with more than 3,000 employees, including all CAC40 companies. In this role, you will own acquisition on the Enterprise segment in France and run the business end‑to‑end : you will be hands-on on the field while coaching and scaling a team of Account Executives to win this market. This position sits at the heart of our growth ambition: We have just passed the one million member milestone – and this is only the beginning! We’re accelerating acquisition in France and doubling down on our portfolio — and the Enterprise segment is one of the core pillars of that plan . About the Enterprise segment Perimeter: companies of 3000+ employees Verticals: all Verticals (Tech, Retail, Industrial Companies etc) Total Addressable Market: ~ 7M members in France Why Enterprise Sales is exciting at Alan Diverse workforce : Mix of 60% cadres / 40% non-cadres, often with subsidiaries or multi-site operations, ranging from highly tech-savvy employees to those requiring digital adoption support. Critical challenges : Multi-stakeholder decision processes involving HRD, CFO, CEO, Payroll, CSE, Legal, Purchasing, Comp & Ben, Accounting, Brokers, Unions, long sales cycles (multi-year conversations), RFP processes requiring deep audits and product customization, and strong influence from unions/CSE who can co-manage health insurance topics; Company profiles : Flagship companies (widely known brands), groups with standalone entities or subsidiaries, often with focus on employee wellbeing (QVT programs, Great Place to Work), modern company culture, and strategic communication about digitization or employer brand attractiveness; HR priorities : Increasing productivity, obtaining fair and competitive pricing, contributing to employee well-being through customized health plans, simplifying HR processes with digital platforms, and managing change management concerns when implementing new health insurance (biggest fear for large companies) Critical business characteristics : This segment requires breadth & depth of expertise to navigate complex organizations, account-based strategies with Key Account Management approach, early engagement in company roadmaps, face-to-face meetings, co-creation of insurance and digital products (tailored offers considering past results, specific regimes, demographics, payroll system integration), and ability to work through RFPs and with brokers. Sales cycles are volatile with high stakes: 1 deal = 50% of annual target for Enterprise Account Executives. Our approach for Enterprise companies positions Alan as a strategic partner in health rather than just an insurance provider, emphasizing our digital platform for fluid UX, customized health plans at fair pricing, and health/well-being services. Success requires leveraging high-level connections, building professional materials, and potentially creating exclusive "Health Clubs" or labels for early adopters. ⭐ What you will do ⭐ You will be the Sales leader of the Enterprise Sales team in France, responsible for both hitting the numbers and scaling the machine . More precisely, you will: Own the Enterprise acquisition plan in France. Design and execute the go‑to‑market strategy for 3000 employee customers, from targeting to closing, to reach ambitious acquisition targets and scale the segment . Lead & coach a team of 4 Account Executives (and likely more to come) Drive hiring, onboarding, and career development as we scale the crew and the segment. Help each team member reach their targets with clear expectations , rigorous follow‑up , and ongoing coaching on methodology, deal execution, and pipeline management. Be on the field with the team : prospecting, joining key meetings, supporting tough negotiations, and owning strategic opportunities to maximize win rates. Empower every member of the team: Create the conditions for everyone to reach and exceed their goals : strong feedback culture, coaching, clear ownership, and autonomy. Ensure market fit and remove blockers: Surface customer expectations, patterns, and blockers, and ensure they’re addressed through the right strategic and execution plans (product, pricing, ops, marketing, etc.). For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the F-G level range . ⭐ Is it what you are looking for? ⭐ You may be a great fit at Alan if you: Have at least 10 years experience in B2B sales , with a proven track record of hitting and exceeding targets as an Account Executive and Sales Leader Have experience leading and coaching sales teams , with the ability to set a high bar , give clear direction , and help people grow Have full working proficiency in French , and advanced level in English for internal communication Have a very hands‑on mentality : you love being on the field with your team, joining customer meetings, helping on tough negotiations, and sharing what works Have experience selling to Enterprise level companies (3000+ employees and above) in multi‑stakeholder deals Are comfortable operating in fast‑paced, ambiguous environments , and can prioritize ruthlessly Are data‑driven and analytical : you know how to leverage KPIs to drive performance, run analyses, and make decisions Have strong cross‑functional collaboration skills and appetite for building things with others (sales ops, marketing, etc.) Are based (or willing to relocate to) the Paris area Nice-to-have: Experience selling to HR or Finance . 🙌 Perks & Benefits At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need , and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers. Therefore, we offer: Fair rewards . Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only. Flexible Office . Amazing office space at our Paris HQ All the tools you need . Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones. Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours . Organize your time as you wish. Delightful healthcare insurance . Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% of the contribution covered by Alan for you and your family, for permanent contracts only. Transport . Country-specific commuter benefits. Learning & Training opportunities . A highly flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises. Parental leave . Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only. Important note: we hire people not roles. After reading this job description, if you feel like you don’t have all the necessary prerequisites but that it matches where you are now or what you'd like to grow into in your next position, we encourage you to apply ! Not everybody will enter our recruitment process, but all, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success. 🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium , blog and Glassdoor page for more info. title: Account Executive, FedCiv
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2>Available Locations</h2> <ul> <li>Washington DC, US</li> </ul> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>Account Executives, Channel Account Managers, Business Development Representatives, Solution Engineers, Customer Success, and Sales Operations - all working together help our customers adopt Cloudflare and create great Internet-enabled experiences. The sales team at Cloudflare helps customers solve real, technical problems while creating the revenue streams that help the company provide free service to millions in our community.</p> <h2>Responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li>We are looking for a seasoned sales professional to help cover the Federal market for US. The ideal candidate will possess both a sales and technical background that enables them to drive engagement at all levels with technical and non-technical buyers.</li> <li>As an Account Executive, you'll be responsible for developing and executing against a comprehensive account/territory plan as well as driving sales in a defined territory and/or account list to achieve revenue targets. The person in this role will also assist in creating and articulating compelling value propositions for Cloudflare services.</li> <li>Manage contract negotiations</li> <li>Maintain a robust sales pipeline</li> <li>Develop long-term strategic relationships with key accounts.</li> </ul> <h2>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h2> <ul> <li>Minimum 3 years of experience selling technical solutions or products to the Public Sector (Federal Government) ; <strong>all</strong> FedCiv agency experience open to consideration</li> <li>Experience managing longer, complex sales cycles`</li> <li>Basic understanding of computer networking and “how the internet works”</li> <li>Aptitude for learning technical concepts/terms (Technical background in engineering, computer science, or MIS a plus)</li> <li>Strong interpersonal communication and organizational skills.</li> <li>Self-motivated; entrepreneurial spirit</li> <li>Comfortable working in a fast paced dynamic environment</li> <li>Experience selling to the Federal customer base</li> </ul> <h2>Compensation</h2> <p>For Washington DC, based hires: The expected salary range for this role is $269,000 - $370,000,  depending on experience and qualifications. Job level and compensation will be determined based on the candidate's experience and alignment to role expectations.</p> <h3>Equity</h3> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <h3>Benefits</h3> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <h3>Health & Welfare Benefits</h3> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <h3>Financial Benefits</h3> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <h3>Time Off</h3> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2>Available Locations</h2> <ul> <li>San Francisco, US</li> <li>We are only considering locally based candidates OR candidates looking to move to the Bay Area.</li> <li> <p>Customer Engineer - (AI & Start-Ups) </p> <ul> <li><br>About the Role<br>Digital Native SEs at Cloudflare work with the most innovative and cutting-edge companies on the planet — the startups and high-growth, cloud-native businesses that are building the next generation of Internet products. These are companies where the developers <em>are</em> the decision makers, and where the CTO is often personally responsible for shipping new products and getting the company's AI initiatives off the ground.<br>This role is for a technologist who genuinely enjoys being in the room with builders. You'll be equally comfortable jumping into a Slack channel with a founding engineer, whiteboarding an architecture with a lead developer, and stepping into a strategic conversation with a CTO about their platform and AI roadmap. You speak the language of engineers fluently and can hold a credible, detailed technical conversation — but this is <strong>not</strong> a software developer role, and you won't be writing production code every day. Your superpower is technical discovery, translation, and evangelism: understanding what a builder is trying to accomplish, mapping it to the full breadth of the Cloudflare Developer Platform, and inspiring teams to build on Cloudflare rather than just consume a single service.<br>The Digital Native segment leans heavily on Solutions Engineering to lead technical discovery within the cloud-developer vertical. You'll be expected to go deep on the Cloudflare Developer Platform — Workers, Durable Objects, Workers AI, R2, KV, D1, Vectorize, Queues, Pages, and the broader developer ecosystem — far beyond basic storage, and to make the case for Cloudflare as <em>the</em> place to build. This role covers both the acquisition of new Digital Native accounts and the expansion of existing ones. The ideal candidate is a "builder" personality with a strong mix of pre-sales/technical customer-facing experience who thrives in an agile, fast-moving environment.<br>What you'll do as a Senior Solutions Engineer<br>The Pre-Sales Solution Engineering organization owns the technical sales of the Cloudflare solution portfolio, ensuring maximal business value, fit-for-purpose solution design and adoption roadmap for our customers. Solution Engineering is made up of individuals from a wide range of backgrounds including but not limited to Sales Consultants, Technical Consultants, Technical Support and Program Managers.<br>You are a customer-facing technologist within the Cloudflare Solutions Engineering team, focused on the developer-first, digital-native segment. You have experience in a pre-sales or other technical customer-facing role, and you're at your best when engaging directly with engineering teams and technical founders. In this role you'll partner closely with the sales team from the very start of the cycle — joining early discovery calls, qualifying opportunities from the get-go, and embedding yourself in customer Slack channels and working sessions. You'll lead technical discovery, deliver compelling demos and architecture discussions, run proof-of-concept builds, and evangelize the Cloudflare Developer Platform as the foundation for our customers' next products and AI initiatives.<br>Responsibilities<br>Specifically, we are looking for you to:<br> <ul> <li>Lead technical discovery within the cloud-developer vertical — asking the right questions to uncover how a customer builds, what they're trying to ship, and where Cloudflare fits.</li> <li>Engage early and often: join sales-led discovery calls from the outset, help qualify deals from the get-go, and stay embedded with customer teams (including in their Slack channels and working sessions) throughout the cycle.</li> <li>Identify and map customer initiatives and business problems — especially around new product development and AI initiatives — to the Cloudflare platform.</li> <li>Build relationships and technical champions within customer accounts, from founding engineers and developers up to the CTO.</li> <li>Develop and present tailored technical content and demos for both hands-on developer audiences and senior technical leadership.</li> <li>Lead demo and proof-of-concept / build activities for Cloudflare prospects and customers.</li> <li>Evangelize the Cloudflare Developer Platform (Workers, Workers AI, Durable Objects, R2, D1, KV, Vectorize, Queues, Pages and more) — making the case for customers to <em>build on</em> Cloudflare, not just use it for storage or CDN.</li> <li>Demonstrate your expertise with your peers through the creation of professional content, including reference architectures, demos, blog posts and other knowledge-sharing activities.</li> <li>Represent and evangelize Cloudflare externally at Developer, Community, Technology and Industry events with thought leadership and expertise.</li> <li>Apply in-depth vertical knowledge or domain expertise. Advise on best practices.</li> </ul> Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience<br> <ul> <li>Previous experience as a Solutions Engineer or other customer-facing technical role, ideally selling to or working with developer-led, cloud-native, or startup organizations.</li> <li>A genuine "builder" mindset and the personality to match: you enjoy talking to developers, you're curious, and you naturally gravitate toward technical problem-solving conversations.</li> <li>The ability to speak engineers' language credibly — you can hold your own on architecture, APIs, and platform design — <strong>without</strong> this being a hands-on, code-every-day developer role.</li> <li>Strong technical discovery instincts: you know how to draw out requirements, qualify fit early, and separate real needs from noise.</li> <li>A good mix of pre-sales / technical sales experience and comfort operating in an agile, fast-moving environment (joining Slack channels, iterating quickly, engaging in early-stage calls, and qualifying deals from the start).</li> <li>Solid communication, written and presentation skills, with the range to talk to both a hands-on developer and a CTO in the same day.</li> <li>Ability to work on several projects and activities concurrently.</li> <li>Highly driven, curious, team-oriented, and able to work with a sense of urgency.</li> <li>You've built web applications before, or contributed to existing web applications in a meaningful way — enough to have real empathy for how developers work.</li> <li>Polished communication and executive presentation skills with the ability to drive a discussion with a broad range of stakeholders (from the web developer to the CTO/CISO).</li> <li>Relationship building: a proven track record of building deep technical relationships with engineers and technical founders. Experience managing various stakeholder relationships to build consensus on technical solutions/projects.</li> <li>Experience managing technical sales within accounts, including developing champion-style relationships, driving technical wins, and assisting with technical validation.</li> <li>Bachelor's Degree or equivalent in relevant work experience.</li> <li>The role requires up to 50% travel to attend meetings with prospects or customers, attend conferences and other industry events, and to collaborate with your Cloudflare teammates.</li> </ul> A deep understanding of the Cloudflare Developer Platform and core industry components (and a desire to learn more):<br> <ul> <li><strong>The Cloudflare Developer Platform</strong> — serverless compute and application development with Workers, Durable Objects, Workers AI, R2, KV, D1, Vectorize, Queues, and Pages. Familiarity with building or architecting applications on a serverless/edge platform is a strong plus.</li> <li>AI/GenAI application patterns — inference at the edge, RAG, vector databases, and how startups are operationalizing AI initiatives.</li> <li>HTTP technologies including reverse proxy (e.g., WAF and CDN), forward proxy (secure web gateway), and serverless application development.</li> <li>Internet security technologies including DDoS and DDoS mitigation, Firewalls, TLS, VPN, DLP.</li> <li>Networking technologies including TCP, UDP, DNS, IPv4 + IPv6, BGP routing, GRE, SD-WAN, MPLS, Global Traffic Management.</li> <li>Zero-trust network access (ZTNA & SASE) concepts including identity management and authentication.</li> <li>Cloud computing technologies such as AWS, GCP, Azure and others.</li> <li>Some scripting or programming familiarity with one or more of JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Golang, BASH — enough to read code, build a demo, and converse with engineers (not to ship production software).</li> <li>Understanding of, or experience with, regulatory requirements such as FedRAMP, GDPR, PCI DSS, HIPAA, SOC-2, ISO/IEC.</li> <li>An undergraduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field. Reminder: this is not a strict requirement at all. Candidates from all walks of life are welcome.</li> <li>You can translate technical concepts and jargon for a wide variety of audiences: from systems engineers, to front-end developers, through to technical founders and C-levels.</li> <li>You want to be constantly learning new things and teaching what you've learned to the broader team through internal and external blog posts, team demos, and product training sessions.</li> <li>You have a knack for understanding problems and finding creative ways to solve them.
